articles.abstract_kr: 본고에서는 『삼국유사』에 언급된 경전과 논소 등의 불전을 전수조사하여 목록화하고 불전의 언급 및 인용 방식을 분류하였다. 더불어 그 맥락과 내용을 검토하여 『삼국유사』에 나타난 불전 유통 내력을 정리하였다.그 결과, 21가지 경전이 68번 언급되었고, 21가지 논소가 28번 언급되어, 총 42가지 불전이 96번 언급되어 있음을 확인했다. 불전의 언급 방식으로는 단순히 경명만을 언급한 경우와 경문을 인용한 경우로 구분할 수 있는데, 경문의 내용을 인용한 것은 총 10회이다. 불전 유통 방식으로는 외국의 사신이나 유학승 등에 의해 불전이 유입된 내용 총 13회, 강론 내력 총 20회, 더불어 8종의 저술이 언급되어 있으며, 또한 수학 내력과 관련하여 불전이나 그 구체적인 내용이 언급된 경우는 총 5회이다.일연은 수많은 불전에 대한 이해를 토대로 선별한 불전 중 필요한 내용만을 요약 및 발췌하여 인용하였으며, 불전을 유입시키거나, 강론하거나, 저술, 또는 수학하는 법시(法施)의 신행 내용을 통해 보살행을 실천할 것을 권하고자 했던 것으로 보인다.이상과 같이 『삼국유사』에 언급된 불전들을 목록화하고, 삼국 내에서의 불전의 유통 내력을 살펴보았다. 어느 시기에 어떤 불전이 삼국에 유통되었는가는 곧 고대 한국 불교의 교학 발전사와 연결된다. 그런 의미에서 본 연구는 당시 교학의 유행과 발전을 파악하는 단초가 될 수 있을 것이라 기대한다.

articles.title_kr: 한국불교의 대학생 전법ㆍ교화 진흥 방안
articles.title_en: A Study on the Promotion of Korean Buddhism's  University Student Propagation
articles.abstract_kr: This study looked at the current address of Korean Buddhism and looked at the characteristics of the MZ generation, who tried to approach Buddhism from a cultural perspective, as well as the view of religion that showed a tendency not to reveal the religion they believed in or to conceal being a religious person. Additionally, statistical data analysis demonstrated that in light of the age and occupational characteristics that Buddhism is most vulnerable to in the distribution of religious people, the search for the revival of Korean Buddhism through the transmission of university students and propagation of Sangwol Gyeolsa is based on appropriate and reasonable judgments both in its solution and validity.Furthermore, the SWOT analysis of Korean Buddhism for college student propagation analyzed that a more convincing approach would be possible through the spread of cultural-oriented Buddhist popularization and the expansion of temple stays and meditation programs, despite the reduced religious environment and the lack of specific and professional missionary personnel and programs.

articles.title_kr: 인공지능시대, 불교 교육 방향성 고찰을 위한 시론적(試論的) 연구 -『금강경』에 기반한 윤리관 구축을 중심으로-
articles.title_en: An Experimental Study on the Direction of Buddhist Education in the Age of Artificial Intelligence：Focusing on establishing a view of ethics based on the Diamond Sutra
articles.abstract_kr: This paper discusses the correct direction and relationship between the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence and current Buddhist education. Today, Artificial Intelligence is causing rapid changes in many areas, even in the principles and methods of education, and this is expected to have a significant impact on Buddhist education. Therefore, this paper examines the problems of artificial intelligence and looks forward to the role and challenges of Buddhist education in the age of artificial intelligence, where artificial intelligence will lead the field of education, including these problems. To this end, this paper first looks at how artificial intelligence is applied in the field of education, based on the understanding of artificial intelligence in this paper. This will lead to a discussion of the direction in which future Buddhist education will evolve. An understanding of the current state of artificial intelligence technology in the field of education will contribute to presenting the direction of future Buddhist education. Second, we present that Buddhist education should be preceded by the construction of an artificial intelligence ethic of “right thinking (right thought) and right action (right practice)” based on 『Diamond Sutra』. Today, the need to derive social consensus on ethical principles for developing an artificial intelligence that conforms to ethical conformity is raised. And 『Diamond Sutra』 will provide a direction for the establishment of an evolving ethical view of a universal perspective to the academic and industrial debate on the direction of artificial intelligence ethics. Today, the interaction between Artificial Intelligence and religious education has both potential advantages and challenges to be solved. Artificial intelligence can increase personalization and accessibility to religious education and increase learner engagement and participation. However, there are limits to what artificial intelligence alone can convey, since religious experience and depth of faith come from human relationships. Therefore, subsequent research will have to better understand the interaction between artificial intelligence and religious education and explore ways to use artificial intelligence based on respect and understanding of human existence and religious beliefs.

articles.title_kr: 백제의 불교수용과 불갑사 초전불교의 비판적 검토
articles.title_en: A critical review of Baekje's acceptance of Buddhism and the first introduction of Buddhism to Bulgapsa Temple
articles.abstract_kr: 백제 불교의 특징은 인도불교와 법화신앙이다. 백제 침류왕 원년(384) 백제에 불교를 전한 마라난타는 축건 출신이다. 인도 승려가 백제에 불교를 전하기도 했지만 나중에 백제 승려가 인도를 찾아가기도 했다. 겸익은 무령왕 때인 521년 인도에 가서 산스크리트어 경전을 가지고 성왕 때인 526년 귀국하였다.마라난타가 배를 타고 백제에 올 때나 겸익이 인도를 오갈 때 법성포 등 전라도 해안을 경유했을 가능성이 높다. 이들이 이곳에 머물러 직접 불교를 홍포하거나 절을 창건하는 등의 구체적인 행동을 취하지는 않았겠지만 인도[축건] 승려에 대한 인상은 깊게 남았을 것이다.백제는 한성시기 불교를 받아들인 이후 웅진시기와 사비시기를 거치면서 불교를 널리 퍼뜨려 나갔다. 법화경 독송을 업으로 삼았던 혜현은 수덕사에 머물다 강남의 달라산[월출산]으로 거처를 옮겨 법화경을 독송했다고 한다. 6~7세기 백제 불교는 공주, 사비 인근을 벗어나 전라도지역까지 확장되어 갔다.전라도 지역의 사찰 가운데 백제 때 창건된 절이 있었다면 이 지역에 잠시 머물렀던 마라난타나 겸익의 역사적인 기억을 떠올리며 초창주를 백제 불교의 초창주인 마라난타에 가탁했을 가능성이 있다. 백제 때 창건된 절이 아닐 경우 17세기 전라도 해안에 표류했던 ‘가흥대장경’을 접하면서 이 지역 불교에 대한 관심이 높아지고 저 멀리 인도 승려 마라난타가 전라도 해안에 잠시 머물러 갔던 역사적 기억을 떠 올렸을 수도 있다.마라난타가 지은 백제 최초의 절이 불갑사란 기록은 역사적 사실이라기보다는 역사적 기억의 재구성이라고 생각한다. 백제 불교의 전통가운데 인도불교의 전통이 큰 부분을 차지한다면 역사적 기억 속에서 불러낼 수 불갑사 등의 사찰이 백제 불교를 알리는 최일선에 나설 수 있다고 생각한다. 다만 그 범위를 마라난타에 한정하지 말고 인도를 오간 겸익까지 포괄했으면 한다.
articles.abstract_en: The characteristics of Baekje[百濟] Buddhism are Indian Buddhism and Lotus Flower faith. Marananda[摩羅難陀], who introduced Buddhism to Baekje in the first year of King Chimryu of Baekje (384), was from Chukgun[竺乾]. Indian monks introduced Buddhism to Baekje, but later Baekje monks also visited India. Gyeomik[謙益] went to India in 521, during the reign of King Muryeong, and returned to Korea in 526, during the reign of King Seong, with Sanskrit scriptures.When Marananda came to Baekje by boat or when Gyeomik went back and forth to India, it is highly likely that he passed through the coast of Jeolla-do, including Beopseongpo[法聖浦]. Although they may not have stayed here and taken specific actions such as directly promoting Buddhism or founding temples, they would have left a deep impression on Indian[Chukgun] monks.After Baekje accepted Buddhism during the Hanseong period, it spread it widely through the Ungjin period and Sabi period. It is said that Hye-hyeon, who made it his business to recite the Lotus Sutra, stayed at Sudeoksa Temple and then moved to Dalasan [Wolchulsan Mountain] in Gangnam, where he recited the Lotus Sutra. In the 6th and 7th centuries, Buddhism in Baekje expanded beyond the areas around Gongju and Sabi to the Jeolla-do region.If there was a temple founded during the Baekje period among the temples in the Jeolla-do, it is possible that the first founder of Baekje Buddhism, Marananda, was entrusted to the temple, recalling the historical memory of Marananda or Gyeomik, who stayed in the area for a while. If it is not a temple founded during the Baekje period, interest in Buddhism in this region may have increased after encountering the ‘Gaheung Tripitaka’ that drifted on the coast of Jeolla-do in the 17th century, and historical memories of the distant Indian monk Marananda staying for a while on the coast of Jeolla-do may have come to mind.I believe that the record that Bulgapsa Temple[佛岬寺] was the first temple in Baekje built by Marananta is a reconstruction of historical memory rather than a historical fact. If the Indian Buddhist tradition is a large part of the Baekje Buddhist tradition, I think temples such as Bulgapsa Temple, which can be recalled from historical memory, can be at the forefront of promoting Baekje Buddhism. However, I hope that the scope is not limited to Marananda but also includes Gyeomik of traveling to India.

articles.title_kr: 이승만 정부가 한국불교에 미친 영향과 그 극복 방안
articles.title_en: The Impact of Syngman Rhee Government on Korean Buddhism and Ways to Overcome it
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 이승만 정부가 한국불교에 미친 영향과 그 극복 방안에 관해 고찰한 것이다. 해방 이후 한국불교에 치명적인 상처를 안겨주었던 ‘승단분규’는 1954년 5월 20일 발표한 이승만 대통령의 ‘사찰정화’에 관한 유시(諭示)에서 비롯되었다. 이승만 대통령이 ‘사찰정화’에 관한 담화를 발표한 목적은 크게 두 가지로 요약할 수 있다. 하나는 정치적 목적이었고, 다른 하나는 종교적 목적이었다. 후자의 종교적 목적은 승단분규를 통해 불교의 자멸을 유도하기 위한 치밀하게 계획된 교묘한 술책이었다. 그러나 당시 불교계의 지도자들은 이승만 대통령의 숨은 의도를 간파하지 못하고, 부화뇌동하여 ‘사찰정화’라는 이름으로 절 뺏기에 몰두해 있었다.이른바 불교계가 자중지란(自中之亂)에 빠져 있을 때, 개신교 근본주의자였던 이승만 대통령이 “장차 한국을 완전한 예수교 나라로 만들겠다.”라는 그의 꿈을 실현하기 위해 노골적으로 기독교 편향정책과 선교활동을 펼쳤다. 그 결과 한국의 기독교는 급성장하였다. 반면 불교계는 이승만 대통령의 유시로 발단된 승단분규로 인해 ‘승단분열(破僧)’이라는 크나큰 상처를 입었다. 승단분열로 인한 폐해와 후유증은 지금도 계속되고 있다. 그중에서 가장 큰 폐해와 후유증은 종파 난립의 문제, 불교 재산의 손실, 승단 내부의 폭력 문화 등이다.이러한 문제점들을 극복하기 위해 필자는 세 가지 방안을 제시한다. 첫째는 공신력 있는 초종파적(超宗派的)이고 범불교적(凡佛敎的)인 기구를 창설하여 정부의 종교편향 정책이나 이교도에 의한 훼불 사건에 적극 대응해야 할 것이다. 둘째는 외부의 권력에 의해 승단정화가 이루어져서는 안 되며, 승단 내부에서 자체적으로 문제를 해결해야 할 것이다. 또한 승단정화는 단 한 번으로 끝나지 않으므로 앞으로도 계속되어야 한다. 셋째는 승단 내부에서 일어나는 다툼, 즉 승쟁(僧諍)은 율장에 명시된 불교 고유의 멸쟁법(滅諍法)으로 해결해야 할 것이다. 승쟁을 사회법에 제소하여 소송비용으로 삼보정재를 탕진하는 것은 비(非) 불교적이다.끝으로 우리가 과거의 암울했던 역사를 되돌아보는 까닭은 과거의 잘못된 역사를 되풀이하지 않기 위함이다. 다시 말해 과거의 역사를 통해 교훈을 얻고자 함이다. 역사를 통해 교훈을 얻지 못한다면, 미래 한국불교의 발전도 기대할 수 없기 때문이다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of Syngman Rhee government on Korean Buddhism and ways to overcome it. The “Quarrel of the Saṅgha,” one of the most devastating blows to Korean Buddhism after the liberation from the Japanese rule in 1945, originated from President Syngman Rhee's May 20, 1954, allocution on the “Buddhist temple purification”. The two purposes of President Syngman Rhee issuing the speech can be summarized as follows. One was political and the other religious. The latter was a maneuver carefully planned to induce the self-destruction of Buddhism through divisions of the Saṅgha. The Buddhist leaders at the time, however, were unable to recognize President Rhee's hidden intention and were solely preoccupied with taking over the temples in the name of 'temple purification' in assentation.While the Buddhist community was in a state of internal strife, President Syngman Rhee, a Protestant fundamentalist, was blatantly favoring Christianity and conducting missionary activities to realize his dream of “making Korea a sheer Christian nation.” As a result, Christianity in Korea grew rapidly. The Buddhist circle, on the other hand, was deeply hurt by the “Saṅgha division (Saṅghabheda)” which sparked off under President Syngman Rhee. The harmful consequences and after-effects of the Saṅghabheda still linger to this day. Among them, the biggest problems are sectarianism, the loss of Buddhist property, and a culture of violence within the Saṅgha.In order to overcome these troubles, I propose three measures. First, an authoritative, non-sectarian, pan-Buddhist organization should be created to actively respond to government policies based on religious biases and incidents of pagan desecration. Second, the purification of the Saṅgha should not be imposed by any outside power but should be addressed by the Saṅgha itself, and should be an ongoing process, not a one-time event. Third, conflicts within the Saṅgha or Saṅgha conflicts should be resolved by the inherent Buddhist method of extinguishing disputes (adhikaraṇasamathā-dhammā) as outlined in the Vinaya Piṭaka. It is un-Buddhist to take a dispute to a secular court and waste the Three Treasures for legal costs.Finally, the reason we look back at the dark history of the past is to avoid repeating the past mistakes. In other words, we want to draw a lesson from history. If we do not learn from history, we cannot expect the future development of Korean Buddhism.
keywords_en: quarrel of the Saṅgha(僧團紛糾)

articles.title_kr: 법연종의 종지와 그 선종사적 연원 고찰
articles.title_en: A review of Bupyeonjong's main purpose and its historical origins in Zen Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: Bupyeonjong's main purpose in Korean Buddhism is a structure that takes the core meaning with Yeonbul, forms the main body with Yeonbup, and unfolds subtle functions with Yeonsa (然師).Yeonbul is the main character's duty and corresponds to the core meaning of nature, and the main character is a fundamental person who has established subjectivity and corresponds to the Buddha nature that he originally possesses.Yeonbup is a universal and subtle teaching in which the true nature of Dharma-dhatu is revealed. This corresponds to the principle that nature's subtle teachings are inherently pure and equal to all living beings.Yeonsa is a subtle and natural action of Buddha, and it acts without prejudice on all living beings with great compassion for all living beings.Therefore, Yeonbul is the main character's duty as a subjective attribute, Yeonbup is a subtle teaching of nature and is a universal law without any obstacles, and Yeonsa is a subtle and natural function of Buddha and is a person who does not fall into Dharma-dhatu.The triple link of Yeonbul, Yeonbup, and Yeonsa is a common relationship that intersects with each other, but at the same time, it is a principle that each acts individually.The three Yeons are as follows: Yeonbul is the meaning of the main character who is independently aware of the principles of nature. Yeonbup is a natural doctrine acquired through Yeonbul, and it is a teaching revealed without distortion and based on correct principles. Yeonsa is a group that practices the correct teachings together as the correct principles that each individual embodies.When comparing Three Yeons with the traditional Buddhist system, they are contrasted with the Buddha's treasures, Dharma treasures, and monks, respectively.The origin of the Three Yeons presented in Bupyeonjong is based on the ideology of the Patriarch-zen the history of Zen Buddhism. Yeonbul corresponds to Patriarch-zen’s ideology that ‘All living beings are inherently Buddha’, Yeonbup is a teaching that reveals Patriarch-zen’s ideology, and Yeonsa corresponds to an organization that practices Patriarch-zen’s ideology.Therefore, speaking of the core meaning of Bupyeonjong, it is not limited to Bupyeonjong but is a universal principle that extends even further to all religions of the universe, thus expanding the scope of so-called Buddhism.

articles.title_kr: 천주교 성지에 가려진 내포지방 민중사
articles.title_en: People's History in Naepo Region, Hidden in the Catholic Holy Land
articles.abstract_kr: 조선은 1876년 개항 이후 천주교에 대해 종교적 자유를 보장하였다. 이제 어떤 차별과 탄압 없이 천주교를 믿을 수 있게 된 것이다. 이후 천주교는 한국 사회 주요 종교가 되었다. 최근 천주교는 초기 천주교인의 희생을 기리고 성역화하려 노력하고 있다. 천주교 박해 과정에서 희생된 사건을 부각하고 희생된 인물을 찾아 성인으로 추대하여 성역화 하려는 것이다. 하지만 이로 인한 사회적 갈등이 심화되는 문제는 피할 수 없다.충남 서북부의 내포지방은 천주교의 성역화 사업으로 인해 문제가 발생하는 대표적인 지역이다. 내포지방은 외래 문물과 사상에 개방적이어서 역사적으로 불교를 비롯한 각종 사상과 종교의 진입로가 되었다. 천주교 역시 예외가 아니어서 내포지방을 중심으로 정착한 이후 크게 확산되었다. 이에 따라 내포지방 곳곳에는 천주교가 주목하여 성지로 삼으려는 역사 유적이 산재해 있다. 천주교 입장에서는 정착 초기 천주교에 대한 박해로 인해 종교적 자유를 위해 희생된 죽음을 추도하고자 해서 이를 성역화하려 한다. 하지만 성역화하려는 곳이 역사적으로 다른 사건과 인물의 흔적이 더 크고 진하게 남아 있다는 사실 또한 인정해야 한다. 이를 통해 사회적, 문화적, 종교적 갈등을 해소하고 공존과 공영의 길로 나가야 하기 때문이다.이 글은 천주교가 성역화하려는 내포지방의 역사 유적이 천주교만의 역사를 가지고 있는 곳이 아니라 다양한 사건과 인물이 역사 공간에서 함께 했었던 사실을 밝히려 한다. 구체적인 사례가 홍주읍성, 해미읍성, 합덕성당, 충청수영성이다. 이곳은 천주교만의 역사만 있었던 것이 아니라 비슷한 시기 동학농민혁명과 의병운동 과정에서 수많은 인물이 희생되었던 곳이다.
articles.abstract_en: Following the opening of its ports in 1876, the Joseon Dynasty officially granted religious freedom to Catholics, allowing Catholicism to be practiced without discrimination or persecution. Since this pivotal moment, Catholicism has emerged as a significant religion within Korean society. In recent years, there has been a focused effort within the Catholic Church to commemorate the sacrifices of early Catholics and to elevate these martyrs to sainthood. This initiative seeks to highlight the incidents of persecution faced by early Catholics and to canonize those who were martyred. However, this endeavor has also led to inevitable social conflicts.The Naepo region, located in the northwestern part of South Chungcheong Province, serves as a notable example of the tensions arising from the Catholic Church's sanctuary project. Historically, Naepo has been a region receptive to foreign cultures and ideas, functioning as an entry point for various religions, including Buddhism. Catholicism, which spread significantly after its introduction to the region, is no exception. As a result, numerous historical sites throughout Naepo have drawn the attention of the Catholic Church, which aims to consecrate these sites as holy places.From the Catholic perspective, these sites are envisioned as sanctuaries intended to commemorate those who sacrificed their lives for religious freedom during the early days of Catholicism in the region. However, it is crucial to acknowledge that these locations bear a broader historical significance, encompassing events and figures beyond the Catholic narrative. The challenge lies in addressing the social, cultural, and religious conflicts that arise from this project and in fostering coexistence and mutual prosperity.This paper aims to demonstrate that the historical sites in Naepo, which the Catholic Church seeks to sanctify, are not exclusively linked to Catholic history. Rather, they are spaces that have witnessed a diverse array of events and people. For instance, locations such as Hongju-eupseong, Haemi-eupseong, Hapdeok Cathedral, and Chungcheong Suyeongseong are not only significant in the context of Catholicism but also as sites where many were sacrificed during the Donghak Peasant Revolution and the Unknown Righteous Army Soldier Movement, both of which occurred during a similar period. These examples underscore the complex and multilayered history of the Naepo region, a history that must be considered in any efforts to designate these sites as sanctuaries.

articles.title_kr: 백제불교의 전래 주체와 초전지에 대한 고찰                       - 침류왕대 한성백제 구도읍과 신도읍과 관련하여 -
articles.title_en: An Examination of the Agents and Initial Locations of Buddhism's Introduction in Baekje  - Focusing on the Old and New Capitals of Hanseong Baekje during King Chimryu's Reign -
articles.abstract_kr: 이 논문은 백제의 불교자산 구축사업의 일환으로 침류왕대 한성백제의 구도읍과 신도읍을 중심으로 이루어진 백제불교의 전래 주체와 초전지에 대해 살펴본 것이다. 온조왕은 한강 변의 평지에 판축 기법으로 세운 풍탑토성을 도성으로 삼았다. 근초고왕은 고대국가를 공고히 하고 왕권을 강화하고자 했던 왕성의 천도라는 특단의 조치를 취했다. 이것은 고구려 고국원왕을 잃은 고구려의 침략에 대비하고 기존 정파들의 대립을 잠재우기 위한 그의 마지막 승부수였다. 근초고왕이 천도(371)한 새로운 왕성은 바로 구릉지에 세운 몽촌토성이었다.침류왕은 근초고왕과 근구수왕 이래 유교와 도가 사상에 입각한 왕실 주도 세력들을 제압하고 강력한 왕권을 수립하고자 했다. 이를 위해 호승 마라난타가 동진의 수도 건안을 거쳐 연안의 항로로 배를 타고 한강 하류에서 거슬러 올라오자 교외(풍납토성)까지 나아가 왕성(몽촌토성)으로 맞아들여 예경을 하였다. 침류왕은 재위 2년 차에 구도읍(몽촌토성)에서 신도읍(위례성)으로 천도(385)하고 이곳에 사찰을 창건하고 승려 10여 인을 출가시켜 불교사상을 홍포하였다. 기존의 유교와 도가 사상을 믿던 왕실 주도 세력들을 제압하고 불교사상을 중심으로 왕권을 공고히 하기 위해서였다.하지만 침류왕이 재위 2년 차에 세상을 떠나자 동생 진사왕이 즉위하면서 불교사상은 배척되고 유교와 도가 사상 중심으로 재편되었다. 진사왕을 척살하고 왕위에 오른 아신왕 또한 불교 홍포라는 부왕의 유지를 잇고 왕권을 강화하기 위해 “불법을 받들어 믿고 복을 구하라”는 교지를 내렸다. 그러나 아신왕은 고구려와의 전쟁에서 연패하면서 불교 홍포에 충실하지 못했다. 대신 왜나라에 볼모로 다녀온 아들 전지왕에 의해 불교사상이 적극적으로 수용되었다. 그 배경에는 전지왕의 비 팔부수인과 해씨계의 적극적인 뒷받침이 있었다.백제불교의 전래 주체는 호승 즉 천축의 건다라에서 동진의 건안을 거쳐 배를 타고 한강으로 거슬러온 마라난타였다. 한성백제 불교는 호승 마라난타의 신이성과 감통력을 구심으로 깊게 토착화되었다. 그리고 초전지인 구도읍 몽촌토성을 인연처로 하여 신도읍 위례성을 중심으로 넓게 대중화되었다. 그리하여 한성백제 불교는 마라난타와 위례성의 구심을 기반으로 웅진백제와 사비백제를 향해 동심원을 그려나갔다. 그 결과 겸익(謙益) 등을 통한 인도불교와의 직접 교류와 아직기(阿直岐, ?~?)와 왕인(王仁) 등을 통해 가야 제국과 왜나라로 불법과 선진문화를 전할 수 있었다.
articles.abstract_en: An Examination of the Agents and Initial Locations of Buddhism's Introduction in Baekje- Focusing on the Old and New Capitals of Hanseong Baekje during King Chimryu's Reign -This study investigates the introduction of Buddhism to Baekje and its initial location, focusing on the old and new capitals of Hanseong Baekje during King Chimryu's reign, as part of Baekje's Buddhist cultural heritage development project. King Onjo established Pungnap Earth Fortress along the Han River plains as his capital. King Geunchogo took a significant step by relocating the royal palace to solidify the ancient state and strengthen the monarchy. This was his final strategic move to subdue internal political factions and prepare for invasions from Goguryeo after King Gogugwon’s loss. The new royal palace, which King Geunchogo relocated to in 371, was Mongchon Earth Fortress, built on hilly terrain.King Chimryu, in an effort to consolidate royal authority, sought to subdue Confucian-Daoist factions within the royal family that had been prominent since the reigns of King Geunchogo and King Geungoosoo. When the foreign monk Marananta traveled from the Eastern Jin capital of Jian’an by sea and up the Han River, King Chimryu went to the outskirts (Pungnap Earth Fortress) to welcome him and escorted him respectfully to the royal palace (Mongchon Earth Fortress). In the second year of his reign, King Chimryu moved the capital from the old capital (Mongchon Earth Fortress) to the new capital (Wirye-seong) in 385, where he established a temple and ordained around ten monks to promote Buddhist teachings. This shift aimed to strengthen his royal authority by centering it around Buddhism, countering the influence of the Confucian-Daoist factions in the royal court.However, after King Chimryu's death in the second year of his reign, his brother King Jinsa took the throne, shifting the ideological focus back to Confucian and Daoist teachings. King Ashin, who ascended after King Jinsa’s death, issued a royal decree urging the people to "uphold and believe in the Buddha's teachings and seek blessings," continuing his predecessor’s efforts to promote Buddhism and strengthen the monarchy. However, King Ashin was hindered in promoting Buddhism due to repeated losses in wars with Goguryeo. Instead, his son King Jeonji, who had returned from Japan as a political hostage, actively embraced Buddhism, supported by his wife, Palbusuin, and the Hae clan.The primary agent of Baekje Buddhism’s introduction was the foreign monk Marananta, who journeyed from Gandhara, India, via Jian’an, Eastern Jin, by boat up the Han River. Hanseong Baekje Buddhism deeply rooted itself in local culture around Marananta's reputed spiritual abilities. From the initial transmission site at the old capital, Mongchon Earth Fortress, Buddhism expanded widely, centering around the new capital, Wirye-seong. This foundation in Hanseong Baekje, supported by Marananta and Wirye-seong, later spread towards Woongjin Baekje and Sabi Baekje. As a result, direct exchanges with Indian Buddhism were possible through figures like Gyumik, and the spread of Buddhism and advanced culture to the Gaya Confederacy and Japan occurred through figures such as Ajikgi and Wangin.

articles.title_kr: 『짜끄라상와라딴뜨라』 성립의 탈전통에 대한 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Emergence of Cakrasaṃvara Tantra oriented with the Inner and Outer sources of Buddhist Tantrism
articles.abstract_kr: From the emergence of Guhyasamaa Tantra, the later Indian Esoteric Buddhist scriptures began to expand upon the materials of Yogini Tantra, with the background of Shaivism and Kalachakra rituals. The Shaivite currents that swept through 10th-century India sought practical practices that corresponded to the realities of human existence, transforming vast religious scriptures and cosmologies, excluding formalities. The emergence of Cakrasaṃvara Tantra, influenced by Shaivism, expanded upon the Shaivite elements inherent in Guhyasamaa Tantra, emphasizing individual practices and highlighting the attainment of physical achievements and the philosophy of Kalachakra. The presence of Mandala and Dakinis in Cakrasaṃvara Tantra reflects a simplified structure, avoiding complex doctrinal compositions and focusing on the essence of enlightenment and devotion, presenting Bodhisattvas such as Vajrasattva and Vajrapani in correspondence with the components of the human body. The final rites, which encompass all traces of Buddhist history in human existence, are the Samaya Wheels, the foundation of Bodhisattva practices established by Buddha when performing Bodhisattva activities. While reflecting pilgrimage sites popular in Shaivism, all rituals have undergone purification in Buddhist thought, based on the philosophy of later Middle Way thought, demonstrating the development of the Buddha Nature and the philosophy of enlightenment. The practicality of transcending tradition pursued byCakrasaṃvara Tantra serves as a guide for practical practices emphasizing action, as seen in the transmission of Kagyu, such as the Six Yogas of Naropa and Mahamudra. The expansion of the later Indian Esoteric Buddhism of Yogini Tantra lineage shows a deep relationship with the practical practices of Buddhist teachings within the Indian Buddhist community, seeking simplicity through the inevitability of the Bodhisattva path and individual practices emphasizing practicality.

articles.title_kr: 불교 역사 왜곡의 현황과 실태 - 주어사, 천진암에 대한 한국천주교회의 성지화 사업을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Present and Actual Condition of the Distortion of the Korean Buddhist History - Centering around the Project of Korean Catholic Church That Makes the Buddhist Temples of Jueosa and Cheonjinam to Be the Christian Holy Places -
articles.abstract_kr: 경기도 광주시와 여주시의 경계에는 앵자봉(鶯子峰)이라는 산의 양쪽 자락에 주어사(走魚寺, 여주시 산북면)와 천진암(天眞庵, 광주시 퇴촌면)이라는 사찰 터가 있다. 최근 한국천주교(한국가톨릭)에서는 이 두 사찰 터를 ‘(한국천주교회의) 최초 강학지(講學地)’라고 주장하며 자신들의 발상지로 규정하고 성지화 작업을 진행 중이다.천진암 터는 일대의 골짜기 전체가 천주교 수원교구에 매입되어 각종 천주교 시설이 들어선 상태로, 한국천주교에서는 이곳을 이른바 ‘한국천주교회의 발상지 천진암성지’로 홍보하고 있다. 주어사 터는 현재 별다른 개발이 이루어지지 않은 채 본격적인 천주교 성지화 작업이 시작되지 않았다. 그러나 다수의 천주교인들은 주어사 터도 한국천주교회의 또 다른 발상지로 인식하고 있는 듯하며, 이는 현재 한국천주교에서 신자 교육을 시작으로 주어사에 대한 ‘성지’ 인정 투쟁을 시작하고 있음을 시사한다.주어사와 천진암은 조선 후기 다산 정약용과 일부 근기남인(近畿南人) 소장파 유학자들이 왕래하였던 것으로 알려져 있다. 한국천주교에서 이곳을 한국천주교회의 발상지로 간주하고 개발을 추진하는 것은 이들 근기남인 유학자들이 이곳에 모여 함께 강학을 했다는 일부 기록을 근거로 한다. 문제는 그들의 강학 내용이 서학(西學) 즉 기독교 관련 지식이었다는 점에 대해서는 학계의 주장이 갈린다는 점과, 무엇보다도 그 독서 모임을 용인 내지 지원하며 그들을 보호해 주었던 이가 바로 이 사찰의 스님들이라는 사실을 한국천주교에서 철저히 은닉하고 있다는 사실이다. 지역주민들 사이에 전해 오는 이야기에 따르면 당시 서학자들이 국가권력으로부터 탄압을 받고 처형당할 때 이들을 후원했던 스님들도 함께 희생당했다고 한다. 그러나 천주교계에서는 이러한 스님들의 자비와 희생에 대하여 침묵하는 것은 물론, 심지어 이곳이 본디 불교 사찰이었다는 사실조차 소거한 채 무리하게 역사적 맥락을 왜곡하며 자신들의 교회사를 독자적으로 성화(聖化)하려는 듯하다.한국천주교는 종교사와 정치사를 구별할 줄 아는 인식 태도와 함께 이웃 종교, 더욱이 자신들이 어려웠던 시절 우호와 원조를 아끼지 않았던 불교에 대해 감사와 존중의 태도를 갖추는 태도가 요구된다. 천진암과 주어사에서 벌어졌던 실제의 역사적 사실―이곳이 본디 불교의 사찰이었고, 이 사찰 스님들의 후원으로 소장파 근기남인 학자들의 강학이 이루어졌으며, 본인들이 탄압당할 때 도움을 주었던 사찰과 스님들도 그와 연루되어 함께 희생되었다는 사실―을 인정하고, 추모비와 안내판 등을 설치하여 감사를 표하며 교내외에 알릴 필요가 있다. 이러한 태도야말로 현재 한국 사회에 만연한 종교 갈등을 해결하는 실마리를 제시하며, 이웃 종교들에게도 좋은 모범이 될 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: There are the sites of the Buddhist temples (Jueosa, Cheonjinam) in the border of Guangju city and Yeoju city in Gyeonggido province of Korea. Korean Catholic church is recently making the sites of the Buddhist temples of Jueosa and Cheonjinam to be the Christian holy places for they insists that the sites were their cradles.The site of Cheonjinam has been bought by Suweon ecclesiastical district of Korean Catholic church and many Cathlic centers have been established in this site. Korean Catholic church publicizes it as ‘the Holy Land of Cheonjinam, the cradle of Korean Catholic church’. The site of Jueosa is nether developed nor made as Christian holy site. But many catholics seem to think of the site as their another cradle. It gives suggestion that Korean Catholic church started a kinf of recognition struggle for the Holy Land of Jueosa.There is the records that Jeong-Yakyong and young Confucian scholars of Namin faction tending to Western Learning studied and debated in Jueosa and Cheonjinam. It is the reason that Korean Catholic church insists that the sites were their cradles. But it is not sure whether the contents of their study in these temples were Western Learning or Christian doctrines. Furthermore, Korean Catholic church conceals that it were the monks of the temples who helped the young scholars and were other victims of christian oppression in 19th century of Choseon dynasty.Korean Catholic church needs to distinguish the history of religion and the history of politics and to appreciate that Korean Buddhism helped them in hard times. They also needs to recognize that Jueosa and Cheonjinam were obviously the Buddhist temples and that the monks of the temples helped them and victimizes for the help by the political power. The memorials and informations to let know the help of and the relationship with Buddhism should be set up. These attitudes will offer the clue to solve the religious conflicts of modern Korea and will be good example to other religions.

articles.title_kr: 황벽(黃檗)의 어록(語錄)에 나타난 선사상과 그 의의
articles.title_en: The Zen Thought in the Sayings of Huangbo and Its Significance
articles.abstract_kr: This paper examines the Zen thought expressed in Huangbo Xiyun's recorded sayings in Chuan Xin Fa Yao and Wan Ling Record, as well as in the sayings of Huangbo quoted in The Record of Linji, composed by Huangbo's disciple, Linji Yixuan.Chuan Xin Fa Yao and Wan Ling Record are collections of Huangbo's teachings compiled by Pei Xiu, who was a student of Huangbo's teachings. It is presumed that these collections mention doctrinal teachings because they were preached to Pei Xiu, who had a good understanding of the doctrine.The central practice of Zen in these texts is One Mind. Huangbo identifies the essence of Chinese Zen as One Mind, emphasizing that both Buddhas and sentient beings possess this One Mind. However, sentient beings cling to the forms of this One Mind, seeking Buddha externally.Therefore, Huangbo presents the essence of One Mind as being No Mind, leading to No Seeking and No Attachment, and proclaims Mind Itself is Buddha and No Mind is the Way. Huangbo calls this comprehensive method of Zen The Dharma Gate of the Mind Ground. The Zen thought of Huangbo presented in Chuan Xin Fa Yao and Wan Ling Record generally aligns with this.The paper argues that the Zen thoughts of One Mind, No Seeking, No Attachment, Mind Itself is Buddha, No Mind is the Way, and The Dharma Gate of the Mind Ground all originate from the Southern School of Zen, inherited through Hui Heung , Mazu Daoyi, and Baizhang Huaihai.Huangbo's Zen thought, as cited in The Record of Linji by his successor Linji, appears to be Linji's own unique view. Linji defines the essence of Chinese Zen as Not being deceived by people. Linji regards all Buddhist teachings and masters' instructions as Not being deceived by people.However, the difference in Linji's expression does not signify a divergence from Huangbo's thought. This differentiation in expression is considered a compassionate effort by Zen masters to lead individuals to an autonomous realization of the ultimate principle of Zen. This aspect signifies the important implications of Huangbo's Zen thought.

articles.title_kr: 백제의 법화·천태 전래와 수용
articles.title_en: Baekje's Beophwa and Cheontae Transfer and Acceptance
articles.abstract_kr: 이 논문은 백제의 법화천태사상 전래에 대해 살펴보고, 현광을 중심으로 백제의 법화천태사상 수용의 의의를 밝힌 것이다.백제에 언제 법화경과 천태사상이 전래했는지에 대해서는 명확한 기록이 없다. 불교경전이 처음 전해진 것은 성왕 때(聖王 19년, 541) 양나라에 사신을 보내 󰡔열반경󰡕 등과 경소(經疏)를 청하여 전해왔다고 하여 이때에 법화경도 전해졌을 것으로 보인다. 법화‧천태사상의 전래는 위덕왕(威德王)때 현광(玄光)이 중국의 남악 형산(衡山)에 들어가 혜사(515-577)로부터 법화삼매를 증득하고, 그의 고향 웅주(熊州)로 돌아와 법화삼매를 폈다는 것이다. 우리나라 천태사상은 대개 천태종을 개창한 천태 지자대사 이후 그 사상과 신행이 전해졌는데, 백제만은 천태의 스승 혜사로부터 법화삼매사를 증득하여 전한 것이다. 이로써 백제는 우리나라에 맨 처음 천태 이전의 천태종 사상과 신행을 수용하고 있어서, 그 역사적 의의가 크다. 혜사법맥에서 천태대사가 천태종 적사(嫡嗣)라면, 현광은 방계(傍系)로 분류하고 있으며, 입적후 천태종 본당인 국청사 조사당과, 혜사의 조사당에 봉안되었다. 현광은 이와 같이 두 곳 조사당에 봉안된 천태종의 고승으로 존숭되었다.또한 현광은 위덕왕대 고승으로 중국에서는 혜민(惠旻)이라는 걸출한 제자를 배출하였고, 웅주(熊州)에 돌아와서는 법을 전승한 제자와, 화광삼매(火光三昧)를 얻은 자, 수광삼매자(水光三昧)를 얻은 자를 배출하여 백제에 처음으로 실천적인 법화불교를 전하였다.
articles.abstract_en: This thesis examines the transmission of Beophwa Cheontae Thought of Baekje and reveals the significance of Baekje's acceptance of Beophwa Cheontae Thought centering on Hyeongwang(玄光).There is no clear record of when Baekje was introduced to the Buddhist scriptures and Tendai thought. The Buddhist scriptures were first transmitted to the two kingdoms during the reign of King Seongwang (聖王19, 541), and it was believed that the Buddhist scriptures were also transmitted at this time. The origin of Beophwa and Tiantai thought is that during the reign of King Uideok(威德王), Hyeongwang(玄光) entered Namak Hyeongsan(衡山) in China, acquired Beophwasammae(法華三昧, Saddharma-pundarika sammadhi) from Hyesa(惠思515-577), and returned to his hometown of Ungju(熊州) to practice Beophwasammae. The thought of Tiantai in Korea has been passed down since the Ambassador of Tiantai Jija, who usually reformed Tiantai sect. As a result, Baekje accepts the Tiantai sect thought and new act before the first Tiantai in Korea, and its historical significance is great, If the Tiantai ambassador is a Tiantai sect, it is classified as a Buddhist temple, and after the entrance, it was enshrined in the Buddhist temple of the Tiantai sect, the Buddhist temple of the Tiantai sect, and the Buddhist temple of Hyesa. It was revered as a high priest of Tiantai sect.In addition, Hyeonggwang was the leader of the Uiduk king, and in China, he produced an outstanding disciple named Haemin(惠旻). When he returned to Ungju, he brought out the disciples who passed the dhama, those who got the fire light sammadhi(火光三昧), and those who got the water light sammadhi(水光三昧, and gave the first practical Lotus Buddhism to Baekje.

articles.title_kr: 중화민국 시기 불교 잡지의 간행과 그 의미
articles.title_en: The emergence, publication and value of Buddhist magazines during the Republic of China
articles.abstract_kr: This paper was designed to explore the possibility of using domestic academia through the organization and analysis of Vast Buddhist Magazines published in the period of the Republic of China (1912-1949) in modern China. Therefore, in this paper, the background of the emergence of these Buddhist magazines was first reviewed. During the period of social transformation in modern China, Chinese Buddhism was threatened from the outside and there was also an internal threat. In this crisis situation, Chinese Buddhism went on the path to reform. Faced with the stagnation of Chinese Buddhism as a whole, due to the influence of the May 4th Movement and the Sinmunization trend, Chinese Buddhist monks and laypeople at the time began to exert efforts. At that time, Buddhists promoted Buddhist reform and carried out activities to develop education and culture, raising the spirit of placing importance on Buddhist culture projects. The emergence of Buddhist magazines came into existence under this background of the times.The 『Fo Xue Cong Bao』 and the 『Fo Jiao Yue Bao』 were the first Buddhist newspapers in the period of the Republic of China, and as part of Buddhist propagation and cultural projects, they transformed the propagation method of Buddhism into a revolutionary modernization. Buddhism's influence was greatly increased by this new type of mass media through its popularization and widespread spread. These two publications demonstrate the beginning of a modernization transformation of the spread of Chinese Buddhism.At that time, the 『FoXue CongBao』, published by Di Chuqing, one of the conservative groups in the Buddhist community, rather blew the first trumpet of modern and contemporary Buddhist innovation. The 『FoJiao YueBao』 presented specific innovation suggestions for the city-worshipping of Buddhism, eradicated ghosts by using atheism, advocated equality in line with republican theory, and established schools to lift the world's ridicule. This is a passage that shows the Buddhist community's consensus that we must conform to the times and society. This was also the basis of the modern and contemporary Buddhist innovation movement.The entire list of Buddhist magazines published during the period of the Republic of China, which can be checked so far, was organized based on the region of publication. The period distribution of Buddhist magazine publication was the largest with 68 types in the 1930s, and the regional distribution was an important administrative district in the Republic of China, with 27 types published in Shanghai and the largest.Among the numerous magazines, 『HaiChaoyin』 has a long history. This magazine is the official publication of the Chinese Buddhist Church in the first half of the 20th century. The significance of this publication magazine is that it shows the appearance of Chinese Buddhism and the status of Buddhist studies over a hundred years. Ambassador Taixu (太虛), who is closely related to the publication of the 『Hae-eum』, was an important representative of the Buddhist community in the Republic of China.In short, the publication of Buddhist magazines during the Republic of China was the construction of popular Buddhism during that period. Due to the prosperous spirit of Chinese Buddhist history, more than 140 magazines were arranged side by side and their forms are diverse. The launch of a Buddhist magazine shows that Buddhism during the Republic of China places great importance on secular society, is a physical embodiment of the ideology of Buddhist doctrines, and shows the path to popularization and socialization of Buddhism.

articles.title_kr: 영규대사와 800의승 현양 사업의 과제와 전망
articles.title_en: Tasks and Prospects of the Project to Honor the 800 Righteous Monks and the Great Master Yeonggyu
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논의는 임진왜란 당시 8백명의 의승과 함께 금산전투에서 순절한 의승장 영규대사의 추모의 흐름이 어떻게 이루어져 왔는지 살펴보았다. 영규대사와 800의승의 추모가 조선 후기에 어떻게 이어져 왔는지를 알아보고, 그들의 정신을 기리고 계승하기 위해서는 어떻게 해야 할 것인지에 대한 고민을 나누고자 한다. 이는 호국불교의 구체적인 실현자를 대하는 한국불교의 특징을 살펴볼 수 있는 계기가 될 수 있다.본 논의에서 영규대사와 8백 호국의승 현양 사업을 위한 제언을 하였다. 먼저 호국의승의 정신과 가치를 현양하기 위한 조직을 굳건하게 서우고 중장기적 전망과 정책을 수립할 것, 호국의승 디지털아카이브 구축, 호국의승의 삶을 체험할 수 있는 실감콘텐츠 개발, 지속 가능한 호국불교 관련 콘텐츠 개발과 활용을 담당할 수 있는 인력양성 시스템, 체험할 수 있는 거점 공간의 위계를 회복 등의 방안을 제언하였다. 이는 현양 사업을 위한 논의의 단초를 마련하는 수준이다.오늘을 사는 우리들은 선조들처럼 호국의승의 정신을 계승하고 이를 현양하는 데 진심을 다해 노력해야 할 것이다. 나아가 뜻을 같이하는 여러 사람들과 지혜와 마음을 함께 해야 할 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: This discussion examines how the flow of remembrance of leader of the righteous monks Yeonggyu, who died in the Battle of Geumsan with 800 righteous monks during the Imjin War, has been formed. We will examine how the remembrance of the great master Yeonggyu and the 800 righteous monks continued in the late Joseon Dynasty and share our thoughts on how to honor and inherit their spirit. This can be an opportunity to examine the characteristics of Korean Buddhism in dealing with specific practitioners of patriotic Buddhism.In this discussion, suggestions were made for the promotion project for the great master Yeonggyu and 800 righteous monks who protected the country. First, we suggested the following measures: firmly establishing an organization to promote the spirit and value of the Buddhist monks who protected the country, establishing mid- to long-term prospects and policies, establishing a digital archive of Buddhist monks who protected the country, developing realistic content that allows people to experience the lives of Buddhist monks who protected the country, establishing a human resources training system that can take charge of developing and utilizing sustainable Buddhist Buddhist content, and restoring the hierarchy of the base space where people can experience the country. This is only the starting point for discussions on the promotion project.We who live today should make sincere efforts to inherit the spirit of Buddhist monks who protected the country and promote it like our ancestors. Furthermore, we should share our wisdom and hearts with many people who share the same purpose.
keywords_en: the Leader of the Righteous Monks

articles.title_kr: 한국의 문자 생활과 불교계의 기여
articles.title_en: The development of writing system in Korea and the contribution of Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: 신라와 고려시대에 사용된 ‘향찰’과 ‘구결’, 그리고 1443년 ‘훈민정음’ 창제 직후까지 한국의 문자 생활에 대해 살펴보고, 승려들이 우리의 문자 발전에 어떻게 기여했는지 를 밝혔다.향찰은 ‘자형’에 있어서는 한자를 그대로 사용하지만 ‘자음’을 변형시키거나 한자에서 ‘자의’를 제거하기도 하는 독창적인 방식을 통해 한국어를 전면적으로 표기할 수 있는 문자 체계이다. 향찰은 표의-표음 복합체계를 통해 의미 전달의 효율성을 극대화하 고, 종성자의 인식과 초성/중성/종성으로의 음절 분리 의식이 반영된 문자 시스템이다. 이런 향찰을 가장 능숙하게 사용했던 집단이 불교 승려 계층이었다는 사실과 이런 문자를 오늘날까지 전해지도록 애쓴 집단 역시 승려였다는 사실을 확인하였다.구결은 향찰에서와 마찬가지로 자음을 변형하거나 자의를 제거한 방식을 사용하지 만 한자의 ‘자형’을 변형한 구결자를 사용하거나 점이나 선에 해당하는 구결점을 이용하여 한국어를 표기한다는 점에서 향찰과는 차이를 보인다. 특히 종성 표기 문자를 초성의 표기에도 이용한 것, 또 구결점의 형태ㆍ위치와 음운ㆍ문법이 체계적인 대응을 보이는 것은 구결자ㆍ구결점의 대표적인 문자적 특징이다. 이러한 구결자와 구결점의 성립과 전승에는 한국 불교의 뛰어난 학승(學僧)이 큰 역할을 하였음은 부인할 수 없는 사실이다.한글은 조선신록을 통해 세종의 친제임이 명확하게 밝혀져 있다. 다만 최근에 신미대사가 훈민정음의 모음자 창제에 도움을 주었으리라는 주장이 소수 의견으로 등장한 바 있다. 그러나 문자란 창제한 것만큼이나 새로운 문자를 잘 사용하는 일이 중요하다. 바로 신미와 학조 같은 당대의 조선 고승들은 이 역할을 훌륭하게 수행했었다. 창제된 새 문자를 누구보다 능숙하게 사용할 수 있었을 뿐만 아니라 언해 작업에 대대적으로 참여하면서 정서법과 표기법, 어휘의 기본형 설정 등 뛰어난 어학자의 면모를 보인다.지금까지 신라와 고려, 조선시대 승려들은 종교인과 수행자, 또는 정치인이나 문학가, 아니면 의병과 같은 면모만이 부각되어 왔다. 그러나 한국의 승려들에 대해서는 한국의 문자를 발전시킨, 뛰어난 문자 사용자와 전승자로서의 면모에 대해서도 높게 평가받아야 한다.
articles.abstract_en: Even before the creation of Hangul, the Korean had its own characters to represent the Korean language of the time. Typical examples are Hyangchal and Kugyeol. Hyangchal is a writing system that maximizes the efficiency of conveying meaning through a complex system of ideograms and phonograms, and reflects the perception of codas and the consciousness of separating syllables into initial, middle, and final sounds. It was the Buddhist monastic class that was most adept at using this writing system. Kugyeol is a script that not only possesses the stylistic features of Hyangchal, but also evolved to the point where it created a new shape of letters. There are two types of Kugyeol, one using letters and the other using symbols such as dots and lines, and it is clear that the creators of this system were also monks. Meanwhile, after the creation of Hangul in 1443, Koreans now have a new script that can fully express the Korean language without borrowing or modifying Chinese characters. Creating new characters is one thing, but using them well is another. The monks of the Joseon Dynasty played a key role in the development and expansion of the use of these new scripts. So far, the monks of the Shilla, Goryeo, and Joseon dynasties have been emphasized only as religious figures and practitioners, or as visionaries, literary figures, or medics, but they should also be recognized for their role as excellent users of letters, who developed and preserved the Korean writing system.

articles.title_kr: 眞表의 율사로서 위상 정립과 외부 영향
articles.title_en: Establishment of Jinpyo's status as a Vinaya master and external influence
articles.abstract_kr: Jinpyo(眞表) is a Buddhist monk who represents Korean Buddhism along with Jajang(慈藏). If Jajang was a believer in Mañjuśri(文殊), Jinpyo maintained his faith in Maitreya(彌勒). The record that Jinpyo pursued Maitreya Bodhisattva rather than Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva, which appeared first, during his training, makes it clear that his religious color was Maitreya.The influence of Jajang can be felt in Jinpyo's teacher, Master Sunje(順濟法師). Jajang was a high priest who met Mañjuśri Bodhisattva at Mountain Odae(五臺山) in China and received sacred objects such as Buddha's śarīra(舍利) and kaṣāya. However, it is said that Sunje also received the five commandments from Mañjuśri Bodhisattva at Mountain Odae. However, Sunje pursued Maitreya and Kṣitigarbha Bodhisattva instead of Mañjuśri as the object of faith in the changing flow of Buddhism during the Tang Dynasty. This tendency of Sunje exerted a strong influence on his disciple Jinpyo.Jinpyo was directly influenced by Sunje, but at the same time, he was also influenced by Jajang, who can be said to be a model of Silla Buddhist vinaya monks. This can be recognized through the fact that Jinpyo's objects of enlightenment included fish and animals, and that the he received the Buddha's śarīra (or spiritual body) and kaṣāya as well as his pātra(鉢盂). In other words, Jinpyo's framework as a Vinaya master was completed under the influence of Sunje and Jajang.

articles.title_kr: 탈종교시대 청년 대상 방송포교 사례 분석과 그 방향성
articles.title_en: A Study on the Case Analysis of Broadcast Spreading for Young People in the Age of De-religion and Its Direction
articles.abstract_kr: 탈종교시대 한국불교는 청년층에 다가갈 수 있는 방송포교에 주목할 필요성이 있다. 본 연구는 BTN의 청년 불자 대상 방송프로그램 사례와 다양한 종교 지도자들이 고민을 듣고 해결해 주는 프로그램 사례를 분석하였다. 이 사례들은 청년 대상 방송포교의 중요성을 잘 보여준다.또한 대형 도심사찰인 조계사 청년회의 유튜브방송(“불짬뽕”)과 한마음선원의 청년회 내 동아리인 “미디어팀”의 사례를 살펴봄으로써, 청년세대를 대상으로 하는 다양한 방송포교의 중요성뿐 아니라, 이러한 방송포교의 새로운 주체로서의 청년불자의 역할이 중요함을 주장한다. 지속가능한 방송포교 활성화를 위해 사찰뿐 아니라 종단 차원에서 불교와 관련된 콘텐츠를 다루는 청년 유튜브 프로그램 개발이나 다양한 SNS 활용 등을 고려하고 지원할 필요가 있다.
articles.abstract_en: In the age of de-religion, it is essential for Korean Buddhism to focus on broadcasting outreach to connect with younger generations. This study analyzes examples of BTN’s broadcast programs aimed at young Buddhists, as well as programs where various religious leaders listen to and address youth concerns. These cases highlight the significance of broadcasting as a means of outreach to young people. Furthermore, by examining examples, such as the YouTube program “Buljjamppong” by the Jogyesa Youth Association and the “Media Team,” a club within the Hanmaum Seon Center’s Youth Association, this study emphasizes not only the importance of diverse broadcast outreach targeting young people, but also the vital role of young Buddhists as new leaders in this field. For sustainable broadcasting outreach, it is necessary for temples and religious orders to consider and support the development of youth-led Buddhist content on YouTube and the use of various social media platforms.

articles.title_kr: 『지장경』의 業海와 中有 관계에 대한 일고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Relationship between an Intermediate State (中有) and the Sea of Karma (業海) in the Kṣitigarbha-sūtra (地藏經)
articles.abstract_kr: Concepts of an intermediate state (中有, antarābhava) and the sea of karma (業海), which is especially emphasized together with the intermediate state in the Kṣitigarbha-sūtra (地藏經), have been used for explaining the afterlife in Buddhism. Their sapatiotemporal meaings are similar between Sectarial Buddhism and Mahayana Buddhism. An intermediate state is sometimes used as a space that living things go through when moving on to the next life. It acts as a medium to inherit the seeds of karma into the next life as the subject of reincarnation. After the Abhidharmamahāvibhāṣā (阿毘達磨大毗婆沙論) in the thought ideology of the Sarvâstivāda School (說一切有部), the intermediate state is recognized as the subject of reincarnation in connection with the gandharva, the transnational being. However, after the advent of Consciousness-only theory (唯識), the intermediate state connected with the eighth consciousness, ālaya vijñāna (阿賴耶識) is used as a term to mean the meaning of reincarnation and a special space, where living things stay and the space exists in between this life and the next life during reincarnation. The concept of intermediate state is particularly expanded and developed by clearly stating that the period of living things stays here is 49 days. The sea of karma also exists in the middle of death(死有) and birth(生有). It is the place that living things must pass through on their way to hell. However, the sea of karma is a place where evil-living things experience extreme pain. Thus, it has a different spatial concept from the intermediate state. The Consciousness-only school and the Kṣitigarbha-sūtra suggest that living things stay in the intermediate state for 49 days. They possibly can be reborn to another world by the effort of themselves and other people such as family and relatives. Completely understanding the concept of intermediate state and sea of karma can positively guide attendants at the ritual such as a ritual for 49 days to direct the life of ritual attendants.

articles.title_kr: 신뇨엔 제등호마 법요의 현대적 의미 고찰
articles.title_en: A Study on the Modernistic Meaning of Sinnyoen's Saitougomahouyou(斉燈護摩法要)
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 일본의 진언밀교 교단인 신뇨엔(眞如苑)에서 행해지는 제등호마법요(斉燈護摩法要)의 현대적 의미를 알아보기 위한 것이다. 신뇨엔은 1936년 이토신죠가 개창한 종파로서 『대반열반경』을 소의경전으로 대승이타(大乘利他)의 가르침을 설하고 있다. 신뇨엔은 밀교교단이기 때문에 호마의식을 진행한다. 특히 매년 제등호마법요를 통해 호마의식을 거행하는데, 본 연구는 2024년 10월 13일에 신쵸지(眞澄寺) 별원에서 거행된 제등호마법요의 작법절차를 중심으로 의식의 특징과 의미를 중심으로 알아보았다.본 연구에서는 이러한 연구를 진행하기 위해 우선 호마의식을 직접 참관하고 신뇨엔의 제등호마 의식의 절차와 방법을 알아보았다. 신뇨엔의 제등호마는 기존 불교교단의 호마의식의 의례절차와 차이가 있는데, 현대음악을 활용한 점에서 전통을 유지하면서도 독창성을 보여준다. 신뇨엔의 제등호마법요는 의례를 통해 신심을 기른다는 측면에서 사회적인 의미가 있고, 현대의 전법·포교를 위한 방법으로서 의례를 활용할 수 있다는 측면에서 가치가 있다.본 연구는 신뇨엔의 호마의식만을 확인했다는 한계가 있지만, 의례과정을 통해 그 현대적인 의미를 알아보았다는 데에 의미가 있다. 또한 관련한 후속 연구를 통해 동아시아 국가의 호마의식들이 전통의례의 원류를 찾는데 기여할 수 있을 것으로 생각한다.
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the meaning of the Saito Homa rite practiced in Sinnyoen, a Shingon esoteric buddhism in Japan. Sinnyoen is a sect founded by Ito Shinjo in 1936, and he preaches the teachings of Mahayana in the scriptures of  Mahāparinirvāṇa Sūtra. Sinnyoen is an esoteric denomination, it conducts a homa ceremony. In particular, the homa ceremony is held every year through the Saito Homa rite, and this study examined the characteristics and meaning of the ceremony focusing on the Saito Homa rite's ritual process held at Shinchoji annex on October 13, 2024.In this study, in order to conduct such research, the principal researcher first observed the Homa ritual in person and we examined the homa and the procedure and method of Sinnyoen's the Saito Homa ritual. Sinnyoen's the Saito Homa is different from the ritual procedure. of the homa ceremony of the existing Buddhist denomination, and it shows originality while maintaining tradition in terms of utilizing modern music. The Saito Homa rite of Sinnyoen has a social meaning in terms of cultivating devotion through rituals and is valuable in terms of being able to utilize rituals as a method for modern propagation.This study has a limitation that it confirmed only the homa of Sinnyoen, but it is meaningful that it examined the modern meaning through the ritual process. In addition, it is thought that the origin of traditional rituals can be found through the homa ceremony of East Asian countries.

articles.title_kr: 상월결사의 이해와 발전방안 ー종법 제정과 소의경전 채택을 중심으로-
articles.title_en: A Study On The Understanding and Development of Sangwol Association : Focusing on the amendment Low of Jogye order and adopt Sutra of chief textbook.
articles.abstract_kr: 결사는 현재를 성찰하는 것이며, 그 과정에서 현재 상황에 맞는 가능성을 모색하는 일이고, 발전의 방향을 찾아가는 길이다. 본고는 결사의 시작과 전법과정을 밝히고 이해를 넘어서 정법을 오래 머물게 하려는 미래지향적인 염원을 목표 지향점으로 하여 논지를 전개한다. 또한 현대사회에 적합한 결사로서 역할을 위해 패러다임의 전환을 주장하고자 한다. 따라서 본고는 크게 네 가지 면에서 의미를 갖는다. 첫째 탄허스님의 역경불사에 대한 선행 연구자들의 연구 결과를 검토하여 탄허스님의 결사가 전법 역경불사로 이어지듯, 상월결사가 순례에 머물지 않고 청년 대학생 전법교화를 위한 전법결사로 나아감을 보여주는 선언적 모습임을 명확하게 보여준다. 둘째, 본고는 수행 중심의 한국불교가 나아가 전법 중심의 한국불교로 새로운 방향성을 요청하는 간절함을 담아야 한다는 점에 주목하여 ‘108원력문’의 활용 방안을 제안한다. 셋째, 대한불교조계종의 동국역경원의 역경불사에 주목하여 ‘역경위원회법’을 통해 역경불사의 행정적 초석을 갖추었듯이 ‘대학생전법위원회’에 관한 법제정의 필요성을 ‘파라미타청소년협회 육성에 관한령’의 예시를 통해 설명한다. 마지막으로 『화엄경』이 화합과 평등의 의미를 갖고 정혜결사의 소의경전의 역할을 수행했다면, 상월결사는 사부대중의 결사로서 수행과 교화를 위해 유행으로 인도하는 교화설법을 보여주며, 걷기가 다양한 설법 속에 교화행의 모습으로 나오는『법화경』을 소의경전으로 제안한다.
articles.abstract_en: Association is a reflection on the present and, in the process, a search for possibilities suited to the current situation and a way to find a direction for development. This paper clarifies the beginnings of association and the process of propagation, and develops the argument with the goal-oriented point of a future-oriented desire to perpetuate the positive law beyond our understanding.It also argues that a paradigm shift is necessary for the association to serve as an appropriate association for modern society. Thus, this paper makes sense on four major fronts.  Second, this paper focuses on the fact that the practice-oriented Korean Buddhism must include an earnest request for a new direction for the transmission-oriented Korean Buddhism, and through the study of the Seokgil Am, it proposes a way to utilize the "108 wish statement mun". Thirdly, the author focuses on the Dongguk Adversary Buddhist Center of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism, and explains the necessity of legislation on the "University Student Propagation Committee" through the example of the "Decree on the Fostering of Paramita Youth Association," as the administrative foundation stone of the Adversary Buddhist Law was laid through the "Law on the Adversary Committee.Finally, if the Hua Yan Sutra has the meaning of harmony and equality and played the role of a small scripture of the Shonghui association, the Bairen association is viewed as a folk-centered mass association that actively includes the folk masses, and the Sangyue association, as a four-part association, shows teaching preaching that leads to fads for practice and teaching, and walking is one of the teaching practices in the various preaching He argues for the adoption of the Shogi Sutra, citing the example of Kegonyu in the Lotus Sutra, which appears as a figure.

articles.title_kr: 운문문언(雲門文偃)의 생애와 삼구(三句)의 선사상
articles.title_en: Seon Thought in Yunmen's Three Sentences as Reflected in His Recorded Sayings
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문에서는 운문종을 창립한 운문문언의 생애와 그의 개괄적인 선사상, 그리고 대표적인 운문삼구(雲門三句)에 나타난 선사상을 고찰하였다.문언의 생애에 대해서는 운문종을 창립한 까닭에 거의 모든 전등사서와 선종의 문헌에 실려 있다. 그러나 본 논문에서는 문언의 입적 직후에 찬술된 󰡔행록󰡕을 중심으로 문언의 생애를 고찰하였다. 이러한 생애로부터 볼 때, 문언의 선사상은 목주도종(睦州道踪), 설봉의존(雪峰義存), 영수여민(靈樹如敏)의 세 선사를 통하여 형성되었음을 알 수 있다. 그런데 목주도종과 영수여민은 남악계(南岳系)에 속해 있고, 설봉의존은 청원계(靑原系)라고 속해 있어서 문언의 선사상은 남악계와 청원계 두 계통의 사상을 모두 포섭하는 경향이 있음을 짐작할 수 있다.본 논문에서는 운문종의 대표적인 선사상으로 운문삼구를 고찰하였다. 본래 문언이 제창한 삼구는 ‘함개건곤(函蓋乾坤), 목기수량(目機銖兩), 불섭만연(不涉萬緣)’이지만, 후대에 덕산연밀(德山緣密)에 의하여 ‘함개건곤(函蓋乾坤), 절단중류(截斷衆流), 수파축랑(隨波逐浪)’의 삼구로 바꾸었다. 그러나 사실상 언어적 표현이 달라졌을 뿐으로 그 내포된 사상의 취지는 같다고 할 수 있다. 그리고 󰡔오가종지찬요(五家宗旨纂要)󰡕에서 삼구를 임제(臨濟)가 제창한 삼현(三玄), 즉 ‘함개건곤’을 ‘체중현(體中玄)’, ‘절단중류’를 ‘현중현(玄中玄)’, ‘수파축랑’을 ‘구중현(句中玄)’으로 배대하여 설명하고 있다. 이는 삼구에 대한 이해를 심화시켰다고 평가할 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the life and general Seon thought of Yunmen Wenyan, founder of the Yunmen school, as well as the Zen philosophy expressed in his representative "Three Sentences of Yunmen" (雲門三句).While Yunmen's life is recorded in almost all Seon transmission histories and literature due to his founding of the Yunmen school, this paper focuses on examining his life based on the "Biography" (行錄) compiled shortly after his death. From his life, we can see that Yunmen's Seon thought was formed through three Seon masters: Muzhou Daozong, Xuefeng Yicun, and Lingshu Rumin. Notably, Muzhou Daozong and Lingshu Rumin belonged to the Nanyue lineage, while Xuefeng Yicun was from the Qingyuan lineage, suggesting Yunmen's Seon philosophy tended to encompass both schools of thought.This paper examines the "Three Sentences of Yunmen" as representative of the Yunmen school's Seon philosophy. The original three sentences proposed by Yunmen were "HanGaiGanKun" (函蓋乾坤), "MuJiZhuLiang" (目機銖兩), and "BuSheWanYuan" (不涉萬緣). However, these were later modified by Deshan Yuanmi to "HanGaiGanKun" (函蓋乾坤), "JieDuanZhongLiu" (截斷衆流), and "SuiBZhuLang" (隨波逐浪). While the linguistic expressions changed, the underlying philosophical intent remained essentially the same. The "Concise Essentials of the Five Houses" (五家宗旨纂要) further correlates the Three Sentences with Linji's "SanXuan" (三玄): equating "HanGaiGanKun" with the "TiZhongXuan"(體中玄), "JieDuanZhongLiu" with the "XuanZhongXuan"(玄中玄), and "SuiBZhuLang" with the "KouZhongXuan"(句中玄). This can be seen as deepening the understanding of the Three Sentences.
keywords_en: Three Sentences of Yunmen (雲門三句)

articles.title_kr: 매체 활용 불교 커뮤니케이션 확산 방안 : Chat GPT와 대학생 인식 분석을 중심으로
articles.title_en: The direction of spreading Buddhist communication using media based on the perception of university students belonging to Buddhist clubs
articles.abstract_kr: 이 연구는 매체를 활용한 불교 커뮤니케이션 확산 방향을 제시하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 인공지능(Chat GPT) 및 A대학교 불교 동아리 소속 학생 25명을 대상으로 불교에 관한 인식을 조사하여, 이를 기반으로 전법 및 불교의 대중화를 위한 매체 활용 불교 커뮤니케이션 확산 방향을 제안하였다. 인공지능이 분석한 불교 이미지는 대체로 인간 내면 및 예술과 같은 정신적‧감성적 측면이었다. 사람들이 내면 건강을 챙기기 위한 도구로 불교를 활용한다는 점에서 불교가 대중과의 커뮤니케이션에서 긍정적으로 작용할 수 있음을 알 수 있었다. 또한 불교 동아리 소속 대학생은 불교가 사회에 부합하는 정도가 크기 때문에 불교 커뮤니케이션을 위해서 매체를 효과적으로 활용하면 전법을 구현하고 불교에 대한 긍정적 이미지를 높일 수 있다고 인식하였다. 이를 바탕으로 제시한 불교 커뮤니케이션 확산 방향은 총 3가지이다. 첫째, 숏폼형 소셜 미디어인 릴스(인스타그램), 숏츠(유튜브), 틱톡 등의 서비스를 활용하여 다양하면서도 짧고 강렬한 콘텐츠로 불교 노출 빈도를 높여 대중들이 부담 없이 볼 수 있도록 한다. 둘째, 넓은 의미에서는 ‘공간’ 역시 ‘매체’의 한 요소이므로, ‘공간 매체’로서 장소를 활용한 문화적 커뮤니케이션이 되도록 한다. 셋째, 공신력 및 인지도 있는 불교 관련 인물을 활용하여 홍보 활동을 한다.
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to suggest the direction of spreading Buddhist communication using media. To this end, artificial intelligence (Chat GPT) investigated the image of Buddhism, investigated the perception of Buddhism among 25 students from the Buddhist club of University A, and based on this, the direction of spreading Buddhist communication using media for the popularization of tactics and Buddhism was suggested. The images of Buddhism analyzed by artificial intelligence were generally mental and emotional aspects such as human inner and art. It was found that Buddhism can play a positive role in communicating with the public in that people use Buddhism as a tool to take care of their inner health. In addition, university students belonging to Buddhist clubs recognized that since Buddhism has a large degree of conformity with society, effectively using media for Buddhist communication can implement tactics and enhance the positive image of Buddhism. There are a total of three directions for spreading Buddhist communication based on this. First, services such as short-form social media such as Reels (Instagram), Shots (YouTube), and TikTok are used to increase the frequency of Buddhist exposure with diverse, short, and intense content so that the public can see it without burden. Second, since 'space' is also an element of 'media' in a broad sense, cultural communication is made using temples and Buddhist culture experience places as a 'space medium'. Third, public relations activities are carried out by utilizing trusted Buddhist-related figures.

articles.title_kr: 불교 명상을 활용한 자기 성찰적 글쓰기 연구 -성찰 기록문 텍스트를 중심으로-
articles.title_en: The Study of Self-Reflective Writing Utilizing Buddhist Meditation: -Focused on the Text of Reflective Journals-
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 불교 명상과 글쓰기를 활용한 자기 성찰 프로그램이 참여자들의 내면 탐구와 치유 과정에 미치는 영향을 탐색하였다. W. F. Pinar의 자서전적 방법론을 토대로 성찰 과정을 ‘후향→전향→분석→종합’의 네 단계로 나누고, 이를 명상과 글쓰기 프로그램에 적용하여 ‘집’, ‘음식’, ‘옷’, ‘돈’, ‘몸’과 같은 일상적 주제에 대한 성찰 기록문을 텍스트 분석하였다. 그 결과 ‘마음’과 ‘명상’이라는 키워드가 참여자들의 내면 탐색 과정에서 핵심적인 역할을 담당함을 확인하였다.‘마음’은 성찰의 주요 대상이자 과거 경험을 현재로 불러오는 매개체로 작용하였다. 참여자들은 명상을 통해 ‘마음’을 관찰하고, 그 속에 떠오르는 생각과 감정들을 있는 그대로 받아들이는 과정을 경험하였다. 이를 통해 과거의 상처와 트라우마를 마주하고, 부정적인 감정을 해소하며, 자기 이해를 심화시키는 등 내면의 치유와 성장을 이루어 나갔다.본 연구는 불교 명상과 글쓰기의 융합이 개인의 심층적인 자기 성찰과 치유에 효과적인 방법임을 시사한다. 특히, 명상을 통해 얻은 통찰을 글쓰기를 통해 구체화하고 표현하는 과정은 자기 이해를 돕고 긍정적인 변화를 촉진하는 데 기여할 수 있음을 보여준다. 이러한 결과는 명상과 글쓰기의 통합적 활용이 현대인의 자아 성장과 삶의 질 향상에 기여할 수 있는 새로운 가능성을 제시한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study investigated the impact of a self-reflection program that integrates Buddhist meditation and writing on participants' inner exploration and healing process. The research was grounded in W. F. Pinar's autobiographical methodology, which divides the reflective process into four stages: ‘regression → progression → analysis → synthesis’. Applying this framework to the meditation and writing program, we conducted a textual analysis of reflective journals written on everyday topics such as ‘home’, ‘food’, ‘clothes’, ‘money’, and ‘body’. The findings revealed that the keywords ‘mind’ and ‘meditation’ played a crucial role in the participants’ journey of inner exploration.The ‘mind’  served as both the primary object of reflection and a medium for bringing past experiences into the present. Through meditation, participants observed their ‘minds’  and embraced the thoughts and emotions that arose without judgment. This process facilitated inner healing and growth by confronting past wounds and traumas, releasing negative emotions, and deepening self-understanding.The study suggests that the integration of Buddhist meditation and writing is an effective method for profound self-reflection and healing. In particular, the process of articulating and expressing insights gained through meditation through writing can enhance self-understanding and promote positive change. These findings highlight the potential of combining meditation and writing to contribute to self-growth and improve the quality of life for individuals in contemporary society.

articles.title_kr: 해안봉수의 청년 수학기 행적 발굴과 연보 수정
articles.title_en: Excavation of Kim Bong-su's Educational History and Revision of His Chronology
articles.abstract_kr: Haean-Bongsu is a great Buddhist monk from Naeso Temple in Buan, Jeollabuk-do, and is a high priest who left a collection of Korean Buddhist poems, "Sissim Sibul" and "Coastal House". In terms of the climate of the Buddhist community at that time, most high monks wrote Chinese poems on anniversaries such as Sakyamuni's Birthday, but rarely elevated their faith and expressed Buddhist teachings through Korean poetry. Although there were several monk writers who gained fame as poets and literary writers in the 1960s, I think Haean was the only monk who wrote and published poetry in addition to Chinese poetry.Until now, academia has paid little attention to the coast with this meaning. However, it is not very difficult to grasp his life and thoughts because quotes and related data collections have been compiled by Naesosa and Mundo of Jeondeungsa Temple in Seoul.This paper summarized and supplemented the life of the coast according to the existing annals. In particular, the year was judged according to the description that he graduated from Baekyangsa Temple's Gwangseonggangsuk and studied at Peking University through the Buddhist Central Academy, while intensively considering whether it was true. As a result, it was possible to accurately grasp the actual status and completion status of Gwangseonggangsuk. In addition, although there is no certificate or diploma that can prove the history of studying in Central Academy and Beijing, the annual report could be supplemented by discovering the records of coastal activities contained in media reports.The legal context of the coast and the achievements of literary creation were not covered in this paper, but were left as future tasks.
keywords_kr: 광성강숙. 중앙학림. 석전 박한영. 만공 송종헌.
keywords_en: Gwangseong Gangsuk. Central Hakrim. Seokjeon Park Han-young. Mangong Song Jong-heon.

articles.title_kr: 신라시대 불교 초전(初傳)의 시대적 의의
articles.title_en: The Historical Significance of the Introduction of Buddhism in the Silla Period
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines the issue of the transmission of Buddhism in the early Silla period, with particular attention to its historical significance as a latecomer among Korea’s Three Kingdoms. The period under investigation spans approximately 150 years, from the missionary activities of the Goguryeo monk Mukhoja (or Ado) during the reign of King Nulji, to the official recognition of Buddhist practice following the martyrdom of Ichadon during King Beopheung’s reign, and up to the reign of Queen Jindeok.This paper aims to illuminate the spiritual and cultural significance of this early transmission period, emphasizing the pioneering spirit and dynamic development of Buddhist propagation in Silla. Unlike imperial or conquest-driven religious movements in other world histories, Buddhism in ancient Korea―particularly in Silla―faced intense opposition, including persecution and martyrdom. The Silla case thus stands out for the extraordinary hardships endured in the process of Buddhist acceptance.The most compelling aspect of this early phase is the unwavering resolve and practical action of Silla’s early Buddhist missionaries, who risked their lives for the Dharma. Their determination contributed to the remarkable flourishing of Buddhism in Silla compared to its neighboring kingdoms. Despite significant resistance, Buddhism ultimately took root in Silla through the convictions of visionary rulers and the devoted efforts of exceptional monks. Over time, this led to a productive and enduring integration of Buddhist ideals, culminating in the full realization of the “Buddha-land” ideal.The originality and expansive vitality of early Silla Buddhism, as revealed in this period, constitute the core of its historical significance and serve as a valuable model for understanding religious transmission in Korean history.

articles.title_kr: 불교적 관점에서 본 기후위기의 해법 연구
articles.title_en: Studying solutions to the climate crisis from a Buddhist perspective
articles.abstract_kr: 이 연구는 인류가 처한 기후위기와 그 해법을 불교적인 관점으로 제안하는 것을 그 목적으로 한다. 불교에서 기후위기라는 고통의 원인은 탐진치, 삼독으로서 계정혜, 삼학을 닦으면 해결할 수 있다. 이를 통한 연기적 윤리 · 가치관과 실천은 오늘날 환경문제 해결을 위한 대안이 될 수 있다. 불교만 아니라 다른 종교, 정치, 사상, 과학, 철학에서도 기후위기를 진단하고 그 해결 방법을 내놓으라고 한다면 불교와 크게 다르지 않을 것이다. 문제는 이러한 앎과 실제 삶의 현격한 차이다. ‘인간의 탐욕’, ‘경쟁과 대립’, 그리고 ‘세상이 나와 한 생명이라는 것을 망각한 무지, ‘세상의 자원은 무한하다는 어리석음’ 등 이미 자본주의 체제의 산업경제 체재에 중독된 인간에게 탐진치, 삼독은 좀처럼 벗어나기 어려운 습관이다.이러한 기후위기를 극복하기 위해서는 불자가 먼저 나서야 한다. 불교 생태환경에 대한 무지와 그릇된 인식을 전환하고 바른 생태 생활 습관을 들이는 ‘환경교육 불사’, 그리고 붓다가 많은 사람의 이익과 행복을 위해서 전도 선언을 한 것처럼, 불자의 적극적인 대사회적 운동으로 나가야 한다. 무엇보다도 앎과 삶의 간격을 좁히기 위해서는 내 마음과 몸이 세상과 하나가 되도록 하는 생활 속 작은 습관이 필요하다. 하루에 한 번, ‘수행으로 마음을 정화하고’, ‘내 생활 주변의 물자 절약’을 하는 등 하나만이라도 실천하면 환경은 변화할 것이라고 믿는다. 기후위기는 먼 미래를 내다봐야 하는 장기적 환경 사안이다. 자신이 노력한 결과가 당장 눈앞에 나타나지 않더라고 성숙한 자세와 지혜로서 끊임없는 노력이 요구된다.
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to suggest solutions to the climate crisis facing humanity from a Buddhist perspective. In Buddhism, the cause of the suffering of the climate crisis is the Three poison of Tamjinchi (貪瞋痴), which can be solved by practicing the Three studies of gyejeonghye (戒定慧). The ethics, values, and practices of dependent origination through this can be an alternative for solving today’s environmental problems. If we were to diagnose the climate crisis and come up with solutions not only in Buddhism but also in other religions, politics, ideology, science, and philosophy, they would not be much different from Buddhism. The problem is the significant difference between this knowledge and actual life. ‘Human greed’, ‘competition and conflict’, ‘ignorance that forgets that the world is one life with me’, and ‘foolishness that the world’s resources are infinite’, the Three poisons are habits that are difficult to escape for humans who are already addicted to the industrial economic system of the capitalist system.In order to overcome this climate crisis, Buddhists must take the lead. We must change ignorance and wrong perceptions about the Buddhist ecological environment and instill proper ecological living habits through ‘environmental education Buddhist work’, and as the Buddha declared evangelism for the benefit and happiness of many people, we must move forward as an active social movement of Buddhists. Above all, in order to narrow the gap between knowledge and life, we need small habits in our daily lives that make my mind and body one with the world. I believe that if we practice even just one thing, such as ‘purifying my mind through practice’ and ‘saving things around my life’ once a day, the environment will change. The climate crisis is a long-term environmental issue that requires us to look far into the future. Even if the results of our efforts do not appear right away, we must continuously make efforts with a mature attitude and wisdom.

articles.title_kr: 선불교 전통에 근거한 한국불교의 발전적 지향에 대한 고찰
articles.title_en: A study on the developmental direction of Korean Buddhism based on the tradition of Zen Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: The Korean-zen began with importing Chinese-zen in the mid-8th century, but the Korean-zen showed a difference from the Chinese-zen. On the one hand, it is a tradition of Zen and Doctrine, and on the other hand, it is a fusional position.The development of this fusion-zen has reached Jogye-Order today, and it has become the overall appearance of Korean Buddhism as well as zen-thoughts.As a result, the identity of Zen was blurred on the one hand, and on the other hand, it was developed into a comprehensive Buddhist form that combines various beliefs, practices, culture and ideas.The positive aspect is complex, diverse and fusional as a whole Buddhism. However, the negative aspect is that it has lost some of its identity even though he is a zen.Specifically, the following is : First is enlightenment, so-called Buddha-disease, which vaguely pursues enlightenment. Second, they discriminated between Zen and Doctrine, and underestimated Doctrine, which is a Dharma-disease. Third, the result of emphasizing the merit of the exodus is a Monk-disease that ignores the life of the public.At this time, the current situation of Korean-zen or Korean Buddhism became a time when future alternatives are needed. Therefore, it is necessary to have a new strategy for the future as well as the faith of Buddhism itself.In this regard, it is necessary to overcome Buddha-disease with the mind of fusional and flexible bodhisattva, overcome Dharma-disease with fusion between Zen and Doctrine, and overcome Monk-disease with the spirit of leaving.

articles.title_kr: 해안봉수의 중국 유학과 불교혁신운동
articles.title_en: Haean-Bongsu's Study in China and Buddhist Innovation Movement
articles.abstract_kr: 해안봉수(海眼鳳秀, 1901-1974)는 20세기 한국불교사에서 선지식의 면모와 더불어 일제강점기 불교혁신운동 및 교육운동에 헌신한 행동하는 출가수행자였다. 본 연구는 탄신 124주년과 열반 51주기를 맞이하여 그간 주목받지 못했던 1920년대 청년기 활동을 집중 조명하였다. 특히 1923~1924년 북경 유학 경험과 귀국 후 전개한 불교혁신 및 교육운동을 신문 기사와 일본 당국 보고서 등 1차 사료를 활용하여 실증적으로 재구성하였다.해안은 백양사 학림에서 전통 불교교학을, 중앙학림에서 근대 불교학을, 북경대학에서 신학문을 익힌 통합적 학문 이력을 지녔다. 1920년대 초 조선불교청년회 백양지회 문예부 임원과 전국 순회강연단 일원으로 활동하며 청년불교운동에 적극 참여하였다. 1923년 북경대학 유학 중에는 북경불교유학생회 활동에 참여하고 기관지 《황야》 발간에 관여하며 사상·학술·문예 활동을 전개하였다.1924년 귀국 직후 내소사 자장암에 신명야학을 설립하여 문맹퇴치 운동에 나섰고, 1927년에는 해성학원으로 발전시켜 3학급을 운영하며 40여 명의 남녀 학생을 교육하였다. 이는 불교 민중교육의 선구적 사례였다. 1925년 불교개혁을 위해 결성된 철우회에 참여하여 선운사 강연회에서 '조선인의 시대고'를 주제로 "우리가 받는 고통을 각성하여 낙원지로 전진하자"고 강연하며 민족의식 고취와 불교혁신을 연계하였다.1930년대 이후 활동은 사회운동에서 수행과 포교 중심으로 전환되었다. 1927년 내소사 주지 취임, 1935년 순회포교사 활동, 1945년 서래선림 개원, 1969년 불교전등회 창립 등으로 이어지는 후기 활동은 시대적 제약 속에서 불교의 본령을 지키며 민중과의 접점을 유지하려는 노력이었다. 해안의 생애는 참여불교와 수행불교가 대립이 아니라 조화를 이룰 수 있음을 보여주며, 근대 한국불교사에서 전통교학-근대교육-해외유학을 통합한 독특한 학문 이력과 실천적 행보가 지닌 의의를 규명하였다.
articles.abstract_en: Master Haean Bongsu (海眼鳳秀, 1901-1974) was not only a distinguished Seon master in 20th-century Korean Buddhist history but also an actively engaged ordained practitioner who devoted himself to Buddhist reform and educational movements during the Japanese colonial period. This study intensively examines his youth activities in the 1920s, which have not received adequate attention, on the occasion of the 124th anniversary of his birth and the 51st anniversary of his nirvana. In particular, it empirically reconstructs his study abroad experience in Beijing from 1923 to 1924 and the Buddhist reform and educational movements he undertook after returning home, utilizing primary sources such as newspaper articles and Japanese authorities' reports.Master Haean possessed an integrated academic background, studying traditional Buddhist doctrine at Baekyang Temple's seminary, modern Buddhist studies at the Central Buddhist Seminary, and new learning at Peking University. In the early 1920s, he actively participated in the youth Buddhist movement as a literary department officer of the Baekyang branch of the Joseon Buddhist Youth Association and a member of the national lecture tour. During his study at Peking University in 1923, he participated in the activities of the Beijing Buddhist Students Association and engaged in ideological, academic, and literary activities by contributing to the publication of the journal Hwangya (荒野).Immediately after returning home in 1924, he established Sinmyeong Night School at Jajangam of Naeso Temple to launch a literacy campaign. By 1927, he had developed it into Haeseong Academy, operating three classes and educating about 40 male and female students. This was a pioneering case of Buddhist popular education. In 1925, he participated in Cheoluhoe (鐵牛會), formed for Buddhist reform, and gave a lecture on "The Suffering of Koreans in This Era" at a lecture meeting at Seonun Temple, stating "Let us awaken to the suffering we endure and advance toward paradise," thereby linking national consciousness with Buddhist reform. He also participated in the Tenant Farmers' Friendship Association to advocate for tenant farmers' rights.After the 1930s, his activities shifted from social movements to a focus on practice and propagation. His later activities—serving as abbot of Naeso Temple in 1927, working as a traveling dharma teacher in 1935, opening Seorae Seon Forest in 1945, and founding the Buddhist Jeondeung Association in 1969—represented efforts to maintain Buddhism's essence and connection with the people under temporal constraints. Master Haean's life demonstrates that engaged Buddhism and practice-oriented Buddhism are not opposites but can achieve harmony, revealing the significance of his unique academic career integrating traditional Buddhist studies, modern education, and overseas study, as well as his practical endeavors in modern Korean Buddhist history.

articles.title_kr: 신라불교의 初傳과 黨項津을 통한 전개 양상
articles.title_en: The early transmission of Silla Buddhism and its expansion through Danghangjin harbor
articles.abstract_kr: In 553 [14th year of King Jinheung’s reign], Silla secured the militarily important Danghaengseong castle and Danghaengjin harbor. Silla, which secured the sea route, sent envoys to China 39 times from the reign of King Jinheung to the reign of King Taejong Muyeol. Many monks went to China by sea route to study Buddhism and returned. With many Buddhist contents introduced by them, it formed the cornerstone of Silla Buddhism.After the unification of the Three Kingdoms, Danghangjin changed its name to Dangunpo harbor. Even after the unification of the Three Kingdoms, many monks went to China by sea route. Zen practitioners also went to China by sea route. From the late 8th century to the early 10th century, Zen was introduced through Dangunpo harbor. They established nine schools of Zen Buddhism. Seon Buddhism led the Buddhist community in the late Silla period and became a major axis of Korean Buddhism.After King Jinheung secured Danghangjin harbor, all of Silla Buddhism's teachings and Seon Buddhism were introduced through here. In that respect, Danghangjin harbor is the place where the historical transition of Silla Buddhism took place. During the Unified Silla period, it was called Dangunpo harbor. During the Joseon Dynasty, it was called Daejin harbor. This place became Pyeongtaek Port in Gyeonggi Province.
keywords_en: A monk who went to study Buddhism

articles.title_kr: 감정노동자를 위한 차명상(茶冥想) 프로그램 고찰 -불교의 삼학(계·정·혜)을 중심으로-
articles.title_en: A Study of tea meditation program for emotional workers -A focus on Buddhist practice of the three disciplines(戒ㆍ定ㆍ慧)-
articles.abstract_kr: ObjectivesThe purpose of this study is to develop a tea meditation program based on three disciplines, and to verify the effectiveness of the developed program.MethodsAs a qualitative research method, this study examined the tea meditation program, which provides meditative functions according to the composition of three stages of aroma, taste, and sight by recognizing one's own state of mind, allowing one to look inward, and drinking tea. Buddhist practice aims to realize nirvana by recognizing the anguish that occurs in each mind and self-regulating it to reach the state of my mind in a calm state free from suffering. The basis of such Buddhist practice is the three disciplines(三學 The three general aspects of Buddhist practice: of Gye, Jeong, and Hye 戒,定,慧). the three disciplines is Gye of the system, and Sammae is created, wisdom is created through Sammae, and enlightenment is completed by wisdom. The purpose of tea meditation(茶冥想) in this paper is to gain enlightenment and self-reflection, so it aims to enhance its significance as a tea meditation program by promoting mental discipline through the Gye, Jeong, and Hye of three disciplines, a Buddhist practice virtue. From a Buddhist performance perspective, the tea meditation program, which is based on Samhak, is expected to be a tool to be able to live a healthy life by being aware of one's condition while drinking tea in daily life and developing positive self-awareness by separating from mental confusion.Tea prevents internal anxiety and confusion from increasing by stimulating various reactions in terms of smell, taste, and vision. When the mental value of tea is combined with meditation, physical activation and emotional stabilization through drinking tea(飮茶) can be expected together. As a result, subjective well-being (satisfaction of life, positive emotions) and psychological stability required by a healthy organizational culture can be promoted. In particular, the composition of tea is considered to be a good device for use in terms of mind management of emotional workers as it brings a deep state of relaxation and shows the effect of relaxing tension.ConclusionsIt is expected that the tea meditation program based on three disciplines can help emotional workers' mental health and well-being.

articles.title_kr: 해안봉수 선사상의 특징
articles.title_en: Characteristics of Haean Bongsu's Zen Thought
articles.abstract_kr: Haean Bongsu(1901-1974) devoted his entire life to establishing Korean Zen Buddhism in the 20th century. As a Zen master who lived through the Japanese colonial period under harsh conditions alongside the nation's fate, he dedicated his life to the practice of the Buddha Dharma. Haean Bongsu devoted his entire life to revitalizing the Jeondeung Dharma Assembly through the awakening to the lamp of the Dharma, seeking to repay the grace of the Buddha's teachings. His efforts were not in vain; to this day, through the diligent practice of Jeondeungsa Temple, several direct disciples, and devotees, his legacy continues unbroken.Translated with DeepL.com (free version)Haean Bongsu demonstrated exceptional insight as a Zen master, offering outstanding interpretations and lectures on various Zen texts and sutras based on his profound understanding of the scriptures. As a result, materials remain where he personally took notes and lectured on diverse Buddhist texts, including the Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra.Haean Bongsu freely employed numerous koans traditionally transmitted in his daily Dharma talks. He also composed his own verses and wrote prayers, striving to embody the true essence of the koans presented by the patriarchs. For instance, he delivered Dharma talks using the “What is this?”(是甚麽) and numerous other Dharma talks, encouraging the participating assembly to strive diligently. Particularly regarding the “What is this?” Dharma talk, he emphasized the traditional approach, utilizing it as an independent koan. This aspect provides clear guidance on Dharma talks and Dharma talk practice methods within contemporary Kan hwa seon(看話禪) practice of Korea.The Zen thoughts Haean Bongsu revealed in Volume 3 of Haeanjip are well reflected in the Dharma transmission verses(傳法偈) he composed to guide each disciple and lay follower, based on his own personal practice from the moment he first awakened to the Dharma. Based on the Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra's concept of “no fixed dharma,” the vigorous practice demonstrated during intensive meditation sessions at Hanbyeok Seonrim, Seorae Seonrim, Wolmyeong Seonwon, Daewon Seonrim, and Jeondeung Seonwon — involving both monastics and lay practitioners — was also an expression of compassionate teaching rooted in Zen thoughts, as exemplified by Haean Bongsu.

articles.title_kr: 신라불교 초전지 毛禮家와 史國과의 관계 소고
