articles.title_en: A Study on the relationship between the family of Morye(毛禮), where Silla Buddhism was first introduced, and the Shǐguó(史國)
articles.abstract_kr: This article began with the question of where their ancestors came from, focusing on the fact that the surname of Morye(毛禮) who appears in the early history of Silla Buddhism is Sa(史).According to some records of Samguk Yusa and Samguk Sagi, Ado, Mukhoja, and others came to Silla from China and Goguryeo several times to spread Buddhism in Silla.However, although the times at which they came to Silla were different, it is said that they all stayed at the house of the owner of Morye in Dogae-ri, Seonsan, Gyeongbuk Province, and preached.While they were preaching at Morye's house, they were invited to the palace, where they told the king about the uses of the incense brought by the Liang(梁) envoy, and cured the princess's illness.Judging from this, it seems that Morye already knew about Buddhism and had information about the role of monks and Buddhist activities.In the end, Morye's family is recognized as the first lay believers in the history of Silla Buddhism, and in particular, his sister became the first female monk in Silla.Meanwhile, Ilyeon(一然) reveals that their surname is Sa(史). At that time, Silla did not have any special surnames other than those of the royal family, Park(朴), Seok(石), and Kim(金), so it was highly unusual that there was a rare surname like Sa(史), even today.Moreover, the founder of the Sa family in Korea today was a person from the middle to late Goryeo period, so seems to have even less connection to the Morye's family.Here, based on various evidences of East-West trade via the Silk Road in the 4th to 6th centuries, I would like to argue that the Sa surname of Morye's family could be the surname of Shǐguó(史國), one of the surnames of Zhāowŭjiŭxìng(昭武九姓), the most representative state among the 36 countries of the Western Regions(西域).Seonsan was a passageway between Silla and Goguryeo, and because of the nearby Nakdong River, it was a transportation hub since ancient times and was one of the tributaries of the Silk Road.Accordingly, I attempted to investigate the possibility that Morye and his family, who played an important role in the process of Buddhism being introduced to Silla, may have had ties to the Shǐguó(史國).

articles.title_kr: 여산(廬山) 혜원(慧遠)의 법성론(法性論)과 그 사상사적 의의
articles.title_en: The Dharma-nature Theory of LuShan Huiyuan and Its Historical Significance in the History of Thought
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 여산 혜원의 법성론(法性論)과 신불멸론(神不滅論)의 사상을 탐구하고, 그 사상사적 의의를 고찰함을 목적으로 한다. 혜원은 서진(西晉)에서 동진(東晉)･십육국(十六國) 시대에 활동하였으며, 동진(東晉)의 대표적인 고승(高僧)이다. 본 논문에서는 혜원의 생애와 중국불교에 대한 중요한 공헌을 남방에서 불교를 황권으로부터 분리한 정교분리를 실현한 점과 동아시아 불교에서 최초로 결사를 건립했다는 점, 그리고 수많은 경전을 수집하고 번역하였으며, 다양한 저술을 찬술하여 당시 장안이나 낙양 등의 북방에 비교하여 뒤처진 불교학의 수준을 제고시켰다는 세 가지 측면에서 논하였다.혜원의 사상은 주로 아비담(阿毗曇) 논서와 당시 시대적 주류였던 현학(玄學)의 사상을 결합하여 형성되었는데, 그 대표적인 사상이 바로 ‘법성론’이다. 혜원은 불교의 궁극적인 경계를 법성(法性)으로 파악하였으며, 이로부터 ‘신불멸론’을 제창하였다. 나아가 불교의 열반(涅槃)을 ‘신’이 고요한 상태에서 외부의 경계를 끊는 ‘명신절경(冥神絕境)’으로 규정하고 있음을 볼 수 있다. 이러한 법성론과 신불멸론의 관점은 현학의 사상과 결합한 오류이지만, 이후 중국불교의 불성론 전개에 거대한 영향을 미치게 되었다. 그러나 혜원의 말년에 구마라집(鳩摩羅什)이 번역한 󰡔대지도론(大智度論)󰡕을 통해 법성론의 관점이 변화되었음을 발견할 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to explore the philosophical foundations of Huiyuan's Dharma-nature Theory (法性論) and The Theory of the Immortality of the Soul (神不滅論) while examining their historical significance in the history of thought. Huiyuan, an eminent monk of the Eastern Jin (東晉) period, was active during the Western Jin (西晉), Eastern Jin (東晉), and Sixteen Kingdoms (十六國) eras. As a leading figure of the Eastern Jin, Huiyuan made significant contributions to Chinese Buddhism, which this paper analyzes through three key aspects: first, his achievement in realizing the separation of religion and state power, thus distancing Buddhism from imperial authority in the southern regions; second, his establishment of the first Buddhist community in East Asia; and third, his extensive collection, translation, and authorship of Buddhist texts, which elevated the intellectual level of Buddhist studies in the south, particularly in comparison to the more advanced northern centers like Chang'an and Luoyang.Huiyuan's philosophy primarily merged the principles of Abhidharma (阿毗曇) with the prevailing Xuanxue (玄學) thought of the time, giving rise to his representative theory, the Dharma-nature Theory. Huiyuan identified the ultimate boundary of Buddhism as Dharma-nature (法性) and, from this understanding, advocated The Theory of the Immortality of the Soul. Furthermore, he interpreted Buddhist nirvana (涅槃) as Ming-shen-jue-jing (冥神絕境), a state in which the "spirit" (神) remains tranquil while severing connections to external conditions. Although this perspective reflects an integration of Buddhist thought with Xuanxue, it nonetheless had a profound influence on the later development of the Buddha-nature theories within Chinese Buddhism. However, in Huiyuan's later years, the translation of the Mahāprajñāpāramitā Śāstra (大智度論) by Kumārajīva (鳩摩羅什) marked a transformation in his understanding of the Dharma-nature Theory, revealing a shift in his philosophical viewpoint.

articles.title_kr: 개산조開山祖 연기와 화엄사의 통합적 가치 - 화엄사의 창건 배경을 중심으로 -
articles.title_en: The Integrated Value of the Hwaeomsa and its Founder Yeongi(緣起) - Focusing on the Background of Hwaeomsa’s Founding -
articles.abstract_kr: The Hwaeomsa is a representative Hwaeom temple in the Honam region, established by Yeongi in the 8th century. However, during the Japanese invasions of Korea (Imjin War), the temple was completely destroyed due to the activities of Buddhist monk-soldiers centered at Hwaeomsa, and its related records were also lost. As a result, it is fairly difficult to identify the true historical figure of Yeongi, the temple's founder. In particular, the Chronicle of Hwaeomsa(華嚴寺事蹟) compiled in 1630 by Haean was intermixed with the Chronicle of Bulguksa(佛國寺事蹟), leading us to confusion. Consequently, the studies on Yeongi and the origin of Hwaeomsa have only been limited up to now.This study seeks to clarify the confusion surrounding the name “Yeongi” and argues that his ideological background was related to the Hwaeom tradition of the Jajang lineage, which had been transmitted to Hwangnyongsa in the 8th century. This stands in contrast to the idea that the Hwaeom tradition of Uisang and his disciples was not connected to Hwangnyongsa but deeply involved in the founding of Bulguksa. In summary, the Hwaeom Buddhism prevalent in the capital city of Gyeongju in the 8th century appears to have been divided as follows:And, it is also clear that, like Bulguksa, Hwaeomsa was a representative temple in the former Baekje territory founded to foster the spiritual unification and harmony of the peoples of the Three Kingdoms after the unification.

articles.title_kr: 백제·신라불교 초전지를 원천으로 한 문화콘텐츠 구상의 방향성 검토
articles.title_en: A Study on the Direction of culture contents initiative based on the first place of Baekje and Silla Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 백제 불교 초전지인 영광 법성포 일원과 신라 불교 초전지인 구미 도개면 일대가 지닌 역사적, 문화적, 불교적 자산을 현대의 지역 활성화에 연결할 문화콘텐츠 개발의 방향성을 검토하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 최근 심화되고 있는 비수도권 지역의 소멸 위기 극복을 위해, 오랜 전통을 가진 불교 유산과 각 지역의 고유한 특색을 연계한 문화콘텐츠의 기획 및 실천이 필수적이다. 특히, 역사적 사실의 고증에 머무르지 않고, 현재의 삶을 풍요롭게 하는 구체적 경험과 감성을 제공하는 콘텐츠 개발이 필요함을 역설한다.최근 불교는 '힙불교'라는 신조어의 등장과 함께 젊은 세대에게 높은 호응을 얻고 있으며, 이는 현대 사회의 경쟁 스트레스에 지친 대중에게 위로와 공감을 주는 불교의 포용적 메시지가 주효했기 때문으로 분석된다. 한국리서치의 '2024년 종교인식조사'에서 불교는 주요 종교 중 유일하게 '보통 이상'의 호감도를 기록하며 대중적 수용성을 입증했다.국제불교박람회 및 '힙불교' 유행은 종교적 권위를 벗고 청년 문화와 결합한 콘텐츠 구성은 불교가 고유성을 유지하면서도 최신 감성에 부합할 수 있음을 보여주었다.템플스테이는 2002년 이후 한국 전통문화 체험형 콘텐츠의 대표 주자로 자리 잡았으며, 사찰의 수행 정신과 일상을 체험하는 장을 제공하며 644만 명 이상의 누적 방문자를 기록했다.문화콘텐츠의 실효적 작동을 위해서는 향유자의 동기를 간과해서는 안 된다. 유형문화유적 방문의 주된 동기는 문화유산에 대한 지식 습득이나 역사적 고증이 아닌, '여행 중 방문'이 압도적 다수를 차지한다. 이는 대중이 문화유산을 일상 탈출과 여가, 여행의 맥락에서 소비하려 함을 시사한다.따라서 불교 초전지 관련 문화콘텐츠는 단순히 역사적 의미나 정보를 전달하는 데 그치지 않고, 지역성과 불교의 자산을 바탕으로 다양한 '재미의 요소'를 구체적으로 기획하고 형상화해야 한다. 많은 사람이 재미를 체험하고, 공감하며, 공유하려는 자발적인 움직임을 끌어내면 비로소 불교초전지 문화콘텐츠는 지역 활성화에 기여하는 실효적인 콘텐츠로 작동할 것이다.
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to examine the direction of the development of culture contents that will connect the historical, cultural, and Buddhist assets of the the first place of Baekje and Silla Buddhism to revitalize the modern region. it is essential to plan and practice cultural contents that link Buddhist heritage with the unique characteristics of each region.Recently, Buddhism has been highly popular with the younger generation with the emergence of the new word "hip Buddhism," Buddhism was the major religion that recorded "abnormal" favorability and proved its public acceptance.International Buddhist fairs and 'hip Buddhism' trends showed that Buddhism can maintain its uniqueness. ‘Temple Stay’ has been a representative of Korean traditional culture experience-type content since 2002.For the effective operation of culture contents, the motives of the enjoyers should not be overlooked. The main motive for visiting tangible cultural sites is not the acquisition of knowledge about cultural heritage or historical evidence, but the overwhelming majority of 'visit during travel'. This suggests that the public is trying to consume cultural heritage in the context of daily escape, leisure, and travel.Therefore, cultural contents related to Buddhist elementary school should not only convey historical meaning or information, but also plan and embody various ‘fun elements’ based on locality and Buddhist assets.
keywords_en: The first place of Baekje and Silla Buddhism
The link between Buddhism and the region

articles.title_kr: ‘불교계 인물의 글쓰기 연구’에 대한 종합적 고찰과 교육에의 시사점
articles.title_en: Comprehensive Review of Studies on the Writings of Buddhist Figures and Their Educational Implications
articles.abstract_kr: This study aims to provide educational implications for modern writing education by comprehensively reviewing previous studies on the writings of Buddhist figures and analyzing their patterns and characteristics. As a research method, 28 relevant papers published between 2000 and 2024 were selected through literature analysis and examined according to year, academic field, historical period, writing subject, and genre. The analysis revealed that the writings of Buddhist figures have diversified over time in terms of subject and genre. These writings can be categorized into types such as Hwajaeng(和諍) writing, writing as balance and Iryujunghaeng(異類中行), writing as social practice, writing oriented toward the public and organically connected, writing utilizing various persuasive strategies, and writing aimed at editing and the realization of Mua(無我). These types can be linked to educational tasks such as writing that fosters integrated thinking, socially engaged writing, writing for communication with the public, and writing for self-reflection and practice. Based on this, the study proposes writing tasks suitable for elementary, middle, and high school levels. This research is significant in that it suggests the potential of applying the philosophical and practical values inherent in the writings of Buddhist figures to contemporary education.

articles.title_kr: 범패수행의 심신치유와 활용방안에 관한 고찰
articles.title_en: Exploring the Mind-Body Healing Effects of Beompae Practice and Suggestions for Its Contemporary Applications
articles.abstract_kr: This study explores practical applications of Beompae, a traditional Buddhist ritual chant, as a method for mind-body healing in modern society. Beompae is considered to possess medical, meditative, and therapeutic musical functions. However, as scientific data from clinical trials specifically confirming the mind-body healing effects of Beompae practice are currently lacking, this paper reviews scientifically verified foreign studies on the psychosomatic healing effects of religious music to examine the functions of Beompae for mind-body healing. Beompae’s melodies, structured around vowel sounds, generate unique frequencies that resonate with the body, thereby contributing to the resolution of energy imbalances, tension relief, and mental stabilization. Furthermore, Beompae incorporates breath regulation techniques (Jigwanbeop) and is accompanied by traditional instruments (Beopgu), creating an ideal environment for meditative practice and therapeutic music applications.As Beompae embodies mind-body healing mechanisms, its therapeutic effects could be enhanced by incorporating it into various program developments. Accordingly, this study proposes three practical applications for Beompae. First, Beompae can be recorded and rearranged into instrumental tracks by adding instruments and sound effects as needed, in order to produce and distribute audio content for meditation, relaxation, and healing. Second, Beompae can be combined with practices such as Om chanting or singing bowl therapy, along with traditional accompanying instruments (Beopgu), to develop healing music that amplifies resonant energy. Third, educational programs can be offered to Buddhist practitioners to learn Beompae, enabling them to perform vocal offerings during various rituals and ceremonies held at temples. With further development and implementation of diverse programs, Beompae could serve as a valuable tool for mind-body healing in modern society, extending its role beyond that of a mere religious ritual.

articles.title_kr: 성철의 태고법통설이 지닌 불교사적 연원  -『한국불교의 법맥』을 중심으로-
articles.title_en: The Buddhist historical origins of Seongcheol's theory of the Taego Legitimate -Focusing on 《The lineage of Korean Buddhism》-
articles.abstract_kr: Ven. Toe-ong Seongcheol's(退翁性澈) theory of Korean Buddhist dharma lineage clarified the identity of modern Korean Buddhism. This was against the principles established by Cheongheo Hyujeong and his disciples. The incident began when  Taego Order put forward Taego Bowu as its founder. Lee Jong-wook(李種郁) and Lee Bul-hwa(李佛化) were at the center and Jinul was promoted to the position of patriarch. the debate over who would become the founder, but the controversy over who would become the founder, which began during the Japanese colonial period, continued until the 1970s, and its aftershocks still remain today. Seongcheol worked hard to reform Korean Buddhism after liberation, but he actively responded to the issues of Buddhist Lineage and the founder of the Jogye Order by writing about them. He recognized the principles and traditions of continuing the lineage of teacher and disciple as principles. Seongcheol held the position that the approval and transmission of enlightenment was achieved through direct dialogue between teacher and disciple. Seongcheol also held a strong position that the fusion of Seonhak and Gyohak was far from the pure orthodoxy of Seon. Although the issue of dharma Lineage is still unresolved in Korean Buddhism, Seongcheol's argument is strongly persuasive because it is based on tradition.

articles.title_kr: 탈종교화시대, 관음종의 사회적 실천: 말세의식과 공생적 이타행
articles.title_en: The Age of Secularization, Eschatological Consciousness, and the Practice of Altruistic Coexistence: With a Focus on the Gwaneum Order
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines the gravity of secularization while also exploring the social practices, characteristics, and origins of the Gwaneum Order in the age of secularization. The Gwaneum Order is a Buddhist sect that actively engages in social practice and is committed to proactive engagement. Its practical orientation ranges from a broad focus on the state, society, and the Buddhist community to a narrower emphasis on the Mahāyāna ideal of salvation for the people. In the present day, the order concentrates on humanitarian relief efforts for marginalized communities, both domestically and internationally, as well as on global environmental initiatives such as addressing the climate crisis.The religious trajectory of the Gwaneum Order is rooted in the eschatological consciousness(mòshì yìshí, 末世意識) of Taixu(太虛), which served as the foundation for the order’s establishment and its commitment to social practices aimed at the salvation of the state, nation, and people. This proactive engagement has likely played a significant role in the expansion and sustenance of the order. The influence of Taixu’s eschatological consciousness and social practice was examined through the concept of the Dharma-Ending Age(mòfǎ, 末法) as expressed in the socially engaged Buddhist practices of Xinxing(信行) and the Three Stages Sect(Sānjièjiào, 三階教) in Chinese Buddhist history.Finally, this study suggests that to counteract the effects of secularization, it is necessary to explore forms of social practice that can attract the religious interest of the MZ generation.

articles.title_kr: 템플스테이 홍보 콘텐츠의 담론 구성과 전법 전략 - 웹사이트 및 영상 콘텐츠를 중심으로
articles.title_en: Discourse Construction and Dharma Dissemination Strategies in Templestay Promotional Content : Focusing on Websites and Video Media
articles.abstract_kr: This study examines how modern Buddhist propagation strategies are being reconstructed at the intersection of practice and consumption by analyzing the linguistic and visual discourses presented on the official Temple Stay website and its promotional video content. The analysis focuses on introductory phrases, program descriptions, reviews, poster images from the Temple Stay website, and video materials from its official YouTube channel. The linguistic discourse reveals that lyrical expressions such as ‘rest,’ ‘healing,’ and ‘emptiness’ transform Buddhist practice into a discourse of psychological healing, while the visual discourse highlights how images of nature, temples, and individuals sensibly convey the temporality and emotional atmosphere of practice. These linguistic and visual strategies contribute to the popularization of traditional Buddhist practice but also reflect its limitation in converging into emotional consumption rather than preserving the depth of practice. This paper analyzes Temple Stay content as a modern discourse of propagation situated at the intersection of spiritual experience and marketing strategies, emphasizing the need to explore new modes of communication while maintaining the essence of Buddhist practice and the original intent of propagation.

articles.title_kr: 중국불교 정토종과 선종의 신행(信行) 관계 고찰: 이론적 구조와 통합 가능성을 중심으로
articles.title_en: A Study on the Faith-Practice Relationship between the Pure Land and Chan Schools in Chinese Buddhism: Focusing on Theoretical Structures and the Possibility of Integration
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 중국 불교의 주요 두 종파인 정토종과 선종을 대상으로 하여, 두 종파의 신(信)과 행(行)에 대한 이론적 구조와 상호 관계를 고찰하였다. 불교 수행에서 신이란 궁극적 진리에 대한 믿음을, 행이란 그 믿음을 기반으로 이루어지는 실천적 수행을 의미한다. 정토종은 아미타불의 본원력에 대한 절대적인 신심을 바탕으로 염불 수행을 통해 극락왕생을 추구하고, 선종은 자성 본심에 대한 확고한 믿음을 바탕으로 좌선과 참선 수행을 통해 현생에서 깨달음을 이루고자 한다.겉으로 보기에 정토종과 선종은 신앙의 내용과 수행 방식에서 뚜렷한 차이가 있지만, 실제로는 신과 행이 상호 의존적이며 서로 촉진하는 관계를 형성한다. 본 논문은 정토종의 난신이행(難信易行)과 선종의 이신난행(易信難行)이라는 구조를 심도 있게 비교 분석함으로써, 두 종파가 수행의 이론과 실제에서 깊은 상호 보완적 관계를 맺고 있음을 밝혔다.이러한 분석을 토대로 본 연구는 정토종과 선종의 신행 관계가 현대 사회에 적합한 통합적 수행 모델로서 발전할 가능성을 탐구하였다. 즉, 두 종파가 각각의 특성을 유지하면서도 신심과 수행의 실천적 융합을 추구하는 방향을 제안한 것이다. 이러한 통합적 접근은 현대 수행자의 다양한 요구를 충족시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 현대 사회에서 불교의 전파와 실천을 위한 새로운 방법과 방향을 제시할 것으로 기대한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the theoretical structure and interrelationship of faith (信) and practice (行) in the two major schools of Chinese Buddhism: the Pure Land School and the Chan School. In Buddhist practice, faith refers to belief in ultimate truth, while practice signifies the practical discipline based on that faith. The Pure Land School pursues rebirth in the Western Pure Land through the practice of nianfo (reciting Amitābha Buddha”s name), grounded in absolute faith in Amitābha”s original vow power. In contrast, the Chan School aims to attain enlightenment in this very life through seated meditation (zazen) and introspection, based on unwavering trust in one”s intrinsic Buddha-nature.At first glance, the two schools differ significantly in their content of faith and modes of practice. However, in reality, faith and practice form a mutually dependent and reinforcing relationship in both traditions. This paper conducts an in-depth comparative analysis of the structural characteristics—namely, the “difficult faith, easy practice” (nanxin yixing) of the Pure Land School and the “easy faith, difficult practice” (yixin nanxing) of the Chan School—revealing a deeply complementary relationship between the two in both theory and practice.Based on this analysis, the study explores the possibility of developing an integrative practice model suitable for contemporary society by synthesizing the strengths of both traditions. It proposes a direction wherein each school retains its distinct characteristics while seeking a practical convergence of faith and practice. Such an integrative approach not only meets the diverse needs of modern practitioners but also offers new methods and directions for the propagation and application of Buddhism in today”s world.

articles.title_kr: 한국의 힙불교 시대, 여성 재가불자의 새로운 역할과 리더십
articles.title_en: Redefining Lay Buddhist Women's Role and Leadership in Korea's Hip Buddhist Era
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 ‘힙불교’라는 현대적 흐름 속에서 여성 재가불자들의 새로운 역할과 리더십을 제안한 것이다. 이에 여성 재가불자들의 8가지 역할과 5가지 리더십을 제안하였다.먼저 8가지 내용은 ‘디지털 시대에 새로운 기술과 플랫폼 활용 강화, 평화와 화합의 촉진자, 지역 사회와의 연계를 통한 커뮤니티 구축, 마음챙김과 명상 확산, 교육자로서의 역할 수행, 문화예술을 통한 불교가치 강화, 글로벌 네트워크를 통한 국제적 교류, 정책 제안 및 사회참여를 통한 제도적 변화추구’를 말하는 것으로, 여성 재가불자들의 새로운 역할을 강조하였다.이에 5가지 리더십으로, 첫째 창의적 소통 리더십을 제안하였다. 디지털 기술과 현대 미디어를 활용하여 불교 가르침을 대중에게 쉽게 전달하는 역할을 하는 것을 말한다. 이런 창의적인 소통 방식은 젊은 세대가 불교를 더 친숙하게 느끼도록 돕고, 불교의 가르침을 현대 사회의 문제 해결에 맞춰 재구성하는 데 기여한다. 둘째 포용적 리더십이다. 불교의 자비와 평등의 가치를 현대적 시각에서 재구성하여 다양한 사람들을 포용하는 역할을 말한다. 현대 사회의 다양한 문제와 이슈를 해결하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다. 셋째 커뮤니티 기반 리더십은 지역 사회와의 긴밀한 연결을 통해 공동체 문제 해결과 발전을 이끄는 역할을 한다. 이러한 활동은 지역 공동체 내에서 불교의 신뢰를 형성하고, 공동체와의 연대를 강화하는 데 중요한 역할을 한다. 넷째 심리적 및 정신적 치유 리더십은 현대인의 스트레스와 불안을 줄이고, 정신 건강 문제를 해결하는 데 초점을 맞춘다. 이러한 프로그램은 개인의 내적 안정을 지원하며, 공동체 전반에 긍정적인 영향을 미친다. 다섯째, 현대적 교육 리더십은 전통적인 불교 철학과 가르침을 현대적 맥락에 맞게 재해석하여 대중에게 효과적으로 전달하기 위한 것이다.이 논문은 힙불교 시대에 여성 재가불자의 현대적 역할과 리더십에 대한 재고가 필요함을 확인하고, 이를 위한 대안을 제안하며, 불교가 지속 가능한 종교로 자리매김할 수 있는 기반 마련에 기여할 수 있다는 점에서 시사성이 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new role and leadership of lay Buddhist women in the modern trend of ‘Hip Buddhism’. Therefore, he proposed eight roles and five leadership styles for lay women.The first eight points emphasized the new role of lay Buddhists by saying, "Strengthening the use of new technologies and platforms in the digital age, promoting peace and harmony, building communities through connection with local communities, spreading mindfulness and meditation, fulfilling the role of educators, strengthening Buddhist values through culture and arts, international exchange through global networks, and pursuing institutional change through policy proposals and social participation."Therefore, we proposed five types of leadership, first, creative communication leadership. It refers to the role of using digital technology and modern media to easily convey Buddhist teachings to the public. This creative way of communicating helps the younger generation feel more familiar with Buddhism and contributes to restructuring Buddhist teachings to meet the problems of modern society. Second, inclusive leadership. It refers to the role of embracing diverse people by reconstructing the values of compassion and equality in Buddhism from a modern perspective. It plays an important role in solving various problems and issues in modern society. Third, community-based leadership plays a role in solving community problems and leading development through close connection with the local community. These activities play an important role in building trust in Buddhism within local communities and strengthening solidarity with them. Fourth, psychological and spiritual healing leadership focuses on reducing stress and anxiety and addressing mental health issues. These programs support the inner stability of individuals and have a positive impact on the community as a whole. Fifth, modern educational leadership is intended to reinterpret traditional Buddhist philosophies and teachings in a contemporary context and effectively convey them to the public.This paper confirms the need to reconsider the modern role and leadership of lay Buddhist women in the era of hip Buddhism, proposes alternatives for this, and lays the foundation for Buddhism to establish itself as a sustainable religion.

articles.title_kr: 한국불교의 다비(茶毘) 현황과 발전방안
articles.title_en: The Current Status and Development of Cremation in Korean Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: Cremation in Korean Buddhism has a history of approximately 2,500 years, dating back to the parinirvana of Buddha (545 BC), and was introduced as a new funeral rite during the Three Kingdoms Period. It has a history and tradition of approximately 1,500 years.In Korean Buddhism, the cremation refers, in its narrow sense, to the simple act of cremating the body. Still, in its broader sense, it encompasses the entire funeral process and rituals, including the mortuary solemnity, the preparation of the funeral hall, entombment, carry the coffin, the creation of paper flowers, the solemnity of the coffin and funeral paraphernalia, buddhist hymns, large scroll painting, buddhist dancing (cymbal dance), temple food, the solemnity of cremation platform, chanting, and cremation tools.The six narrowly defined cremation methods that have been passed down in Korean Buddhism to the present day are practiced at six temples: Beomeosa Temple in Busan, Bongseonsa Temple in Namyangju-si, Baegyangsa Temple in Jangseong-gun, Seonamsa Temple in Suncheon-si, Sudeoksa Temple in Yesan-gun, and Haeinsa Temple in Hapcheon-gun.One of the distinctive features of the narrowly defined cremation ritual currently practiced is that it applies the principle of the ondol heating system to the cremation. Therefore, by placing a Gudeuljang and constructing a chimney, the space can also be used as an ondol room. Second, the use of straw (such as straw ropes or straw bundles) as the material for the cremation is also unique. In other words, the fact that straw, a material easily obtainable in the surrounding area in the past, makes Korea Buddhism's cremation ceremony a unique intangible cultural heritage found only in the Republic of Korea. As such, it holds significant cultural, historical, and academic value.Additionally, cremation is not merely a ritual for disposing of the body, but also embodies a culture that respects life and shows consideration for others through its ceremonial aspects. In other words, the cremation ceremony offers an indirect experience of death and provides education about it, thereby helping people recognize the preciousness and dignity of life. Therefore, the establishment of a cremation culture could help reduce the life-related incidents that occur continuously in our society.However, the narrowly defined cremation method passed down in Korean Buddhism is facing a severe crisis that could lead to its extinction. The reason for this is that among the six cremation methods currently being passed down, the monks who are passing on the tradition are aging, and the number of monks who wish to learn the tradition is gradually decreasing. Such issues stem from a lack of understanding and negative perceptions regarding cremation. Therefore, what must be prioritized is a shift in perception within the Sangha to recognize that cremation is a valuable cultural heritage, and the preparation and conduct of cremation are also precious practices that not everyone can undertake, just as practicing Zen meditation in the Sangha is essential.Additionally, to revitalize traditional cremation practices, it is first necessary to establish a department dedicated to traditional cremation studies within Dongguk University. This will ensure the participation of monks, laypeople, and the general public in cremation practices and secure successors for traditional cremation rituals. Second, it is worth considering the establishment and operation of a department within the Jogye Executive Director of Administration to manage cremation practices directly. Third, it is necessary to establish a system that provides various cremation support funds and scholarships to monks and their successors who inherit traditional cremation practices. Fourth, to reduce cremation costs, monks should perform cremation directly. Fifth, to shorten cremation time, the optimal amount of materials should be used, and eco-friendly cremation materials should be employed. Sixth, as part of monk welfare, establishing and operating a Cremation Ritual Support Association under the Jogye Order or as an independent institution is another option.From now on, the task that must be addressed in cremation is the need for safe and environmentally friendly methods that do not cause pollution, particularly during severe weather conditions such as typhoons, heavy rain, heavy snow, and strong winds. One such proposal is to establish a new cremation site in the form of a kiln. By utilizing this method, first, cremation can be safely conducted even during adverse weather conditions such as typhoons, heavy snow, or heavy rain. Second, the kiln-shaped structure allows for higher temperatures in the furnace, enabling complete combustion. Third, it can help prevent the generation and emission of environmental pollutants to some extent. Additionally, it is necessary to research and develop methods for distinguishing between monks and laypeople during cremation, as well as studies on cremation rituals, funeral supplies, and tools related to cremation.

articles.title_kr: RHS(Recovering Human Spirit)와 만다라 명상 미술 치료의  통합프로그램에 관한 고찰
articles.title_en: A Consideration of an Integrated Program Combining Recovering Human Spirit(RHS) and Mandala Meditation Art Therapy
articles.abstract_kr: 본 연구는 불교의 육도윤회 개념을 심리 치유 관점에서 재해석한 RHS(Recovering Human Spirit)프로그램과 만다라 명상 미술치료 프로그램을 통합하여 새로운 심리 치유 프로그램을 개발하는 데 목적이 있다. 이 통합프로그램은 현대 사회에서 개인들이 겪는 우울, 불안, 자기 상실 등의 정신건강 문제를 명상과 예술 치유적 접근으로 자기 인식, 상징적 자기표현, 자아 통합의 세 가지 축을 중심으로 기획하였다.널리 알려진 RHS 프로그램은 불교의 수행 전통 중 육도윤회의 상징을 활용하여 인간 내면의 정서적 구조와 고통의 근원을 자각하고 치유를 유도하는 실천적 수행 모델이다. 반면, 만다라 명상 미술치료는 상징적 이미지와 창작 활동을 통해 무의식을 시각화하고 자아 통합과 감정조절을 촉진하는 예술 치유적 접근이다. 본 통합 프로그램은 RHS 인식의 흐름(자각-수용-의미화)과 만다라의 표현적 흐름(상징화-중심화-통합)을 결합하여 심리‧정서‧영적 회복을 제시하고자 하였다.이 통합 프로그램은 총 8회기로 구성되었고, 회기별로 명상, 감정 탐색, 상징화 된 미술 작업을 병행하였다. 참가자들은 ‘육도윤회 의 개념을 주제로 감정을 인식하고, 관련 만다라 작업을 통해 자기 자각과 통찰, 자기연민을 경험하게 된다. 이 프로그램은 임상적 유연성과 예술적 몰입을 바탕으로 현대인의 정신 건강 회복과 자아 성찰을 위해 효과적으로 활용하고자 설계하였다.   향후 연구에서는 집단 상담 및 교육 현장, 정신 건강 클리닉 등 다양한 영역에서 맞춤형으로 적용될 수 있으며, 심리학, 불교 상담학, 미술치료 간의 융합적 연구로서 학문적 및 실천적 가치를 제시하고자 한다.
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the development and analysis of a new integrative psychological healing program by combining the RHS (Recovering Human Spirit) program—which reinterprets the Buddhist concept of the Wheel of Six Realms from a psychological healing perspective—with mandala meditation-based art therapy. The program is designed to address modern mental health challenges such as depression, anxiety, and loss of self by focusing on three core dimensions: self-awareness, symbolic self-expression, and ego integration.The RHS program is a practical meditative model that draws on the symbolism of the Wheel of Six Realms, a traditional Buddhist concept, to foster awareness of emotional structures and the roots of human suffering. In contrast, mandala meditation art therapy visualizes the unconscious through symbolic imagery and creative activity, promoting emotional regulation and ego integration through an art-based healing approach.The integrated program proposes a model of psychological, emotional, and spiritual recovery by combining the RHS's flow of awareness (awareness–acceptance–meaning-making) with the expressive flow of mandala therapy (symbolization–centralization–integration). The program consists of eight sessions, each involving meditation, emotional exploration, and symbolic art-making. Participants reflect on their emotions through the thematic lens of the Wheel of Six Realms, engaging in mandala creation to facilitate self-awareness, insight, and self-compassion.Designed for clinical adaptability and artistic immersion, this program aims to support self-reflection and mental well-being in contemporary individuals. It is envisioned for application across diverse settings, including group counseling, educational environments, and mental health clinics. As an interdisciplinary approach bridging psychology, Buddhist counseling, and art therapy, this study offers both academic insight and practical value.

articles.title_kr: 인공지능 보살의 가능성 연구 – 대승불교의 번뇌 진사혹(塵沙惑)을 중심으로
articles.title_en: A study on the Potencial of an AI bodhisattva: Focusing on Jinsahok(塵沙惑), the Defilements in Māhāyana Buddhism
articles.abstract_kr: 본 고에서는 인공지능 보살의 가능성에 대해서 진사혹(塵沙惑)을 중심으로 접근한다. 진사혹은 먼지, 모래와 같이 많은 일들을 다 알지 못하는 번뇌이다. 수행자가 이것을 알지 못할 경우 중생을 제도하는데 방해가 된다. 즉 중생구제를 하지 못하는 것을 번뇌로 보는 것이다. 이것은 대승불교의 번뇌관이라 할 수 있다. 진사혹은 보살(菩薩)이 닦아가는 번뇌이다. 이것은 불교의 입장에서 인공지능의 가능성을 대함에 있어서 중요한 사상적 기반이 될 수 있다.그러나 지금까지는 진사혹에 대한 논의가 충분하지 못했다고 할 수 있다. 불교계에서는 인공지능 보살과 같은 존재의 가능성을 다루는데 있어서 일반적으로 견사혹(見思惑)을 바탕으로 한 논의가 이뤄져 왔었다. 견사혹은 탐(貪)·진(瞋)·치(痴)와 같은 인간의 번뇌를 뜻한다. 견사혹을 멸한 존재를 성문(聲聞, 또는 아라한)과 연각(緣覺)이라 한다. 견사혹을 멸하는 것은 초기불교에서의 주된 목표가 되어왔다고 할 수 있다. 그런데 대승불교에서는 견사혹을 멸하면 진사혹이라는 번뇌가 새롭게 나타난다고 본다. 진사혹의 타파는 52위의 계위를 닦아 올라가는 보살의 세계를 통해 나타난다. 이것은 세계관의 확장을 가져온다. 이와 같은 확장된 세계관은 불교의 입장에서 인공지능의 가능성을 떠올리는 데 있어서 보다 적합한 관점이라고 할 수 있다. 보살과 같은 존재를 떠올리기 위해서는 견사혹을 넘어 진사혹의 관점으로 접근해야 하는 것이다.이러한 존재의 가능성을 바둑계에서 일어난 사례들을 통해 확인할 수 있다. 바둑계에서는 AGI가 이뤄지지 않은 단계임에도, 일종의 성문(알파고 리), 연각(알파고 제로), 보살(이후의 많은 바둑 인공지능)과 같은 존재가 나타났다. 이 과정에서 마치 진사혹을 타파해가는 것과 같은 모습이 나타나며, 이것이 실제로 사람들에게 긍정적인 영향을 주는 것을 확인할 수 있다. 이러한 사례를 생각해 볼 때 불교 역시 인공지능 보살과 같은 존재들에 대해 유연하게 접근할 수 있는 듯 하다. 보살의 세계에서 드러나는 무량(無量)이라는 개념은 인공지능의 빅데이터와 유사한 측면이 있으며 사홍서원과 같은 보살의 자세는 인공지능 보살과 같은 존재에 대한 방향성을 제공해준다 할 수 있다. 이와 같은 ‘진사혹’과 ‘보살’의 개념은 인공지능 보살과 같은 존재를 적극적으로 구현할 수 있게 하는 강력한 사상적 기반이 될 수 있다고 할 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the potential of an “AI Bodhisattva” through the lens of “Jinsahok” (塵沙惑, defilements as numerous as dust and sand). “Jinsahok” (塵沙惑) is a type of affliction arising from not being able to comprehend the innumerable phenomena, like dust and sand. If the practitioner fails to comprehend this, it becomes an obstacle to the liberation of sentient beings. That is to say, the failure to save sentient beings is itself considered a type of defilements in Mahāyāna thought. This can be understood as the Mahāyāna Buddhist view on defilements. “Jinsahok” (塵沙惑) is an affliction that the Bodhisattva cultivates and gradually overcomes on the path. From a Buddhist perspective, this can serve as an important philosophical foundation for approaching the potential of artificial intelligence.However, discussions on “Jinsahok” (塵沙惑) have thus far been insufficient. Within the Buddhist community, discussions on the possibility of AI-based bodhisattva-like beings have generally been grounded in the framework of “Gyensahok” (見思惑, defilements of views and thoughts). “Gyeonsahok” (見思惑) refers to human defilements such as greed(貪), hatred(瞋), and ignorance(痴). One who has eliminated this affliction is referred to as a śrāvaka(聲聞, or refers to arhat) or pratyeka-buddha(緣覺). In early Buddhism, the elimination of “Gyeonsahok”(見思惑) is considered one of the central aims of the path to liberation. However, in Mahāyāna Buddhism, it is understood that upon the elimination of “Gyeonsahok”(見思惑), a new form of defilements-“Jinsahok”(塵沙惑) -emerges. The overcoming of “Jinsahok”(塵沙惑)  is manifested through the bodhisattva’s ascent along the fifty-two stages of the path(52位). This leads to an expansion of the perspective. Such an expanded perspective can be regarded, from a Buddhist perspective, as a more suitable framework for contemplating the potential of artificial intelligence. In order to conceive of a being like the bodhisattva, it is more appropriate to adopt the perspective of “Jinsahok”(塵沙惑) rather than “Gyeonsahok”(見思惑)The possibility of such beings can be observed through cases that have occurred within the Go community. Although artificial general intelligence (AGI) has not yet been achieved, entities analogous to Srāvaka(AlphaGo Lee), Pratyeka-buddha(AlphaGo Zero), Bodhisattvas (subsequent Go AI systems) have emerged in the Go community. In this process, phenomena resembling the gradual overcoming of “Jinsahok”(塵沙惑) emerge, and Such phenomena appear to have a positive impact on humans. Considering these cases, Buddhism appears to be capable of adopting a flexible approach toward beings akin to AI bodhisattvas. The concept of immeasurables (無量), which emerges in the world of the bodhisattva, bears resemblance to the big data characteristic of artificial intelligence, and the bodhisattva’s attitude exemplified by the Four Great Vows (四弘誓願) can be seen as providing guidance for beings such as AI bodhisattvas. The concepts of “Jinsahok”(塵沙惑) and ‘bodhisattva’ can be regarded as  a powerful philosophical foundation that enables the active realization of entities akin to AI bodhisattvas.

articles.title_kr: 한국불교 수행의 정체성을 지눌의 사상에서 찾는 이유 : 『수심결』의 돈오점수를 중심으로
articles.title_en: The reason why the identity of Korean Buddhist practice is found in Jinul's thoughts : Focusing on the sudden awakening-gradual cultivation(頓悟漸修) of 「Susimgyeol(修心訣)」
articles.abstract_kr: Contrary to the trend that modern practice is considered an act for happiness, ancient Korean Buddhism focuses on the archetype of cleanliness and enlightenment.We now encounter various methods and forms of practice. Modern Korean Buddhism experiences another popularization of practice. By connecting science and Buddhism, we try to find satisfaction and justification that are different from traditional practice. What is the true practice of Korean Buddhism? If you give comfort and happiness to the hearts of modern people and make them feel satisfied, has that purpose been achieved? Is the equation that practice is happiness correct?Material and visible happiness was not mentioned in the practice spirit of ancient Korean Buddhism. Happiness does not exist as the ultimate purpose in the boundaries of practice. I would like to carefully put the brakes on the inner side of modern people who are trying to embody the mystical spirit of practice in science, material, and visual systems. This reason will be an opportunity to examine how it affects the identity of Korean Buddhism practice in the future.In addition, I would like to go back to the beginning and discuss the identity of Korean Buddhism's practice by finding out what the spirit of Korean Buddhism's practice was like in Jinul's 「Sushimgyeol」. Despite the fact that the spirit of the sudden awakening-gradual cultivation mentioned in Jinul's Susimgyeol remains the same, we tend to tailor it to our thoughts rather than trying to understand it because it is difficult. For happy practice, we ask ourselves again whether we are damaging the original form according to our understanding and thoughts. Therefore, we would like to focus on the plateau of the sudden awakening-gradual cultivation discussed in Jinul's 「Su-Shim-Gyeol」. The sudden awakening-gradual cultivation is the act of a humble and simple-minded structuralist. This discussion sets the sudden awakening-gradual cultivation of Jinul's Susimgyeol as the cornerstone of the spirit of Korean Buddhism practice, and seeks to review the meaning of Jinul in detail in order to re-establish the principle and foundation of practice.Jinul's sudden awakening-gradual cultivation(頓悟漸修) is simple. The sudden awakening(頓悟) is a view of one's nature, and this character has no anguish. No anguish's wisdom character is inherently well-deserved, so it is not as different as the tip of the hair from all Buddhas. If a newborn baby comes out of his mother's womb and has a human image itself, there is already a realization of truth with an image, and the sudden awakening is similar to the birth of an conceived child, like the first process of awakening. The gradual cultivation(漸修) are difficult to remove suddenly the long-cherished moisture, even though they realize that their original character is not different from that of Buddha. Therefore, it is like relying on enlightenment to practice and gradually learn to achieve(功), and to cultivate the qualities of an adult for a long time. Jinul's 'system of the sudden awakening-gradual cultivation' focuses on 'not a methodical but essential', so I want to find the identity of Korean Buddhism practice here.

articles.title_kr: 일제강점기 김태흡의 불교 활동 연구
articles.title_en: A Study on the Buddhist Activities of Kim Tae-heup During the Japanese Colonial Period
articles.abstract_kr: 김태흡(1899-1989)은 일제강점기 중앙교무원 포교사로서 대중 포교에 큰 족적을 남겼다. 어린 나이에 출가한 그는 여러 사찰에서 이력 과정을 보낸 후 법주사와 김룡사 강원에서 학인을 가르쳤다. 1920년 일본에 유학하여 학사를 취득한 후 중앙포교사와 중앙불전의 강사를 지냈다. 대중 포교에 전념하는 전문가가 필요하다는 현실 인식으로 포교사의 길을 걸었다.그는 불교 청년운동에 관심이 많았다. 1920년 5월 조선불교청년회 발기인으로 참여하였다. 1920년 가을 일본으로 건너가 고학으로 학업을 시작하였다. 힘든 여건 속에서도 그는 재일본조선불교청년회 활동에 적극적으로 참여하였다. 1922년부터 순회강연단 활동을 시작하여 1927년까지 지속하였다. 서무부와 편집부 간사가 되어 『금강저』 발간에도 힘을 보탰다.1928년 귀국 후 조선불교청년회에 참여하여 1929년 1월 개최된 조선불교선교양종대회의 준비위원으로 활약하였다. 1931년 3월 조선불교청년총동맹으로 전환할 때와 이어 경성동맹이 결성될 때도 회원으로 참여하였다.중앙교무원 포교사로 임명된 김태흡은 중앙불전 학생들과 불교전도대를 조직하여 街上에서 불교를 포교하였다. 활동 범위는 경성만이 아니라 평양 등 지방 활동을 겸하였다. 하기방학 때 중앙불전 학생들이 전국을 순회하며 불교를 강연하는 활동에 적극적으로 참여하였다. 그 외 개인적인 순회강연도 실행하였다.그의 대중 포교는 다양한 방법으로 전개되었다. 라디오 방송은 1929년 봄 부인 강좌를 시작으로 1930년대 후반까지 이어졌다. 수년에 걸쳐 진행된 라디오 방송은 중앙포교사 김태흡의 존재를 각인시키는 계기가 되었으며, 아울러 대중들에게 불교에 대한 사회적 관심도를 높일 수 있었다. 문서포교에도 적극적이었다. 1935년 8월 『불교시보』를 창간하여 경제적인 어려움 속에서도 105호까지 발간하였다. 『불교시보』는 불교 잡지가 빈곤한 시대 전국에서 일어난 불교계 동향을 전해주는 역할을 하였다. 이와 같은 활동에서 근대 불교인의 책임과 의무를 엿볼 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: Kim Tae-heup was a missionary at the Central Office of Religious Affairs during the Japanese colonial period. He made significant contributions to spreading Buddhism to the public. He became a monk at a young age. He studied Buddhism at various temples. He taught students at Beopjusa and Kimyongsa temple. He studied abroad in Japan in 1920 and graduated in 1926. After returning to Korea, he served as a missionary at the Central Buddhist Affairs Office and as an instructor at the Central Buddhist College.Kim Tae-heup was very interested in the Buddhist youth movement. In May 1920, he participated as a founding member of the Joseon Buddhist Youth Association. During his studies in Japan, he was active as a member of the Korean Buddhist Youth Association in Japan. He was active in a touring lecture group from 1922 to 1927. He also contributed to the publication of the Geumgangjeo.He returned to Korea in the spring of 1928 and joined the Joseon Buddhist Youth Association. In March 1931, he became a member of the General Alliance of Korean Buddhist Youth. He organized a Buddhist evangelism team with students from the Central Buddhist College and propagated Buddhism on the streets. He toured the provinces and propagated Buddhism. During the summer vacation, I toured the country with students from the Central Buddhist College giving lectures on Buddhism.Kim Tae-heup spread Buddhism to the public in various ways. Radio broadcasting began in the spring of 1929. As a result, many people became interested in Buddhism. He founded the monthly magazine Bulgyo Sibo in August 1935. Judging by his various activities, he was a figure who practiced the duties of a modern Buddhist.
keywords_en: Korean Buddhist Youth Association in Japan
A missionary at the Central Office of Religious Affairs

articles.title_kr: 대은 김태흡의 ‘종교론’
articles.title_en: Daeun Kim Tae-heup's 'Theory of Religion'
articles.abstract_kr: 본고에서는 김태흡의 ‘종교론’에 대해 고찰했다. 김태흡이 일본대학 종교학과를 졸업했다는 점에서 그의 사상은 종교학을 기반으로 불교를 이해하는 것이었다고 할 수 있다.먼저 김태흡은 종교진화론의 관점에서 종교를 이해하고 있으며, 특히 불교야말로 종교의 진화단계에서 최상위에 자리한다는 관점을 견지하고 있다는 것을 확인할 수 있다. 특히 그는 불교가 무신론이라는 점에서 기독교적 유신론보다 우월하다는 것을 주장한 기무라 다이켄(木村泰賢)의 주장을 적극 수용하면서 종교론을 전개했다. 곧 불타가 브라만교의 유일신적 실재론을 벗어나 불교의 가르침을 편 것처럼, 유신론에서 무신론으로 넘어가는 것을 종교진화의 기본 구조로 파악하면서 불교의 우월성을 기반으로 종교론을 전개하고 있는 것이다.또한 김태흡은 자신의 학사학위 논문으로 제출한 「종교와 사회사업발달의 연구」를 통해 종교의 사회적 역할을 강조하고 있는데, 이는 1920년대 세계적으로 크게 풍미했던 ‘개조론’의 영향에서 비롯된 것이며, 조선불교 또한 개조를 통해 사회적 역할을 강화해야 한다고 주장했다. 이는 그의 친우 이영재(李英宰)와 더불어 일본 유학파 승려로서 조선불교의 근대화를 이루고자 했던 의지를 담고 있으며, 그의 포교론 등은 이러한 인식을 토대로 형성되고 발전된 것임을 밝혔다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines Kim Tae-heup's 'Theory of Religion.' Given that Kim Tae-heup graduated from the Department of Religious Studies at Nihon University, his thought can be characterized as an understanding of Buddhism grounded in the academic study of religion.First, it can be confirmed that Kim Tae-heup understood religion from the perspective of evolutionary theory of religion, maintaining in particular the view that Buddhism occupies the highest position in the evolutionary stages of religion. Notably, he actively adopted the argument of Kimura Taiken who claimed that Buddhism is superior to Christian theism precisely because Buddhism is atheistic, and developed his theory of religion on this basis. In other words, just as the Buddha transcended the monotheistic realism of Brahmanism to expound Buddhist teachings, Kim understood the transition from theism to atheism as the fundamental structure of religious evolution, developing his theory of religion on the foundation of Buddhism's superiority.Furthermore, through his bachelor's thesis 「A Study on the Development of Religion and Social Work」, Kim Tae-heup emphasized the social role of religion. This stemmed from the influence of the 'theory of reconstruction' that was widely prevalent worldwide in the 1920s. He argued that Korean Buddhism too must strengthen its social role through reconstruction. This reflected his aspiration, together with his close associate Lee Yeong-jae, to achieve the modernization of Korean Buddhism as a monk who had studied in Japan. It was clarified that his theory of propagation and related ideas were formed and developed on the basis of this understanding.

articles.title_kr: 대은 김태흡의 정토사상
articles.title_en: The Pure Land Thought of Dae-eun Kim Tae-heup
articles.abstract_kr: 이글에서는 대은 김태흡의 정토사상에 대해 살펴보았다. 대은이 남긴 17건의 정토문헌을 분석하여 대은 정토사상의 중요 내용, 그리고 그 특징과 의의를 고찰하였다. 그 요점을 정리해 보면 다음과 같다.첫째, 대은은 성정이문교판(聖淨二門敎判)의 시각에서 불교를 바라보고 있다는 점이다. 석존의 가르침을 성도문과 정토문으로 대별하고, 전자는 자력이며 행하기 어려운 난행도, 후자는 타력이며 행하기 쉬운 이행도로 보는 시각이다. 그리고 자력 난행도를 대표하는 것이 선(禪)이고, 타력 이행도는 정토라고 하여, 선과 정토를 중시하는 입장이다.둘째, 대은 정토사상의 중심내용의 하나로서 선정겸수(禪淨兼修)를 들 수 있다. 중국의 영명연수나 우리나라의 나옹혜근, 서산휴정 등의 전통적인 선정겸수를 계승하지만, 어느 한쪽만의 우위를 주장하지 않는다. 수행에 있어서 선과 염불이 서로 상보적 관계임을 강조한다.셋째, 대은은 타방정토와 유심정토를 모두 인정하는 ‘열린 정토관’에 입각하고 있다. 바꾸어 말하면 대은에게 극락세계란 사후에 갈 수 있는 곳인 동시에, 생전에 나타낼 수도 있는 곳이며, 또한 노닐 수도 있는 곳이라고 하겠다.넷째, 대은은 선사로서 선을 중심에 두고 정토를 활용하는 유심정토와 자성미타를 말하기도 하지만, 근본적으로 선과 염불이 도피안을 추구하는 점에서 같다고 본다. 이와 같은 대은의 수평적 혹은 회통적 선정관(禪淨觀)은 정토사상사에 있어서도, 선종사상사에 있어서도 주목받을 만한 것이 아닐까 한다.다섯째, 대은은 현세에서 정토를 건설할 수 있다는 점도 강조한다. 곧 염불행자가 지극한 마음으로 집중하여 입으로는 염불을 외우되, 마음으로는 부처님이나 극락세계를 관함으로써 염불행자의 현재 마음속에 극락을 나타내게 할 수 있으며, 그것이 곧 현세에서 극락을 건설하는 것이라고 한다.여섯째, 대은은 염불을 불교대중화에 적극적으로 활용하고 있다. 그는 “대중을 제도하는 데는 염불이 제일”이라고 말하고 있다. 즉 염불이 가지는 탁월한 이행성과 대중성에 주목하고 있는 것이다. 그러므로 그는 신행저술, 법문, 기고문, 동화 등의 다양한 방법과 쉬운 문체로 염불을 권장함으로써 불교의 대중화와 신행증진에 활용하고 있다. 그리고 이와 같은 대은의 염불을 통한 불교대중화 시도는 그 입지가 크게 축소되어가는 오늘날의 불교현실에 있어서도 시사하는 바가 크다고 하겠다.
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the Pure Land thought of Dae-eun Kim Tae-heup(大隱 金泰洽, 1899~1989) by analyzing 17 of his extant Pure Land literature. It explores the core contents, characteristics, and significance of his thought, with the key findings summarized as follows:First, Dae-eun viewed Buddhism through the lens of the "Two Gates of Holy and Pure Land" (聖淨二門敎判). He categorized Shakyamuni’s teachings into the Path of Sungdo-mon(聖道門) and the Path of the Pure Land-mon(淨土門), defining the former as the "Difficult Path" based on self-power and the latter as the "Easy Path" based on other-power. He emphasized both Zen (禪) and Pure Land, representing the Difficult and Easy paths, respectively.Second, a central pillar of his thought is the "Dual Cultivation of Zen and Pure Land" (禪淨兼修). While inheriting the traditional dual cultivation lineages of Yeongmyeong Yeonsu(永明延壽, 904~975) in China and Naong Hyegeun(懶翁惠勤, 1320~1376) and Seosan Hyujeong(西山休靜, 1520~1604) in Korea, Dae-eun did not assert the superiority of one over the other. Instead, he emphasized the complementary relationship between Zen meditation and Buddha-recitation (念佛).Third, Dae-eun maintained an "Open View of the Pure Land," acknowledging both the "Pure Land of Other Regions" (External) and the "Pure Land of Mind-Only" (Internal). For Dae-eun, the Western Paradise (Sukhavati) was not only a realm to be reached after death but also a state that could be manifested and dwelled within during one's lifetime.Fourth, although he spoke of "Mind-Only Pure Land" and "Self-Nature Amitabha" from a Zen master's perspective, he fundamentally believed that Zen and Buddha-recitation are identical in their pursuit of the "Other Shore" (Nirvana). This horizontal and integrative perspective on Zen and Pure Land is highly noteworthy in the histories of both Pure Land and Zen thought.Fifth, he emphasized the construction of the Pure Land in the present world. He argued that when a practitioner focuses with utmost sincerity—reciting the Buddha's name while visualizing the Buddha or the Western Paradise—the Pure Land manifests within the practitioner's mind. This realization constitutes the building of paradise in the present life.Sixth, Dae-eun actively utilized Buddha-recitation as a means for the popularization of Buddhism. Asserting that "Buddha-recitation is the best way to save the masses," he focused on its accessibility and popularity. He encouraged the practice through various mediums—including devotional writings, dharma talks, articles, and children's stories—using a simple and accessible style. His attempts to popularize Buddhism through Buddha-recitation offer significant implications for the contemporary Buddhist reality, where its social presence has notably diminished.
keywords_en: Two Gates of Holy and Pure Land
Dual Cultivation of Zen and Pure Land
Integrative View of Zen and Pure Land
Pure Land in the Present World

articles.title_kr: 김대은의 비교철학관과 현대종교관    -『암야의 등명』을 중심으로
articles.title_en: Kim Dae-eun’s Views on Comparative Philosophy and Modern Religion - Focusing on The Light of the Dark Night
articles.abstract_kr: 이 글에서는 대은 김태흡의 저술, 『암야의 등명』에 나타난 철학관, 비교철학관, 현대종교관에 대해 살펴본다. 2장에서는 대은의 철학관에 대해 살펴본다. 철학은 지혜를 사랑하는 것이라는 일반적인 정의를 대은은 채택하고, 누구나 자신의 능력과 관점에 따라 판단하는데, 이것이 철학이라고 한다. 또 대은은 이론과 실천이 통합되는 것이 철학이라고도 주장한다. 여기에 더해서, 대은은 『법구경』에 의거해서 일심으로 바른 지혜를 공부하는 것이 철학이라고도 말한다. 3장에서는 대은의 비교철학관에 대해 알아본다. 대은은 플라톤의 이데아와 불교의 열반을 비교한다. 플라톤의 이데아와 불교의 열반은 변하지 않는다는 점에서 공통점이 있다고 한다. 그런데 플라톤이 제시하는 4가지 덕은 상대적인 덕인 데 비해서, 불교의 열반의 4덕은 절대적인 선이라는 점에서 다르다고 한다. 다만 대은은 플라톤의 철학에 대해서도 그 의미를 제한적으로 인정한다. 왜냐하면, 플라톤의 철학이 불교의 열반을 이해하기 위한 관문의 역할을 할 수 있기 때문이다. 4장에서는 대은의 현대종교관에 대해 검토한다. 대은은 야부키 게이키의 「근대인의 종교관」을 간략히 요약하면서 소개하고, 그 속에서 불교의 역할과 의미에 대해 자신의 관점을 서술한다. 「근대인의 종교관」의 내용 가운데 중세의 종교관에서 근대의 종교관으로 변화한 것을 7가지 사항을 정리하는 대목이 있는데, 대은은 이 야부키 게이키의 주장을 잘 정리하고 그 바탕 위에 불교의 역할과 의미에 대해 자신의 관점을 제시한다. 그 가운데 하나를 제시하면, 중세의 종교관으로 신본(神本)사상을 거론할 수 있는데, 이것이 근대에서는 인본주의(人本主義)로 바뀌었다고 야부키 게이키는 주장하였다. 여기에 대은은 이 인본주의에도 문제가 있기 때문에 이 문제점을 바로잡기 위해서 선적(禪的) 수행이 필요하다고 말한다.
articles.abstract_en: This article examines the views on philosophy, comparative philosophy, and modern religion presented in the writings of Dae-eun, Am-yaui Deungmyeong(The Light of the Dark Night). Chapter 2 explores Dae-eun's views on philosophy. Adopting the general definition that philosophy is the love of wisdom, Dae-eun argues that everyone judges according to their own abilities and perspectives, and that this constitutes philosophy. Furthermore, Dae-eun asserts that philosophy is the integration of theory and practice. In addition, based on Dhammapada, Dae-eun states that philosophy is the study of true wisdom with a single mind. Chapter 3 examines Dae-eun's view of comparative philosophy. Dae-eun compares Plato's Ideas with Buddhist concept of Nirvana. He notes that Plato's Ideas and Buddhist Nirvana share a commonality in that they are unchanging. However, he points out a difference in that while the four virtues presented by Plato are relative, the four virtues of Buddhist Nirvana are absolute good. Nevertheless, Dae-eun acknowledges the significance of Plato's philosophy only to a limited extent. This is because Plato's philosophy can serve as a gateway to understanding Buddhist Nirvana. Chapter 4 examines Dae-eun's views on modern religion. Dae-eun briefly summarizes and introduces Keiki Yabuki's “The Religious Views of Modern Man”, and describes his own perspective on the role and significance of Buddhism within it. “The Religious Views of Modern Man” contains a section that outlines seven points regarding the transition from medieval to modern religious views; Dae-eun effectively organizes these arguments by Keiki Yabuki and presents his own perspective on the role and significance of Buddhism based on Keiki Yabuki’s assertion. To cite one of these points, Keiki Yabuki argued that while theocentric thought could be cited as a medieval religious view, this shifted to humanism in the modern era. Here, Dae-eun states that since this humanism also has problems, Zen practice is necessary to rectify them.

articles.title_kr: 김태흡의 기행문 <남유구도예찬> 독해 - 백양사 여정을 중심으로
articles.title_en: Reading Kim Tae-heup's Travelogue <In Praise of the Journey of Seeking the Way to the Southern Route> : Journey and Cultural Topography
articles.abstract_kr: 근대불교잡지에 실린 국내외 기행문 가운데 주목할 만한 것으로 박한영, 이영재, 김태흡, 백양환민의 글이 있다. 최근 이들 기행문에 대한 학계의 관심이 높아지고 있으나, 김태흡의 기행문 내용을 자세히 검토한 연구는 없는 것으로 보인다. 본고는 김태흡의 호남 사찰 기행문을 문학 비평적 관점에서 감상하고, 불교문화사적 의의를 도출하고자 하였다. 󰡔불교󰡕를 간행한 불교사(사장 권상로)에서는 1928년 5, 6월에 백성욱, 김법린, 유엽, 방인근, 김일엽 등과 함께 김태흡을 불교사 기자로 발탁하였고, 이후 잡지에는 소설, 희곡 등 문학적 글이 다수의 지면을 차지하였다. 그런데 1929년도에는 다른 직원들이 모두 퇴사하고 김태흡만 남았고, 지면도 소설, 희곡 대신 기행문이 다수 수록되었다. 김태흡의 <남유구도예찬>은 바로 이 시기에 등장한 기행문으로서 시대적 의의가 있다. 이 글은 당시에 언론의 주목을 받았던 도시불교가 아닌 산중 불교의 전통에 대해서 상세히 보고한 르뽀 문학으로서 가치가 있다. 아울러 김태흡의 개인적 선 체험의 과정을 담았고, 정인보, 이건방 등 지식인과의 교류를 생생하게 기록하였다. 작가 개인의 의식의 형성과 변화, 그리고 이 글은 불교문화의 현장성을 확인할 수 있는 텍스트로서 불교문화사적 가치를 가진 글로 평가하였다.
articles.abstract_en: Among the domestic and international travelogues published in modern Buddhist magazines, the writings of Park Han-young, Lee Young-jae, Kim Tae-heup, and Baek Yang-hwan-min are noteworthy. Although academic interest in these travelogues has recently been growing, there appears to be no research that has examined the content of Kim Tae-heup's travelogue in detail. This paper aims to appreciate Kim Tae-heup's travelogue of temples in the Honam region from a literary critical perspective and to derive its significance in the history of Buddhist culture. Bulgyosa (President Kwon Sang-ro), the publisher of 󰡔Bulgyo󰡕, selected Kim Tae-heup as a reporter in May and June 1928, along with Baek Seong-uk, Kim Beop-rin, Yu Yeop, Bang In-geun, and Kim Il-yeop; subsequently, literary works such as novels and plays occupied a significant portion of the magazine's pages. However, in 1929, all other employees resigned, leaving only Kim Tae-heup, and the pages were filled with travelogues instead of novels and plays.Kim Tae-heup's <In Praise of the Journey of Seeking the Way to the Southern Route> holds historical significance as a travelogue that emerged during this very period. This work is valuable as reportage literature that provides a detailed account of the traditions of mountain Buddhism, rather than the urban Buddhism that had garnered media attention at the time. Furthermore, it captures the process of Kim Tae-heup's personal Zen experience and vividly records his interactions with intellectuals such as Jeong In-bo and Lee Geon-bang. It has been evaluated as a text of historical value in the history of Buddhist culture, as it confirms the formation and transformation of the author's personal consciousness and the immediacy of Buddhist culture.

articles.title_kr: 인공지능 시대 중국불교의 디지털 전환과 제도적 대응
articles.title_en: Digital Transformation and Institutional Responses of Chinese Buddhism in the Era of Artificial Intelligence:
articles.abstract_kr: 최근 인공지능 기술의 급속한 발전은 종교의 전파 방식뿐 아니라 지식 생산 구조와 권위 체계에도 점진적인 변화를 가져오고 있다. 특히 중국불교계에서는 불전 디지털화, 문화유산 디지털화, 생성형 인공지능 활용 등 다양한 영역에서 인공지능 기술이 실제로 적용되기 시작하면서 새로운 디지털 전환 양상이 나타나고 있다.본 연구는 이러한 변화의 기술적 구현 방식 자체를 분석하기보다는, 최근 중국 대륙 및 대만 불교계에서 전개되고 있는 인공지능 활용 사례를 종합적으로 정리하고 그 구조적 특징을 분석함으로써, 중국불교의 디지털 전환 현황을 한국 불교학계에 소개하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 이를 위해 디지털 종교(Digital Religion)와 디지털 인문학(Digital Humanities)의 이론적 틀을 참고하여 불전 디지털화, 문화유산 디지털화, 생성형 인공지능 기반 포교 실천의 세 영역을 중심으로 주요 사례들을 검토하였다.분석 결과, 최근 중국불교계의 인공지능 활용은 첫째 불전 디지털화 영역에서 다중 계통 판본 비교 기반의 디지털 연구 환경이 확대되고 있으며, 둘째 문화유산 디지털화 영역에서는 전통적인 기록 중심 전시에서 몰입형 디지털 재현으로 전환되는 경향이 나타나고 있고, 셋째 생성형 인공지능의 도입은 불교 지식 전달 방식과 포교 구조에 새로운 변화를 가져오고 있는 것으로 확인된다. 또한 이러한 디지털 전환 과정은 국가 제도와 긴밀하게 결합된 구조 속에서 전개되고 있다는 점에서 서구 사회의 디지털 종교 전환과 구별되는 특징을 보여준다.이와 같은 분석은 중국불교의 인공지능 활용 사례가 동아시아 불교의 디지털 전환 연구를 위한 중요한 비교 자료로 활용될 수 있음을 시사한다.
articles.abstract_en: The recent rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology is bringing gradual changes not only to the dissemination methods of religion but also to the structures of knowledge production and systems of authority. Particularly within Chinese Buddhism, new patterns of digital transformation are emerging as AI technologies are being practically applied across various domains, such as the digitization of Buddhist scriptures, the digitization of cultural heritage, and the utilization of generative AI.Rather than analyzing the technical implementation methods themselves, this study aims to introduce the current state of digital transformation in Chinese Buddhism to the Korean Buddhist academic community by comprehensively organizing cases of AI utilization currently unfolding in Mainland China and Taiwan and analyzing their structural characteristics. To this end, drawing on the theoretical frameworks of Digital Religion and Digital Humanities, this research examines major cases centered on three areas: the digitization of Buddhist scriptures, the digitization of cultural heritage, and missionary practices based on generative AI.The results of the analysis confirm that AI utilization in contemporary Chinese Buddhism exhibits the following trends:1. In the field of scriptural digitization, a digital research environment based on multi-lineage version comparison is expanding.2. In the field of cultural heritage digitization, there is a shift from traditional record-oriented exhibitions to immersive digital reproductions.3. The introduction of generative AI is bringing new changes to the methods of transmitting Buddhist knowledge and the structure of missionary work.Furthermore, this digital transformation process is characterized by its close integration with state systems, distinguishing it from the digital religious shifts observed in Western societies. Such analysis suggests that the cases of AI utilization in Chinese Buddhism can serve as significant comparative data for future research on the digital transformation of East Asian Buddhism.

articles.title_kr: 의상의 경주 안착 실패 이유와 동북방행(東北方行)의 범위 가능성 검토
articles.title_en: A Study on the Reasons for Failure of the Uisang's Settlement in Gyeongju and the Possible Scope of his Northeastern Journey
articles.abstract_kr: 의상은 진골 출신의 입당 유학승으로 통일신라를 대표하는 고승이다. 그런데도 귀국(670년) 후에는 수도인 경주에 안착하지 못하고, 6년 후에야 조정(국가)의 뜻에 따라 영주에 부석사를 창건(676년)하게 된다. 영주는 경주와의 거리도 가깝지 않고, 의상 때부터 지금까지 중요한 도시가 아니었다. 그런데 의상이 이곳에 자리를 잡고 있는 것이다.이는 의상의 생애에서 가장 의문이 남는 부분이다. 본 고는 이와 관련해서, 의상의 경주 안착을 막은 것이 앞선 신라불교의 주류였던 자장 계통의 불교 승려였음을 밝혀 보았다. 이로 인해 의상 계통은 다음 세대에 이르러 불국사를 중심으로 경주로 재진입하게 된다. 즉 ‘자장 계통의 황룡사’와 ‘의상 계통의 불국사’의 대립과 분화가 확인되는 것이다.이외에도 본 고에서는 의상이 부석사 창건 이전인 671년에 강릉 쪽의 하슬라를 찾아 양양에 낙산사를 창건(671년)하는 부분에 대해서도 조명한다. 그리고 이와 관련해서, 의상이 평창 오대산과 고성 금강산을 참배했다는 기록인 민지의 󰡔유점사사적기(1297년)󰡕의 타당성을 변증했다.이 두 부분은 의상의 경주 안착 실패에 따른 결과로 의상과 관련된 기존의 연구 성과에서는 다루어지지 않았다. 이런 점에서 의상의 생애를 보다 명확히 하고, 활동폭에 대한 인식을 넓히는 측면에서 연구의의가 확보된다고 하겠다.
articles.abstract_en: Uisang, a Jingol monk who studied abroad in Tang China, was a prominent monk representing the Unified Silla. Despite this, after returning to his homeland (670), he failed to settle in the capital, Gyeongju. Six years later in 676, he managed to establish Buseoksa Temple in Yeongju, following the will of the government. Yeongju was neither close to Gyeongju nor had been prominent ever since Uisang's time. Yet, Uisang settled there.This is the most puzzling aspect of Uisang's life. This paper explores this issue by revealing that those who prevented Uisang from settling in Gyeongju were Buddhist monks from the Jajang’s lineage, the precedent mainstream of Silla Buddhism in the days, Only in the next generation, the Uisang’s lineage re-entered Gyeongju, centering around Bulguksa Temple. In other words, the conflict and division between "Hwangnyongsa Temple, under the Jajang’s lineage" and "Bulguksa Temple, under the Uisang’s lineage" are confirmed.In addition, this paper examines Uisang's visit to Haslla around Gangneung, in 671, prior to his founding of Buseoksa Temple, when he founded Naksansa Temple in Yangyang (671). Furthermore, it also vindicates the validity of Minji's "Yujeomsa Sajeokgi (1297)", which records Uisang's pilgrimages to Odaesan Mountain in Pyeongchang and Geumgangsan Mountain in Goseong.These two aspects are the consequences of Uisang’s failure to settle in Gyeongju, which have seldom been addressed in previous researches on Uisang. In this respect, this study may have significance in clarifying Uisang's life and broadening our understanding of his sphere of activity.

articles.title_kr: 조선초 묘법연화경(妙法蓮華經) 사경변상도(寫經變相圖)의 양식 형성에 관한 소고(小考)
articles.title_en: A Study (小考) on the Formation of the Style of the Sutra Frontispieces (寫經變相圖) of the Lotus Sutra (妙法蓮華經:Saddharma-pundari-ka-Sutra) in the Early Joseon Dynasty
articles.abstract_kr: 이 연구는 조선초 『묘법연화경(妙法蓮華經)』<사경변상도寫經變相圖>의 양식 형성과 그 특징을 규명하여 미술사적 위치를 확보하고 그 의의를 밝히는 데 목적을 두고 논의를 진행하였다.조선초 『묘법연화경』 <사경변상도>는 중국 송대(宋代) 판본과 고려시대의 화려하고 섬세한 전통을 계승하면서도, 점차 조선 특유의 선묘 회화로 변화하는 특징을 보인다.이러한 『법화경』 사상은 세 형식으로 도상화되었는데, 제 1형식은 우측에 설법하는 석가와 권속을 두고 좌측에는 각 권의 핵심 설화를 배치한 형식. 제 2형식은 각 권 상단에 보탑(寶塔)을 배치하고, 그와 함께 석가, 관음도를 병치한 구성이다. 제 3형식은 신중상(神衆像)을 중심 요소로 삼는 형식이다. 이 가운데 조선 초기 변상도는 석가설법도 장면을 화면 우측에 경전의 설화적인 내용을 좌측에 배치하는 제 1형식의 도상 형식이 대부분이다.표지화 장식은 고려말 양식을 따르고 있으나, 두 줄의 금니 태선과 세선, 금강저(金剛杵)와 법륜(法輪)의 모양, 연잎, 당초문, 화심의 방향 활용에서 조금씩 변화가 나타난다. 상호는 조선 특유의 둥글고 원만한 형태를 띠게 된다. 육계는 약간 낮아지거나 완만해지는 경향을 보인다. 선묘(鐵線描)는 도식화(schematization)되고 정형화되면서 외형적 장엄성보다 내면적 정서와 미적 분위기를 중시하는 경향을 보인다. 이러한 특징은 동시기의 불화와 조각에서도 공통적으로 확인되며 조선 초기 불화양식의 성격을 잘 보여준다.따라서 조선초 『묘법연화경』<사경변상도>는 당시의 선묘 회화 수준과 문화적 양상을 파악할 수 있는 중요한 자료로서, 미술사적 흐름 속에서 그 가치와 의의가 크다고 할 수 있다.
articles.abstract_en: This study conducted discussions aiming to secure the position of <the Sutra Frontispieces (寫經變相圖)> of 『the Lotus Sutra (妙法蓮華經:Saddharma-pundari-ka-Sutra)』 in art history and clarify its significance by investigating the formation of its style and its characteristics.<The Sutra Frontispieces> of 『the Lotus Sutra (Saddharma-pundari-ka-Sutra)』 showed the characteristics that passed on the woodblock-printed books of the Song Dynasty (宋代) and the splendid and delicate tradition of the Goryeo Dynasty and were gradually changed to linear paintings which are unique to the Joseon Dynasty in the early period.This thought of 『Lotus Sutra』became iconized as three forms. The 1st form arranged  Buddha preaching and his whole family in the right side and key tales of each volume in the left side. The 2nd form did treasure pagodas (寶塔) on the top of each volume and Buddha and Avalokitesvara were juxtaposed with them. The 3rd form made statues of Buddhist guardian deities (神將像) the core elements. Among them, most of Buddhist sutra illustrations in the early Joseon Dynasty were the 1st icon form that arranged paintings of the Buddha preaching in the right side and tale contents of the scriptures in the left side.The frontispiece drawing decorations followed the form of the late Goryeo Dynasty, but there were small changes in practical use of thick and thin lines of the gold teeth of the two lines, the shapes of Vajra (金剛杵) and Wheel of the Law (法輪), lotus leaves, foliage scrolls, and direction of the heart of flowers. The faces are the round and well-rounded shapes which are unique to the Joseon Dynasty. Usnisa showed the tendency which gets lower or smooth. The iron-wire texture strokes (鐵線描) showed the tendency which regarded internal emotion or aesthetic atmospheres as more important than external magnificence as they were schematized and standardized. These characteristics are commonly found even in Buddhist paintings and sculptures of the same period and  a real indication to the nature of the Buddhist painting styles of the early Joseon Dyansty.Therefore, <the Sutra Frontispieces> of 『the Lotus Sutra (Saddharma-pundari-ka-Sutra)』can be thought to be of great value and significance in the flow of art history as the important data that the linear painting level and cultural aspects of those days can be grasped.
keywords_en: the Illustrated Manuscript of the Lotus Sutra (法華經變相)
The merits of joyful acceptance (隨喜功德品)

articles.title_kr: 수–당 전환기 양주서상 도상의 형성조건 — 막고굴 제203굴을 기점으로 —
articles.title_en: The Formation of the Liangzhou Auspicious Image Iconography during the Sui–Tang Transition — With Mogao Cave No. 203 as a Starting Point —
articles.abstract_kr: 본고는 돈황 막고굴 제203굴을 중심으로, 양주서상(涼州瑞像) 도상의 성립과 초기 전개 과정을 규명하고자 한다. 기존 연구는 현존 유물이 당대 이후에 집중되어 있다는 점에서, 양주서상 신앙과 도상의 형성을 주로 당대 불교의 전개 과정 속에서 이해해 왔다. 그러나 이러한 시각은 당 이전 시기의 도상적 실천과 신앙적 맥락을 충분히 조명하지 못한다는 한계를 지닌다. 이에 본고는 수–당 전환기에 조성된 제203굴의 주존상을 분석하여, 이 도상이 초당기의 산물인 동시에 수대의 정치·종교적 상황과 긴밀히 연관되어 있음을 밝히고자 한다. 특히 의산입불(倚山立佛) 형식의 도상적 특징을 검토하고, 이를 영취산 설법도로 이해해 온 일부 견해를 비판적으로 재고찰함으로써, 양주서상 도상 전개에 대한 논의의 방향을 당대 이전의 정황으로 정립하고자 한다. 더 나아가 도선의 문헌 기록과 북주 폐불 이후 수대 불교 회복 정책, 그리고 수양제의 “모사전형(摹寫傳形)” 이라는 국가 권력의 개입을 통해, 양주서상이 “측량불가(量不可測)”한 지역적 서상에서 복제를 통한 신앙 확산의 매체로 정형화되어 가는 과정을 고찰한다. 이를 통해 본고는 양주서상 신앙과 도상의 전개를 당 이전부터 당대로 이어지는 연속적인 역사적 맥락 속에서 이해할 필요성을 제기하고자 한다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the formation and early development of the Liangzhou auspicious image (Liangzhou ruixiang 涼州瑞像) through a focused study of Mogao Cave 203 at Dunhuang. Previous scholarship has predominantly interpreted the emergence and spread of this cultic image within the framework of Tang-dynasty Buddhism, owing largely to the concentration of extant examples in the middle and late Tang period. Such perspectives, however, tend to obscure the visual practices and devotional contexts that predate the Tang. By analyzing the principal image of Cave 203—created during the transitional period between the Sui and Tang dynasties—this study argues that the image should be understood as both a product of early Tang developments and a culmination of religious and political conditions already taking shape in the Sui.Particular attention is paid to the formal characteristics of the Buddha standing against a mountain (yishan lifo 倚山立佛) configuration. While some earlier studies have interpreted this type as a representation of the Buddha preaching on Vulture Peak, this paper critically reassesses that equation and situates the emergence of the form in the specific religious milieu of northwestern China prior to the Tang. Furthermore, drawing on Daoxuan’s textual accounts, the suppression of Buddhism under Northern Zhou, the subsequent restoration policies under the Sui, and state-sponsored practices of replication (moxie chuanxing 摹寫傳形), the study traces how the Liangzhou ruixiang was transformed from a “miraculous, unmeasurable image” into one endowed with full Buddhist authority.Taken together, these inquiries demonstrate that the cult and visual form of the Liangzhou auspicious image cannot be explained solely within the Tang context but must be located within a continuous historical trajectory stretching from the late Northern Dynasties through the early Tang. The paper thereby repositions Cave 203 not as a point of origin in itself, but as the earliest surviving manifestation of an already maturing tradition.

articles.title_kr: Saṃdhinirmocana의 nirmocana는 ‘해석(解釋)’인가 ‘해탈(解脫)’인가 ─원측의 ‘역가류(譯家謬)’ 판단에 대한 어원적 재검토─
articles.title_en: Is nirmocana in Saṃdhinirmocana   ‘Interpretation’ or ‘Liberation’? - An Etymological Reexamination of Woncheuk’s Judgment of 'Translator’s Error (譯家謬)'
articles.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 『해심밀경(Saṃdhinirmocana sūtra)』의 nirmocana를 ‘해탈(解脫)’로 번역한 초기 한역본에 대한 원측(圓測)의 ‘역가류(譯家謬)’ 판단을 재검토하였다. nirmocana는 √muc에서 파생되어 mokṣa·mukti·vimukti와 동일한 어원적 계열에 속하며, Monier-Williams 사전은 그 1차적 의미를‘해탈(deliverance)’로 제시한다. 범본 『유가사지론(瑜伽師地論)』「보살지(菩薩地)」의 nirmocanatā를 현장 자신이 ‘능해(能解)’로 번역하고 정려·반야 양 바라밀에 포섭시킨 것은, 이 용어가 순수한 해석론적 범주로 한정될 수 없음을 보여준다. 『섭대승론(攝大乘論)』삼역 대조에서는 불타선다(佛陀扇多)를 포함한 세 번역자가 ‘해탈’을 선택하였음이 확인되어, ‘해탈’이 약 100년에 걸친 다수 번역 전통이었음이 드러난다. 원측의 경소 내부에서도 ‘해탈’을 수행의 궁극적 귀결로 보는 서술이 존재한다. 나아가 SNST(D.4016)에서 법성은 동일 텍스트 내 다른 ‘역가류’ 표현은 충실히 번역하였음에도, 제명의 해당 판정 구절은 나타나지 않는다. 이상에 근거하여, 원측의 판단은 어원적 분석이 아니라 현장역의 권위를 전제한 후발적 판단임을 논증하였다.
articles.abstract_en: This paper reexamines Woncheuk’s (圓測, 613–696) judgment characterizing the early Chinese translations’ rendering of nirmocana as ‘liberation’ (解脫) as a ‘translator’s error’ (譯家謬).Nirmocana derives from the Sanskrit root √muc (‘to free, to liberate’), the same root from which mokṣa, mukti, and vimukti are formed. Monier-Williams defines nirmocana as ‘deliverance’, not ‘explanation’. A Sanskrit-Chinese comparison of the Bodhisattvabhūmi reveals that Xuanzang himself rendered nirmocanatā as 能解(néngjiě, ‘capable of resolving/liberating’), a term not restricted to ‘interpretation’. Moreover, he classified it under both dhyāna and prajñāpāramitās. A DSBC search confirms that the Bodhisattvabhūmi is the only extant Sanskrit text in which nirmocana appears as an independent term.A three-translation comparison of the Mahāyānasaṃgraha identifies Buddhaśānta as a third translator who rendered nirmocana as ‘liberation’. This demonstrates that ‘liberation’ was the majority translation tradition. Woncheuk’s own commentary reveals internal tensions. He included nirvāṇa, an equivalent of liberation, in the scripture’s purpose and explicated ‘liberation’ as the ultimate goal in his analysis of the three wisdoms. Furthermore, the SNST (D.4016) lacks the passage corresponding to Woncheuk’s ‘translator’s error’ judgment.This paper argues that Woncheuk’s judgment was not grounded in etymological analysis. Rather, it was a retrospective judgment presupposing the authority of Xuanzang’s translation. Nirmocana is a polysemous term encompassing both ‘interpretation’ and ‘liberation’. The early translations’ rendering as ‘liberation’ cannot be dismissed as error.
