10권 호.title_en: The Relationships between Buddhism and Feng-shui(風水) in Korea
Visionsof Unified Korean society based on life and peace perspectives
10권 호.abstract_kr: This paper provides visionsof unified Korea society in Korean peninsular where post-cold war and cold-war co-exist. Korea`s national history of overcoming various crises has been reviewed in order to anticipate future unified Korean society. Historical discussions of more than 930 foreign invasionson Korea were provided, including numerous historical facts since the twentieth century. Based on life perspective, Korean peninsularwas seen as a place of harmony, and environmental protection rather than a place of environmental destruction. On the other hand, according to peace perspective, assuming unification, cohabitating relations of super powers` (U.S., Japan, China, and Russia) around Korean peninsular were discussed, viewing both side of Korea as a center of forming the relationship with super powers in the region. Some of the assumptions of unified Korean society theory based on life and peace were, finding a point of contact in both Korea`s unification policies, being able to consider its value in a practical point of view. It has been pointed out that the solution has to be accompanied with both of Korean government`s reform, and social as well as cultural harmony. Thus, visions of unified Korea are defined as 4 elements. First element is consolidating communal spirit. Secondly, needs of constituting a new society based on shared historical consciousness. Thirdly, nurturing great leaders fit for unified Korea. Fourth one is needs for making a society that is able to practice social service, and social welfare.

10권 호.title_en: Logical Relationship between Pratitya Samutpada Theory of Dharmadhatu on Avatamska Sutra and Computer World
10권 호.abstract_kr: Computers are now found in every walk of our life. in the office, in the bank, in schools and colleges , in industry, and so on. Nowadays, computer utilization is extended to many areas rapidly and the application is increased more by development of internet technology. If the foundation related to computer on buddhism can be found, computer theory and technique would are devoted toward the more direction to peoples. For the first, I tried to find the logical relationship between the pratitya samutpada theory, so as called, the depending arising theory of dharmadhatu on avatamska Sutra and computer theory. And the paper described on the four dharmadhatu on the avatamska sutra. because of depending arising theory of that is the kernel of avatamska sutra. And then, for the purpose of finding the ability of the logical relationship between two areas, analysed basic theory of computer systems, hardware and software. Also, I studied the harmony and accessability among of the avatamska sutra, real world and computer world. Specially, I noted the bit theory on hardware and described the tree theory on software area each. At all, to represent the importance of the logical relationship I presented the connection of the four dharmadhatu on avatamska sutra and computer theory. As it is, the computer theory can be derived from and described by the four dharmadhatu. Though the computer world is involved in real world and the real world is the virtual world, also the computer world is virtuality. I think that if we had studied about the avatamska sutra very deeply in real world, then would have grown to the beautiful computer world more than now.

10권 호.title_kr: 식당작법(食堂作法)에서 불교무용(佛敎舞踊)의 역할(役割)
10권 호.title_en: Investigation of Buddhist dancing in Sicdang Jakbub
10권 호.abstract_kr: In Sicdang Jakbub(食堂作法) Bumpae is composed of Zitsori(chorus sound) Hotsori(single sound), take general ceremony with Buddhist dance. The Bara dance (belonging Jakbubmu in Buddhist dance) is danced through supporting and praising Buddhism and means the precept of Buddhism. Bubgo dance(法鼓舞) must be danced by meaning of saving mankind and accelerating of devotion in Buddhism. And Taju dance, kind of butterfly dance(蝴蝶舞) shows the progress of discipline. It shows getting of Prajna All Sunya(般若皆空) and Sarvadharma Reality(諸法實相) by Jakbub dance(作法舞)-the ceremony dance and progess of perceiving of Monks and express delight mind which jumping of sea of pain. At this part we can know the Jakbub dance -kind of Buddhist dance takes a important role in Sicdangjakbub. Bubsamul(法四物) is used at music playing in Buddhist dance, Taju dance(打柱舞) is progressed by Gwangswe(kind of Bubsamul) sound which Gumdangjwa(金堂佐) use. Bumjong (kind of big bell) -the Daesamul(大四物) which is used at Sicdangjakbub- living things, Wooden fish(木魚) -living things in water, Wonpan(雲板) -living things in emptiness and Bubgo(kind of drum) -living things in the world means inviting all king of them at Jakbub-dorang(temple) and attaining Buddhahood. At Sicdangjakbub look at the true heart and labor, and thanking of food by doing -donner, accepter and donating things -three circle cleaning(三輪淸淨) and five sight and planting good medicine for preserving body, that economy and moderation have a valuable meaning at the present age. Because Sicdangjakbub is held at big ceremony and it takes too long time to training the Bumpae, it is difficult assignment to spread to the general public.

10권 호.title_kr: 토함산 석굴(吐含山 石窟)의 점정(點定)과 그 배경(背景)
10권 호.title_en: The Site Selection and Background to The Cave Temple at Mt, Toham
10권 호.abstract_kr: Sokguram, the Cave Temple at Mt. Toham, which has served as an unprecedented masterpiece in Korean culture and art history, is a mystical work and not the result of efforts over a single period. Rather, it is the union and culmination of the thoughts and arts of Korean people through study over many centuries. Sokguram is the most outstanding formative art in Korean Buddhist art history, with Mt.Toham and the East Sea as background to its location. That is to say, the location of the Cave Temple seems to have been designated at the same place where the Yonaejeong(遙乃井) Well was located through the mystical powers of King Talhea and the patriotism of King Munmu. Through the Yonaejeong Well, we can discover Sokguram as a sublimation of the thoughts and arts of Silla. It appears that the location of Sokguram seems to have been selected as a result of mid-8th century Mountain God and Dragon God beliefs. However, to date the background behind the construction of Sokruram on top of the Yonaejeong Well has been unresolved. Religion is world of ideas and beliefs. The mystical nature of the waters of Yonaejeong Well provided the religious background to form an ideal world of a Buddhist figure in a cave temple. This is the realm of the mystical that can be understood as religion rather than architecture. However, despite the restoration projects that have taken place at the site, preservation efforts have been somewhat insufficient and the structure of the original foundation has been lost, along with the wisdom of the people of Shilla in building the structure. This sense of loss is more than the result of just excessive affection for Sokguram. This cave temple, constructed above the waters of a well, is a priceless cultural monument that should be handed down to our descendents. At the same time, Sokguram is a worthy new subject of research on ancient Korean mentality.

10권 호.title_en: The cultural environment prospect of Korean buddhist temple in 21st century
10권 호.abstract_kr: This research was carried out with a purpose to forecast what kind of content and form the Buddhist temple environment should take in order to be responsible for the function as cultural center of the community in 21st century. In the study, cultural events held at temples in 2003 were mainly examined and SWOT analysis was implemented to look at the nature and limitations of those events and the temple environment to function as community`s cultural focal point. Based on the analysis, cultural environment of Korean temple`s future was forecasted. The conclusion was reached as follows through this research. Contemporary Buddhism`s characteristics are in short, Buddhism of everyday life. Therefore, the modern Buddhist temple takes up the role as a container of everyday life Buddhism. Hence, modern temples of the 21st century have to go beyond the traditional concept of being occupied and managed by the monks, and instead create an environment with the worshipers in their center. Which is why, now the space needed by a temple should be a space to practice everyday Buddhism and the environment itself become more worshiper-oriented. Moreover, the Buddhist temple of 21st century has the duty to change from a closed personality to a more open character. That is because only after the temple becomes an open space, could the Buddhist objectives to practice enlightening the mankind be achieved. Recent movements of the temples creating citizen zen meditation center, theater, bookstore, teahouse, art museum, and wedding space and opening them up to not only Buddhist believers but also to the rest of public are thought to be reflecting such trend. However, it is most important that these various facilities, first of all, thoroughly preserve the public interest. If these facilities are introduced in the Buddhist temple for the purpose of pursuing profits, it is obvious that it will bring about a result preventing people from coming to the Buddhist temples. Thus, if the environment of Buddhist temple becomes inclined towards the worshipers and moreover develop into an open environment, the Buddhist temple will naturally take charge of the role as the cultural center of community. In addition, it is concluded that functioning as a cultural center of community could be accomplished very easily, as the Korean Buddhist temples retain Buddhist culture of 1600 years, and that Buddhist tradition corresponds to the sub base culture forming a basis of our culture. However, the most important fact is that, it is wrong to think that merely securing the hardware like facilities or space could make our Buddhist temples function as the cultural center of community. We should have attractive cultural contents, which can be included in such hardware to function as the cultural center. Of course, there is no theory that the cultural contents including in the Buddhist temple should stand on the basis of religion. But, now we will have to get out of the obsolete idea of thinking that the Buddhist temples are exclusive spaces for only Buddhists in order to have the temples become places including the higher level of culture. That is, the Buddhist temple should become cultural space of community, where all people, both Buddhists and non-Buddhists can approach familiarly. When these ideas arouse the common social sentiment widely, cultural events that are held at Buddhist temple can have the support of the public and their effects will also increase. When that is materialized, the Buddhist temple could become a marketing place of Buddhist cultures, and that would widely communicate and spread Buddhism it will be a work of placing Buddhism at the center of people`s spiritual world.

10권 호.title_kr: A study on the Kwan as a intervention strategy for job stress
10권 호.title_en: A study on the Kwan as a intervention strategy for job stress
10권 호.abstract_kr: The economical environment in korea is changing rapidly now. Many employees try to adapt to the changing environment and retain their employment. They have severe job stress due to restructuring and lay off. Job stress affect employees physically and psychologically. Physical job stress symptoms are headache, hypertension, coronary heart disease, musculo-skeletal symptoms and so on. Psychological job stress symptoms are depression, anxiety, job unsatisfaction and so on. Finally employees who have too much job stress, absent themselves from their job or quit their job. Being lost their workers affects the company`s management. Thus, many companies have been trying to manage job stress of their employees and develop job stress management programs for their employees. Kwan is entrusting everything inwardly, while considering nothing as separate from us. If someone entrust everything to Juingong as an inner leader, without regarding anything as separate from himself, all will be well. We have to practice Kwan in every situation, because, life is just Kwan and Buddhism. Kwan is belief on the Juingong as an inner leader. Sufferings of the life are educational materials that show us the way to the truth. When there is nothing separate from us, we don`t need to feel anger, depression, anxiety and job stress and then will be so happy. Thus, Kwan could be a good intervention strategy to manage job stress.

10권 호.abstract_kr: This Article has developed along 4lines. First, set forth the purpose of the study, advances the key proposition, explicates the order In Northeast Asia. Second, focused on what`s meaning in New East Asia Order. What is international order in Northeast Asia? How international order maintained in 21century? it is very important to defines and develops the concepts (1)the goals of order meaning, that is survival, limitation of violence, peaceful change,(2) different pathways meaning: hegemony, balance of power, international regimes,(3)instrument of order: war. international law, diplomacy Third, focuses on the role of Buddhism in East Asia. The Buddhism implies the whole set of complex unity and peace order, it includes its principal concepts the theory of ``self-effacement(無我)`` and ``mercy(慈悲)``, knowledge and potential energy. Overall I think that the Buddhism will be contribute to in various ways providing peace order in Northeast Asia, it will be predominantly the key of role. Finally, I assess some of the experience of the Buddhism for pathways to regional peace order. Its order relates to stability and predictability in relationships and accommodation of change through ``the profound insight`` in Northeast Asia. The Buddhism will be the positive role of pathways to cooperation and peace in Northeast Asia Area. In the end, Buddhism will has been more active than in the past in its efforts, to promote peace order in the Northeast Asia of the post cold war era.

13권 호.title_en: Suffering of Life and Death and Liberation in Theravada Buddhism
13권 호.abstract_kr: 본 논문은 붓다의 가르침의 2개의 핵심적인 주제인 고(苦)와 그 것으로부터의 해탈(解脫)의 문제를 다루고 있다. Siddhartha 태자였던 붓다의 이러한 삶에 대한 인식은 그의 생애를 통해 성스러운 진리(四聖諦)를 추구하는 동기가 되었다. 사성제의 가르침에는 고(苦)에 대한 인간 붓다의 이해와 그 고통의 해결 방법을 제시하고 있다. 첫 번째 고성제에서 우리 인간들이 받아야함 하는 ``고``의 실상을, 심리적인 측면까지 포괄하는 깊은 분석을 하고 있다. 두 번째 진리에서는 고통의 원인을 설명하고 있다. 즐거움과, 지속적 생명의 연장이나 ``파괴적인 것``들에 대한 갈애나 탐착 등을 고(苦)를 초래하는 우리 내부적인 요인으로 분석하고 있다. 세 번째는 이 많은 탐착을 멸하는 것이 고를 멸하는 것으로 이름 하여 열반라고 하고 있다. 그리고 마지막 네 번째 진리는 이 고통을 끊는 열반의 길에 이르는 길, 팔정도를 가르치고 있다. 많은 다른 종교에서처럼, 불교에서도 고통으로부터의 궁극적인 벗어남을 무병(無病), 무괴(無壞), 무사(無死)등의 우리가 상상할 수 있는 외형적인 모습을 지속적으로 존속시키는 것으로 잘못 이해되고 있는 경향이 있다. 그러나 불교에서의 궁극적인 고통의 멸(滅)은 우리의 지속적인 외형상 존재에 대한 탐착과 욕망을 제거하는 것에 있기 때문에, 그러한 탐착과 욕망을 제거하지 않고 고(苦)로부터 해탈이라는 궁극적인 목표를 달성하기는 어렵다. 그러므로 지속적으로 즐거움을 추구하는 우리의 심리적 성향인 갈애(渴愛)를 없애는 것이 바로 생사의 고통으로부터 벗어나 열반에 이르는 길이라고 할 수 있다. 부터님의 가르침에서 열반은 정화(淨化 purification)와 해탈(解脫 liberation)의 두 용어로 표현 된다. 이 두 단어는 우리를 부정(不淨)하게 만드는 마음의 요소들을 깨끗하게 만드는 것이 ``정화``이고 또 한편에서는 그렇게 우리를 결박시키는 요소나 족쇄로부터 우리를 벗어나게 하는 것이 ``해탈``이다. 이 두 용어는 바로 해탈한 사람들을 가리키는 말이기도 하다; 해탈이란 어떤 절대적인 신적 존재에 의하여 영생(永生) 등의 형태로 주어진 은혜가 아니다. 그 것은 마음의 정화와 해탈을 이룬 결과로 얻어진, 진정으로 행복해진 마음의 상태를 말 하는 것이다. 부처님의 가르침 속에 고(苦)란 것은 일부 사람들에 의하여 주장되는 염세주의적 표현이 절대 아니다. 부처님께서 ``고``를 강조한 것은 그 것으로부터 벗어날 수 있는 방법을 제시하기 위한 것이다. 우리가 고통의 실상을 정확히 파악함으로서, 그 고통의 해결 방식을 찾고자 하신 것이다. 다시 말하자면 우리가 일단 문제의 원인을 정확히 파악하는 것이 고통으로부터 벗어나는 방법으로 보신 것이다. 그래서 붓다는 스스로 이 방법으로 해탈을 이루셨고, 일생 동안 많은 사람들에게 자신이 이룬 이 고통의 해결방법을 가르치신 것이다. 이러한 고의 멸도 방식으로 부처님뿐만 아니라 많은 제자들도 열반의 기쁨을 누렸을 뿐만 아니라, 그 가르침은 2,500년 동안 수많은 사람들에게 삶의 고통에서 벗어나 참되고 진정한 행복을 찾는 방법으로 면면히 내려오고 있는 것이다.

13권 호.abstract_kr: 「티벳사자의 서」는 기이하고도 독특한 책이다. 역사적으로 본다면 이 책은 4세기경 티벳의 영웅 Padmasambavah에 의하여 저술된 것으로 알려지고 있다. 이 책은 14세기에 Karma Lingpa에 의하여 발견되기까지 거의 알려진 바가 없다. 이 책은 1920년대에 불완전한 형태이긴 하지만 처음으로 영문판이 발간되였고, 비록 그 난해성으로 인해 충분히 이해되고 있는 책은 아니지만, 최근 동서양에 널리 알려진 책이 되었다. 이 책의 중요성을 충분히 이해하기 위해서는, 서양적인 사고에 길들여진 우리들로서는 새로운 각도에서 이 책을 읽을 필요가 있다. 아직도 우리에게는 경험주의적 서양식 사고가 지배하고 있다. 이러한 사고에 길들이진 한 우리는 항상 실험을 통한 테스트를 전세하기 마련이다. 서양의 이성적, 합리주의적 사고는 달의 정복까지 가져오고, 우리의 많은 고질적인 질병을 치유했으며, 산업혁명을 통해 우리에게 물질적인 부를 가져다 주었다. 과거 400년 동안 서구 기술문명이 꽃피는 동안, 인도를 비롯한 동잉권에서 마냥 침체된 상태로 머물러 있는 것이 아니었다. 농양에서는 우리 의식이 자리 잡은 인간의 내면세계에 대한 연구와 탐구를 끊임없이 해왔다. 시구에서는 우주인을 외계로 보내면서 과학자들과 그들의 업적을 찬양했지만, 반면 동양의 인도, 티벳, 중국 등에서는 우리 내면세계에 대한 끊임없는 탐험을 계속해 왔다. 이들은 명상과 요기 등을 통해 보이지 않는 내면 의 기(氣)에 대한 지형도를 그려왔던 것이다. 이들 요가 수행자들은, 물질적인 세계에 대해 많은 탐구자들이 지형도를 그렸듯이, 우리 마음의 세계에 파고들어 다른 차원에서의 우리 내면의 세계를 탐험했다. 불교의 가르침이 이런 종류의 내면세계에 의 탐험에 근간이 되었다. 특히, 다른 어느 곳보다도 지리적으로 다른 세계와 고립되어 있는 티벳에서 이러한 탐험을 위한 불교수행이 널리 행해졌다. 「티벳사자의 서」는 망원경이 우주의 비밀을 우리에게 풀어준 것 같이. 우리 인간의 내면의 세계를 비춰 보인 최고의 작품으로 평가된다. 이 책은 모든 사람들이 예외없이 맞아야할 죽음에의 여행을 잘 묘사하고 있다. 이 책은 우리가 맞아야할 죽음 이후의 세계에 대한 리포트일 뿐만 아니라, 안내서이기도 하다. 이 책은 살아있는 사람에게는 죽음에 연구가이드로, 죽어가는 사람에게는 죽음에 대한 준비로 읽혀질 수 있고, 죽은 사람에게는 다음 생에 항해할 수 있게끔 그 영혼을 달래줄 수 있는 책도 된다. 궁극적으로 그 목표는 인간들이 사후세계의 상태에 대한 참된 성격을 파악하게 하며, 그 것이 불가능하더라도 다음 세상에서 인간으로 태어나 불법을 수행하는 길을 제시해 줄 것이다. 이 책은 예언적인 성격을 가졌는데, 전반적으로 우리에게 긍정적인 메시지를 전달해 주고 있다. 예컨대 죽음이란 두려워해야 할 것이 아니고 우리가 차분히 냉정하게 대처해야 하는 것임을 우리에게 시시해 주고 있다. 삶은 죽음 후에도 계속이 된다. 죽음이란 우리들에게 새로운 여행이고, 아주 흥미로운 경험이며, 우리가 이생에 있는 동안 준비가 가능한 것이다. 죽음을 두려워하지 말라는 것이 책의 메시지이기도 한데 왜냐하면 죽음의 저편에는 우리의 무한한 가능성이 놓여있기 때문인 것이다.

13권 호.title_kr: 제2부 웰빙과 불교수행 : 불교적 웰빙(well-being) 담론의 가능성
13권 호.title_en: A Study on the Buddhistic Discourse of Well-Being
13권 호.abstract_kr: Well-Being has great interest for many people nowadays. In fact, the subject of Well-Being has been carried on discussion through the human history. This discussion may be continued so far as human beings exist. The subject of Well-Being is related to how we live our own life to be good. In connection with this, I have tried to find out the possibility of better life Buddhistic discourse on Well-Being. In this paper, I asserted that Buddhism pursues both the mundane happiness and unworldliness. Going one step forward, I made it clear that Buddhism teaches us not only the inside happiness but also the social principles of the practice. In this point, I tried to get rid of some misunderstanding, that is, Buddhism is exclusively interested in the inside happiness. We can say that the perfection of the self should be corresponded with the social practice. I made an attempt to seek out the models of good life from Buddhistic point of view. And I showed some instances of models from Nik?ya which is an early Buddhistic canon. I think this work will endow us with the opportunity to reflect on the present discourse of Well-Being and find out the ideal models of Well-Being.

13권 호.title_kr: 제2부 웰빙과 불교수행 : 요가의 이해와 실습 -제1부 요가의 본질과 한국요가-
제2부 웰빙과 불교수행 : 요가의 이해와 실습 -제2부 스트레스해소에 좋은 요가체위
제1분과 : 공동체와 불교 ; 인간성과 불교
13권 호.abstract_kr: French scholar, Luc Ferry describes humanity in terms of feelings and their meanings to the person experiencing them. According to a Japanese zoologist, Matzusida, chimpanzee has intelligence to recognize things, emotional capacity to feel and will to live, the three elements of mind, but it is unconscious of its knowing, that is, it is unconscious of self. The consciousness of self is the limiting line that separates the humans from animals. Is such a rationale sufficient for humans to exploit animals and nature? It has been known that animals and plants and as a matter of fact all objects that are formed in the universe have feelings(pulses), consciousness formed through feedback loops of information and will to preserve their existence. In these senses, all the objects including humans in the universe have humanity. I suppose that Buddhism takes the latter view. The feelings with meanings of the objects pervade this world, the heavens and the world of Buddha. As the objects move over from the hell to this world to the heavens and to the world of Buddha, feelings are gradually purified to mercy, compassion, joy and almsgiving. The four virtues of nirvana: eternity, delight, self and purity are interpreted to mean provision of unlimited space for sentient beings, delight of creations, the self-conscious will of the objects for self expression and the purity of mind with which sentient beings including Buddha observe the universe of the objects respectively. The creation of the objects in the universe takes the forms of association of yang(``+``) and yin(``-;). In the paper, the mercy is described in terms of he association of yin and yang; the compassion, the association of yang and yin; the joy, the competing feelings of joy between yang and yang; and almsgiving, the one-sided giving of yin and yin. Interestingly, these forms of association are what we find in the chemical reactions of matters in the universe. It is concluded what the Buddhism teaches is the workings of humanity itself, which are embodied in the physical laws of matters that have been known and the consciousness that accompany them. The image of Buddha and dharma-kaya(the body of law) are formed through the practice of the behavioral precepts for bodhi-sattva, which read: there are ``no two but one``; there is ``no emerging process``; and there is no self and ``nothing to acquire``.

14권 호.title_en: Conversation between Buddhism and New Religion
14권 호.abstract_kr: It is noticeable that the most of newly established religions have a tendency to set up their doctrine based on the existing religions and thoughts of the contemporary. Although the fundamental doctrine of a religious establishment usually bases on the initiator`s enlightenment or an epiphany, it is evident that the process of teaching and setting up of a dogma is dependent upon cultural backgrounds of the society of the contemporary. This phenomenon appears to be a norm for Korean new religions and the rest of the world as well. Appearance of Korean new religions can be traced back to the establishment of Su-woon`s Dong-hak in 1860. Following his deed numerous religions appeared, one after the other, and reached to a few hundreds including all the branches. Nevertheless, common features shared in these religious doctrines were of Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism, Christianity including atheism and shamanism, which means major religions were the roots of this phenomenon. This study focuses on the influence of Buddhism among three new Korean religions; Chun-do-gyo(Dong-hak), Cheung-san-gyo, Wonbuddhism. One noticeable factor in these three religions were that they all denied the direct relativity with Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism and yet these rooted deep in their religious system if it were to be magnified in depth. Especially Buddhism was the most influential factor amongst. If there were any differential factors, Chun-do-gyo sets its center on Confucianism in acceptance with Buddhism and Taoism. Cheung-san-gyo takes Taoism as its subject and receptive about Buddhism and Confucianism. Wonbuddhism hosts Buddhism as its main subject and also is receptive acceptance with Confucianism and Taoism. For Chun-do-gyo, its main religious practice was adopted from buddhists` through its masters Su-woon, Hae-wal, Eui-am and similarities with the Bub-sin-bul doctrin in Buddhism can be found in its three major doctrines; Chun-do, Chi-gi, In-nae-chun. The master of Cheung-san-gyo proclaimed himself as a mi-ruk-bul (Maitreya) and considered the Yong-wha-dong located beneath the Kum-san-sa as the base for the his new world, Yong-wha-hwae-sang(Naga-pusa the dragon-flower tree, which will be the bodhi-tree of Maitreya, the Buddhist messiah, when he comes to earth; his assembly will gather it and preach the Buddha-truth). It is perceivable that he wanted to draw a picture of the New World as it is described. Wonbuddhism inclined to the Buddhism as its subject because the master So-tae-san`s enlightenment was as close as to Buddha`s. And also he prescribed that buddhists` doctrines were to be Mu-sang-dae-do(the universal law) and will rule over the world```s belief. He also proclaimed that Buddha`s ethics is the only thing to be learnt and taught. Nonetheless, he emphasized on the point where long-believed Buddhism throughout the history has been newly adapted through Wonbuddhism by modernization and habitual practice and popularization.

14권 호.title_kr: 불교와 세계종교와의 대화 : 한국불교, 종교개혁이 필요한가?
14권 호.title_en: Buddhism in Korea : Does It Need the Reformation?
14권 호.abstract_kr: Buddhism in Korea is now at a crisis. To overcome this situation, the following statements should be practiced. (1). If you are to acknowledge spirit and to believe in afterlife and samsara, lower the flag of Buddhism and amalgamate with Hinduism. (2). If you are to make deification of Sakyamuni and to value much of miracle, lower the flag of Buddhism and amalgamate with Christianity. (3). If you are to tell fortune and to sell charms against bad luck, lower the flag of Buddhism and amalgamate with shamanism. (4). Instead of trisharana, it needs to be simplified into monosharana. If you are devoted to the teachings of Buddha, that is enough by itself. You do not have to be devoted to Buddha or to Buddhist monks. (5). Korean Buddhism should be operated in conjunction in all parts, such as the legislation, the administration, the judicature, and the missionary work, with participation of the fourfold community. We should model after the operating system of Korea Buddhist School in Daegu, Korea. (6). Improvement in the Buddhist monk education system should be done without delay. Activation of the education of science and foreign language is the core factor. (7). The prior conditions for the reformation of Buddhism in Korea, as mentioned above, can come to settlement if we go back to the enlightenment, to the teachings, and to the scientific mindedness of Sakyamuni. It is not that we reform. It is that we return.

14권 호.title_kr: 분과별 주제 발교 : 10.27 법난의 성격과 법적 과제
분과별 주제 발교 : 이성과 지도력
14권 호.abstract_kr: In the paper, reason is related to leadership. Reason is defined in terms of virtue, freedom and equality. Virtue is person`s capability to build order within individual person and/or in society. Order makes stable social relationship possible and to plan future. But this capability of a leader is constrained by the demands of freedom and equality of the led. The individual rights of freedom and equality are considered as their natural rights or more broadly as properties of natural units including human being in the universe. Thomas Teal proposes four desirable qualities(or personality characteristics) of the manager of organization: imagination, integrity, empowerment and heroism. A modern and industrialized society is a large-scale organization and Teal`s four desirable qualities are sought in the political leadership of the democratic government. Imagination is required to shape disparate things on criteria provided in the orient by the concepts of mid-ways. Integrity is best kept by not telling lies to oneself. Empowerment of capable subordinates with delegated power is built on the trust that leader has on them. Heroism is needed to create value where none existed; doing right, productive and beneficial things; and conceiving a vision and staying true to it. There are other qualities that can be thought of. But what personality qualities are best suited to solve the social problems encountered depends on the particular situations demanding them.

14권 호.title_en: The Appearance of Locana figure and the Establishment of Trikaya(三身) -Represented in the <Five-Buddha Painting> in Jurinzi Temple, Hyogo-
14권 호.abstract_kr: Buddhist art is generally interpreted and treated in inseparable relationship with the history of Buddhism or the Buddhist policy of that era. If a general idea like this will be accompanied, the Buddhist art in early-Joseon period when strong oppression policy against Buddhism took place cannot escape from existing evaluation which is the darkest period of Buddhism. However, as I was carrying out field work in Japan where most of early Joseon period pieces reside, I was able to encounter masterpieces breaking this common idea that early half of Joseon Period was the darkest era for Buddhism and Buddhist art as well. Among the masterpieces that I have researched, in this paper I particularly would like to take the outstanding piece <Five-Buddha Painting(五불尊도)> in Jurinzi temple at Hyogo Japan into consideration, in order to reveal what Buddhist art was really like at the time. Considering the elaborate expression and philosophical concept shown in th painting, it goes without saying that this piece stands at the highest peak of all other paintings of the period. The basic concepts of the painting, the characteristic links to the works of other neighboring countries like China and Japan, and the role it played in the Joseon society have been examined in this paper based upon the chronological and typological analysis. The painting is composed of five bodies of Buddha which are Vairocana, Locana, Sakyamuni, Amitabha and Bhaishajyaguru. Vairocana is entitled Darmakaya, the embodiment of the Law, Locana is entitled Sambhogakaya, the embodiment of purity and bliss, and Sakyamuni is entitled Nirmanakaya or Buddha revealed. These Trikaya(三身) are arranged in vertical line. And Amitabha and Bhaishajyaguru are added to both left and right side of Locana in a horizontal row forming a set of three-buddha(三佛, Locana is usually substituted for Sakyamuni in late-Joseon period) which are usually known as Tryadhva-Buddha(三世佛). In this paper, I defined them as Sambhogakaya-triad(報身三佛) and explained why. Locana is carefully placed in the center forming a cross shape composition exposing its two aspects, one as Buddhahood for his own bliss(自受用身) in vertical line and the other as Buddhahood for the sake of others(他受用身) in horizontal line. A remarkable characteristic of the painting that I would like to point out is the iconographical feature of Locana. Locana in a vitarka mudra(說法印) should be represented in Buddha figure without any ornament but here it takes the form of luxuriant Bodhisattva figure with high crown and jewels. By the appearance of Bodhisattva style Locana figure bearing these iconographical characteristics, big change occurs in existing trend that was formed Virocana as a main figure. With such a Locana in the center, Trikaya and three-buddha(or Sambhogakaya-triad) settle down as dominant figure throughout Joseon period. It can be said that this piece of painting stands at the pivotal point of this new trend and shows a principle of unity(會通) of various Buddhist images that were most popular throughout the history. Gloriously decorated Locana figure placed in the center is the key icon symbolizing the harmony of all the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

14권 호.title_kr: 제2분과 : 문화예술과 불교 ; 경남지역 범패 전승에 관한 연구
14권 호.title_en: A Study on the Bumpae Tradition of Kyungnam Province
14권 호.abstract_kr: Currently, there has been growing interest towards the Buddhist music, song and dance which were forgotten and abandoned by the temples as well. It has started to recognized as important cultural value among many different religious sect, parties and devotees. There were movements to carry out the new style of Buddhist ceremony that combines music, song and dance which has been prohibited for a long time among Chogye Order of Buddhism in Korea. Different religious orders were also trying to gather scattered tradition of their own with monks who once performed songs and dances but were forgotten for a long time. Buddhist priest Hanpa wishes to have monks who are spread all around the Youngnam area-where the Tongboem sori originated from- who used to perform Tongboem sori (chanting) be back in Boemosa temple to praise and console the dead abd the alive. By giving a higly artistic and religious performances of buddhist ritual ceremonies such as Youngsan-jae and Suryuk-jae, the old tradition of the specious Buddhist culture will revive among the monks and the devotees. By doing so, these kind of tradition that the Boemosa temple is making will also diverse the cultural standardization and step forward to diverse the Korean culture itself.

14권 호.title_kr: 제3분과 : 사회 윤리, 환경 문제와 불교 ; 고령 장애인 고용지원 정책의 과제
제3분과 : 사회 윤리, 환경 문제와 불교 ; 구출갈마(驅出갈磨)에 대한 고찰
14권 호.title_en: A Survey on the Banishment of Buddhist Community
14권 호.abstract_kr: This study aims to identify pabbajaniya which is temporary expelled from the monastic community. The monastic community that set up an ideal with harmony has established religious precepts for comfort, harmony, and leadership. This is called patimokkha or pratimok asutra. Bhikkhu or Bhikkhuni(buddhist monk or nun) should keep these precepts, otherwise s/he is required an equivalent punishment for this. One of these punishments is a banishment. The banishment includes two types, a complete banishment and a temporary one from the monastic community. There are asa vasa and nasana in the complete expulsion and nanasa vasaka, asa bhoga, and pabbajana in the temporary bansishment. Pabbajaniya is a temporary banishment which is placed to a person who commits kuladusaka and papasamacara. The monastic community conducts pabbajaniya kamma through natthi-cathuttha-kamma to the bhikkhu who commits kuladusaka and papasamacara, and it makes the bhikkhu take parivasa, rescuing him from his place. The purpose of the parivasa is to make bhikkhu repent the evil deeds he made, separating him from the place of the misdoings. However, bhikkhu does not have to receive pabbajaniya-kamma, if he admits and repents his mis-deeds. Because the aim of the kamma is to repent and improve, he does not have to take the kamma if a bhikkhu immediately repents. If bhikkhu took the pabbajaniya-kamma because of his non-confession, it is possible for the him to return to the monastic community with a untie-kamma from the monastic community by repenting and doing the regulations. A bhikkhu can exercise his banned rights by returning to the monastic community as long as he repents because the period of the punishment has not been regularly decided. The bhikkhu who has been temporary exiled should perform the strict ascetic practices with repentance in the parivasa before escaping his sin. All of the practices of the punishment kamma are an positive action which enables the wrongdoing bhikkhu to repent his sins and change bad habits in order to be a clean bhikkhu. These actions are the parivasa from the people, and makes the bhikkhu stop his rights temporarily. Pabbajaniya is just a punishment in order to control the monastic community where large number of people live and to be reborn as a pure disciplinant. Pabbajaniya is also a merciful consideration of the monastic community for the wicked bhikkhu to restore his purity, discarding the evil deeds with repentance through the separated life from a group of pure bhikkhu for a while.

14권 호.title_kr: 제4분과 : 불교겅전과 교학 ; 일원상(一圓相) 란전주(丹田住) 선(禪)의 원리와 체험
14권 호.title_en: Principle and Practical Experience of Seon Practice of Il-Won-Sang Dan-Jeon-Ju
14권 호.abstract_kr: Seon(禪) practice is not difficult or miraculous, but very easy way of practice to search out home of own mind. Principle of Seon is to recover the original state that is most natural and comfortable both in mind and body. It means that recapture the vitality of body and restoration of original nature of mind. The principle of Seon practice of Il-Won-Sang Dan-Jeon-Ju(一圓相 丹田住) is the way of harmonious unification of mind, body and breath through the breath meditation which is one minute for one breath basis, while Dan-Jeon breathing in the condition of resting in Dan-Jeon(丹田住). The significance of Seon practice of Il-Won-Sang Dan Jeon-Ju is that everyone easily can experience the state of samadhi in meditation. It needs quite a lot of effort up to one minute. However, since if one overcome the height, one can feel the true taste of Seon, so that it has a tendency to be naturally and easily done without the notion of difficulty. It can be considered that the virtue of Seon is limitless though, from the view point of writer, it has been explained in two folds, the virtue of mind study and accompanied effect.
keywords_en: mutual work process of Seon and kyo

14권 호.title_kr: 제4분과 : 불교겅전과 교학 ; 선(禪)과 밀교의 소통에 관한 연구
제4분과 : 불교겅전과 교학 ; 조계종 표준 한글 금강경과 무비,조현춘 공역 한글 금강경 비교
제4분과 : 불교겅전과 교학 ; 빨리 연구에 대한 재고
14권 호.title_en: A Review of the Issues in Pali (Language and Literature)
14권 호.abstract_kr: It is generally accepted that the Buddhist Pali canon was compiled in the form of oral tradition at the First and the Second Buddhist Councils which were held soon after the Buddha`s Parinibbana, and that those texts in Pali were written down in Sri Lanka. We find some basic ideal conditions on the authoritarian power given to Pali literature, though from multilateral angles there are many questions remained in the field of studies of Pali language and literature such as the origin and development of Pali language, subjective groups of its compilation, basic standard to classify the literatures, etc. This is a work to sketch some issues which have been suggested to the origin and development of Pali language and literature from a historical perspective for revaluation of its historicity.

15권 2호.abstract_kr: Democracy is a much-contested concept. But fundamentally it is a system based on both representation and deliberation which are to be combined together and harmonized each other. Structural changes in our contemporary society prompt us to have more concerns about the two elements of democracy. As political participations of citizens are actively enlarged, it becomes more important to ensure deliberation capacity of democratic system. In this regard, special attention is to be paid to politically-tipping phenomena recently coming out in Korean society. The 2008 Candlelight Meeting in protest against the Government decision to import US meat was an example of such phenomena which drew our attention to deliberation. A question of how such phenomenon matches well with the deliberation capacity of the Korean society may be raised, while it can be regarded as the activation of public sphere in civil society. This issue is pressed upon us, especially because Korean society now faces the increasing threat of hatred coming out of confrontations between the conservatives and the liberals. Splits and hatred spread over the Korean society would weaken its deliberation capacity implying mutual communication and rationality for the better quality of its collective decision. It may be a new topic in the discourse of political sociology that how such deliberation capacity can be built up in Korea. A solution to reduce substantially hatred between both of ideological groups and rebuild newly the Korean community can be found in Buddhism. That is why the Buddhism way of thinking that has been long rooted in the Korean traditional culture is believed to play a very major role in mitigating ideological confrontations and hatred in the society.

15권 2호.title_en: The Korean economic polarization problem and solution from Buddhism
15권 2호.abstract_kr: The important topic of Korea economy in the 21st century is economic polarization. As economy becomes sophisticated, and science and technology gets developed, the income gap between citizens is growing. This is not only Korea`s problem but also many economic advanced countries`problem. If we neglect this economic problem, it would cause more serious social problem with more sophisticated conflict between citizens. And this will endanger the national safety in the end. This research suggests two approaches to solve this economic problem. The first approach is by economic policy. It is focused on how to distribute national wealth to decrease economic polarization. The second approach is from Buddhism`s view point. First of all, the approach by economic policy is the solution to increase economic minorities` income through national direct support and creating constructive corporate economic environment to encourage job market. Here, the imbalance of information is an important issue. It is important to distribute information properly to achieve the goal of economical policy. If Government doesn`t have proper information, then national wealth could be misused in wrong way. The next problem is about moral hazard. Most countries encourage job creation by supporting corporations to solve economic polarization problem. However misdirectedsupport would cause the concentration of wealth on large corporations and this will worsen the economic gap between large corporations and small/mid market companies. That is the reason to require high level of business ethic to entrepreneurs in Buddhism`s view. Entrepreneurs are granted a role of an oracle to contribute the increase of national income in place of Government. The Middle Way of Buddhism is also required to entrepreneurs. Creating job is the most progressive and constructive almsgiving. Furthermore, conflict between management and the unions would bring severe loss to both. Therefore, we have to recognize each other as a moral being with people`s mind and the nature of Buddha. Economic polarization would be solved when the entrepreneurs with the Buddhism`s mind lead Korea economy.
