19권 2호.abstract_en: 돈황 문헌(Dunhuang Manuscripts)에서 金光明經(Sūtra of Golden light)류 관련된 사본들의 특징을 조사한다. 경전의 완성 시기는 인도에서 왕권강화가 일어나는 4-5세기 전후로 보며, 중국인들이 경전의 내용을 수용한 이후로 異譯본들이 출현한 것으로 보인다. 호국적인 성향이 강한 「金光明經」과 「合部金光明經」은 중국에서부터 번역에 고심하여 수정하고 보완하여 증장되어 온 역사를 소유하고 있다.「金光明經」 일부에서는 고려대장경과 돈황문헌에서 일치하는 부분, 삭제된 부분, 중복된 부분 등을 구별해 낼 수도 있다. 고려대장경과 돈황 문헌의 비교에 따라 필사한 사람의 의도를 추정할 수도 있다. 돈황 사본에서 「金光明經」은 북경본이 64개, 러시아(俄藏)본 12개, 스타인(Stein)본 44개, 펠리오(Pelliot)본 11개가 있다. 북경본이 49%, 俄藏9%, 스타인34%, 펠리오 8%가 있다.돈황사본에서 「合部金光明經」 북경본이 13개, 러시아본 33개, 스타인본 26개, 펠리오본 2개가 있다. 북경본이 17%, 俄藏 33%, 스타인49%, 펠리오 1%가 있다. 돈황사본에서는 이역본들에 관련된 광범위한 유통이 진행된 것으로 보이며, 경전들이 품명의 다양성, 그리고 어떠한 경전들이 당시에 필사되었는가를 고려대장경 및 신수대장경과 대조비교를 통해 알 수 있다.
keywords_en: the Overall Compilation of the Sūtra of Golden Light

19권 1호.title_en: A Buddhist View on the Multiculturalism in Korea
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The Korean multiculturalism assumes Korea a multicultural society and regards the ethnic homogeneity of Korea is an important obstacle to the promotion of understanding, tolerance and friendship among the different ethnic and national groups living on its territory. It wants to develop Korea into a westernized multicultural society. But Korean society is in the early stage of immigration not a multicultural one for there is not a single national or ethnic group even if there are ethnic minority individuals in Korea. Multiculturalism in Korea doesn`t reflect reality in Korea but has become only a pretext for the abolition of discrimination in general. And the major source of the discriminative behavior to the different ethnic and racial persons in Korea is not the ethnic homogeneity of Korea but the new psychological and economic situation occurred by the mass immigration in a short period. The Buddhist ideal for the imagined multicultural society of Korea is the harmonized world among individuals and different cultures where every individual and every culture makes a most of it`s create ability and be in harmony among them like a world of the Avatamska sutra. To achieve such ideal, policy targets should not be the specific cultural group but man in general who is the principal agent of the society. And the policy should respect not only align cultures but also Korean traditional culture. The main point of the policy should shift from the existing support policy to the Buddhist symbiotic and win-win policy. The target of the multicultural policy should encourage the participation and contribution to build a happy and prosperous Korean community.

19권 1호.title_en: A Study on the Insight into the Original nature way of Dajian Huineng
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The sixth ancestor, Dajin Huineng(618-713) is preeminent figure of China`s Zen heritage from mind to mind. The main source of information about Huineng`s life is a text of his teaching known as the Platform Sutra. From a religious standpoint, the text expounds and supports the sudden nature of Zen enlightenment. The insight into the original nature way had been stressed over and over again by way of pure Zazen practice way, dialogue communication way and answering to zen question way. As for the few examples of the insight described in the Platform Sutra, it is can be said that all needed for the insight is not the seating meditation nor the cultivation of mindfulness. The concerning to his bodily training or concentration of mind with the intentional effort to get rid of delusion is noting but a effort to be a non-living being. Human mind is naturally of flux and moving. How could it be fixed to tranquillity like a piece of wood or a rock. First, to get insight into his own nature, pure Zazen practice way is important. The original face of mind is just to be looked. The original nature transcends that kind of dualism. The observer is the observed. Also, the Insight is the Nature itself. The original nature is pure and perfect. Second, the dialogue communication with the master is also important. With his questioning and answering, he can take look back his original face suddenly. Nature is just to be seen, but not to be practiced because it is originally pure. It is thus Sudden Enlightenment. Dajian Hui-neng strongly recommend to read the Diamond Sutra and the Platform Sutra over again. To say again, the Sutra can be regarded as a training masters. To read carefully the sutra is to get the dialogue communication with the masters. When he came to be accepted by his master, it will be useless unless he ask for his questions earnestly. Thus, he has to keep his sincerity in mind before the encounter with his master. Next step to the insight into the nature will be looking away from the other`s shortcomings. We are needed to answer to zen question. The ultimate meaning is to get a insight into the nature. This does not some sequent steps. This is the way to the Sudden Enlightenment. Thus, the insight described in the Platform Sutra can be regarded as the way to attain it. It means that the end and its way are not divided from each other, and the dualistic phenomenon can be harmonized in Sudden Enlightenment and sudden practice. From this standpoint of view, we does not practice bodily training to attain the insight into the original nature. The insight can be pursued by itself such as pure zen practice way, dialogue communication way and answering to zen question way.
keywords_en: The insight into the original nature

19권 1호.title_en: Roles of the Venerable Monk in Multicultural Society -Focused on Silla society-
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The purposes of this study are first, analyzing that Silla society was a multicultural society, not an isolated monocultural society and second, what kind of role did Venerable monks, highest intellectual group in Silla socity, played related to multicultural society, third, through this process, we should think about what kind of role should Buddhist play in 21st century Korean society as a new multicultural society. Foundation of Silla dynasty has not started from the natives, who maintained monoculture, but migrants who had different cultures. Therefore, it is safe to say that Silla was multicultural society since the beginning. However, it was introduction of Buddhism that made Silla as a actual multicultural society, not nominal multicultural society based merely on ethnicity. Venerable monks in Silla played as 3 roles following: cultural transferor, culture creator, and cultural mediator. In the begging of 6th century, a number of monks left to Ancient India or Tang Dynasty to study abroad for Buddhism, and eventually they made East Asia as more opened and culturally diversified society, by transferring cultures native cultures to other area. Also, Venerable monks created new Silla culture based on the culture from other areas while suggesting harmonies and logics for solving contradictions according to Buddhism ideas, such as Hwajaeng(和諍) theory and Wonyoung(圓融) thought. This thesis also covers that it helped a lot solving the confliction with other beliefs like shamanism or Confucianism. These acts that Venerable monks have performed in Silla society urge Buddhist in modern days to break away from passive role, and to perform active cultural role.

19권 1호.title_en: A Way for Reforming Presidential Election System of the Jogye Order in Korean Buddhism
19권 1호.abstract_kr: This paper is an attempt to show way for reforming the Jogye Order`s electoral system with a focus on the Presidential election The Presidential election of Jogye Order is being condemned from Buddhist society as well as non-Buddhist society, because that is so corruption. Problem is not blame own but the content of criticism. It is a serious blow to the identity of Jogye Order, so-called clean Sangha. The necessity of the study on way for reforming is provided by the situation. This paper is not presents the concreted way for reforming electoral system, rather than to emboss acting values as a background of the system. Because the system is a tool to realize the value. So I will do to observe that the electoral system of Jogye Order will help or not to pursue of Buddhist core values. For the efficiency of the work, first of all, I look at the basic features of the election. I view the political values to achieve through the election. And I will do to examine that Jogye Order be going to realize what and how through election relelated Jongbeop and Jongheon. I will propose two ways to improve through the review. One is to suggest the viewpoint of principle that matches the identity of the Sangha, and the other one is the direction focused on the possibility of realization here and now.
keywords_en: President of the Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism. Jogye Order of Korean Buddhism

19권 1호.title_kr: 불교사상과 기업의 사회적 책임에 관한 소고
19권 1호.title_en: A Study on the Coporate Social responsibility and Buddhist Thought
19권 1호.abstract_kr: Global corporations that enter the global market in the global economic crisis must observe regulations and systems in various countries, and consider their own interests and interested parties at the same time. Innovation starts from proper distribution, fairness and tolerance which in some case do burden and cause pain to the corporation. Capitalism 5.0 that is the integration of fair society and capitalism says it that poverty and disease in the undeveloped countries influence citizens in the developed countries, so that they get over the limits of the national egoism. Actualizing the capitalism 5.0 or fair capitalism, it needs social responsibility of corporation. Moreover meeting the interests of corporations and interested parties creates the shared value, enhances productivity of corporation and regional societies, constructs effective business system, creates many jobs and increases sustainable development. There is Buddhist thought in the middle of creation of the shared value. The idea of Bodhisattva which is in the essence of Buddhist thought means the altruistic behavior or service. It can be perfecting others, ethical management and total dedication management. Ethical management is concerned with the value which must be observed in the process of pursuit for profits in the corporations. And total dedication management is concerned with how corporation`s profit must be shared with society. Buddhist management paradigm is characterized as perfecting of himself for perfecting others, total dedication, ethics, wisdom and change based management.
keywords_en: Thought of Perfecting of Himself for Perfecting others

19권 1호.title_kr: 다문화적 관점에서 바라본 도시 사찰건축에 관한 연구
19권 1호.title_en: A Study on the Issue of Urban Buddhist Temple Architecture in the Multi-Cultural Society`s Perspective
19권 1호.abstract_kr: In the multi-cultural society of Korea where 95% of the population reside in cities, it is of high value to investigate the way of designing and operating urban Buddhist architecture, whose formalities and contents are incomplete. This study examines the beginning of Sangharama, problems of urban Buddhist temple architecture in Korea, and architectural requirements of urban Buddhist temples. The findings are as follows: 1) Since a city is an aggregate of cultures by its very nature, it is necessary to re-establish a nation of Buddhism in a city as well, and the study on its response, adaptation, and change upon the vertical arrangement of Sangharama rather than the horizontal one needs to be diversified accordingly. 2) Sangharama in the city inevitably involves a limited use of woods or roofing tiles because of its vertical structure. As architectural materials have been advanced, however, a variety of design types may be applied in modern architecture. Hence, Buddhist temples may seem irrelevant to each other without uniformity or symbolism unless the archetype is reconsidered in correspondence to urban features. 3) As there may be a number of individuals or groups with cultures heterogeneous from those of Buddhism in the city, a linear and systematic response in a long-term perspective is necessary in the area of architectural design as well. 4) As for the operation of Buddhist temples, it is vital to take advantage of experts in various areas who are familiar with multi-cultural backgrounds as well as Buddhist priests. In other words, specialization and diversification are to be reflected in the frame of Sangharama in the city in a harmonious and integrated manner. 5) Newly built Buddhist temples in the city, many of which are still built of wood and involve lower heat insulation efficiency, may utilize various modern-day technologies to reduce energy consumption and prevent fire or robbery. 6) As Buddhist priests who are familiar with old traditions of Buddhism and have absolute influence on the construction of Buddhist temples may not understand or embrace new modern designs or spatial utilization techniques, newly built Buddhist temples are likely to be of ambiguity, neither fully reflecting the arrangements and designs of traditional Buddhist temples nor clearly adopting modern designs. This is an aspect that requires an appreciative eye and a lot of research on the part of the building owner.

19권 1호.title_en: The Social Science point of view on the Buddha`s Attitude to the Suicide
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The paper attempts to explain the Buddha`s attitude on suicide from the viewpoint of Social Science. Much of what is written on suicide from a Buddhist viewpoint tends to try to establish whether suicide is permissible for Buddhists. The majority of Buddhists and the scholars of Buddhism take the view that suicide is acceptable for the Arhat. There is a division in morality between the suicidal act of an arhat and non-arhat in the Buddhism. But from the Social Scientist point of view, the focus would be located at not whether the suicidal act of an arhat or non-arhat, but the situations that the act is committed. The paper reviews the three cases of the suicide of arhats, Goddhika, Vakkali, Channa, considering the facts that all of them were on the situations of the unendurablephysical sufferings, probably of the very old ages. Although the majority of the scholars seem to agree that the case of Channa gives the best evidence that the Buddha condoned suicide, the Buddha`s concluding statement to the suicide, “Without reproach was the knife was used by the brother Channa”, is not necessary to the conclusion that Buddhism condones suicide. The meaning of the Buddha`s comment is not acknowledge the suicide, or justifying it, but the “acceptance” of the situation what the monks who are suffering from a serious degenerative illness.

19권 1호.title_en: Multicultural Society and viewpoint of Early Buddhism
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The research tries to search for the light proof in the early Buddhist Scriptures on the Buddha`s view in touching with other religious people. That is to say, the research tries to analyze Buddha`s spirit of mutual respect. In order to this purpose, the research is comprised of three parts. First, I should examine the Buddha`s view of racial discrimination in the four castes. The topic of the study is to be in search of the Buddhist roles and essential perspectives, which would be crucial in the age of multicultural society. Second, the dispute was criticized by Buddhha. What was criticized repeatedly in the ancient Buddhist canons is that one will adhere to a certain opinion, believe that opinion in truth absolutely, and take hostile stance against other insists. In other words, in colliding with other cultures, thoughts, and cultural differences, one should not defend his opinion and argue against other ones but adhere to his own opinion, which can be serious problem. That`s why the Buddha cherish the mind of metta. Third, we should pay attention to Buddha`s attitude in that he took stance of the flexible and tolerant attitude on the aspects of Buddhist principles and other religions without falling into certain insists and opinions. He didn`t hesitate to demonstrate that we should receive any cultures, if the other cultures could bring about ``the effect reasonable and beneficient.

19권 1호.title_en: An Identity Problem of Korean Buddhism in the Multicultural Society
19권 1호.abstract_kr: The discussion about multiculturalism has been increased everywhere in Korean society since 1990`s. The various types of immigrants have been gradually increased. Now we have to admit them as constituents of the nation. It exceeds a simple dimension of consideration policy for them. It means that new era has approached in Korean society. I brought an identity problem of Korean Buddhism in this paper according to the arrival of multiculturalism. The problem has become an important issue from the liberation of Korea until now. The movement for establishing identity of Korean Buddhism is in progress. The movement tried to restore and succeed Buddhism of national tradition. The latest discussion about identity problem shows an opinion which sets up Ganhwa-Seon as an identity of Korean Buddhism and has to globalize it. However the discussion about multiculturalism functions a confusion or a variable on this identity problem of Korean Buddhism. The discussion of multiculturalism in Korean society should be progressed with national problem, national unification. If we understand the peculiarity of formation progress of multiculturalism in Korea and western society, we can`t confine the discussion of nationalism and multiculturalism as two opposiong opinions. I tried to show the necessity of groping progress about the new identity of Korean Buddhism according to the arrival of multicultural society through this paper.

19권 1호.title_en: The Buddhist Comtemplation Practice of Master JinBodhi as a Principle of Reconciliation in the Mutlicultural Society of Korea
19권 1호.abstract_kr: This paper examines the Bodhi Meditation of Chinese Buddhist Master JinBodhi, focusing on the Meditation of Greater Illumination as the unique contemplation practice methodology that stimulates physical renewal and promotes general health. Acclaimed as a natural stress relief system, it further revitalizes the mind and frees the spirit, facilitating improvements in both mental clarity and physical well-being. Master JinBodhi developed Bodhi methodology after eighteen years studying traditional philosophy and meditation on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau of China. In 1991, he emerged from this period of intensive training to great acclaim as a meditation master. From then on, he has taught and inspired vast multitudes of people throughout Asia. Master JinBodhi`s methodology is based on the ancient Eastern philosophy of compassion, an understanding of humanity`s interconnectivity and its inseparability from the natural world. The author argues that combining Ganwha-Seon and Bodhi Meditation practices would offer an new alternative to the Buddhist in the Korean multicultural society. Since the Bodhi Meditation applies traditional practices to the challenges of modern living, it results in a uniquely effective meditation system that holistically enhances immunity, stamina and state of mind. The techniques are accessible and practical, yielding results quickly. As such, they are particularly well-suited to the pressures of urban life ? and the health issues that result from them. In its mere 20 years of availability to the public, Bodhi Meditation has already benefited millions. All are welcome, irrespective of age, religion or personal background.

20권 1호.title_en: A Study on the Diamond Sutra Reciting Practice
20권 1호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this study is to examine the diamond sutra reciting practice as a new Buddhist practice. The founder of this practice was Dr. Baek Sung-wook. former 2ns president of Dongguk University for whom his followers revered as a living Buddha. The diamond sutra reciting practitioners accept the diamond sutra as the highest level of the Buddha`s teachings which shows the way to attaining Buddhahood. They recite the sutra every day and offer everything to the Buddha chanting “Mirugjonyeoraibul” (Maitreya) who is the future Buddha respected by Therevada as well as Mahayana Buddhism. In their daily life when they have their wish they make their wish on the Buddha not for themselves. The benefits of reciting diamond sutra practice are innumerable. Reciting diamond sutra transforms the body and mind of the practitioner day by day. The bright light of diamond sutra changes the cells of his body slowly from corrupted black to clear clean thereby extinguishing disasters from him. By practicing unintended offering to the Buddha as the sutra teaches the merit that you collect are inconceivable, unbelievable, and unimaginable. Through reciting the sutra we plant a seed to realize emptiness and come to attain prajn?(wisdom) and finally achieve the bodhisattva`s mind. Then we are able to bring all sentient beings to Buddha world. That is the our final goal of our life, whether this or next life.

20권 1호.title_kr: 현대인의 정신적 위기 극복으로서의 성철(性徹)의 간화선 사상
20권 1호.title_en: Seong-cheol`s Ganhwa Seon Thought as a Principle of reconcilation of the Mental Crisis of Modern Man
20권 1호.abstract_kr: This paper examines Seong- cheol`s Ganhwa Seon Thought as a Principle of reconcilation of the Mental Crisis of Modern Man. During the last few decades there have been enormous developments in science and technology which have practically changed the face of the earth. But in spite of the great achievements in science and technology, we find that there prevails a certain chaos and confusion at all levels － individual, social, moral, religious, political, national and international. We find people going from bad to worse everyday. There is confusion and anarchy at all levels of human existence. In the face of these circumstances the need of the hour is the spiritual regeneration of human society. Master Seong-cheol(1912-1993) was a mentor who lived with us in the same age. In the Seonmun- jeongro, he delivered the preaching of the middle path. From the viewpoint of Seong-cheol Seon, Sudden enlightenment-gradual cultivation is incomplete theory of Enlightenment. Nevertheless, it has been regarded as a guiding principle of Seon practice for last over 8 hundred years of Korean Seon. Therefore Seong-cheol criticized the theory of Sudden enlightenment gradual cultivation strongly, and expounded the true meaning of ultimate Enlightenment which can be attained only through Sudden enlightenmentsudden cultivation. The meaning of Seong-cheol Seon in the history of Buddhism lies in the fact that he clarified the supreme principle of Buddhim is the Middle Path in his Dharma Teachings. The distinguishing points in His understanding of the Middle Path are as follows. First, according to him, the meaning of the Middle Path is blocking up of both sides of one`s viewpoint, that is, giving up relative contradiction entirely. To get the great freedom of one`s mind, one must leave from both sides of the practical world, and then one can reach a point where both the sides are illuminated totally. This world of the Middle Path is regarded as ``a realm without hindrance``. Second, according to Master Seong-cheol, all beings of the world are empty. However, this does not mean that that they are nothingness. All beings are empty in the sense of the Middle path, that is, that are empty beyond the contradiction between affirmation and negation. It is because not only all living beings have Buddha-nature but also their own nature is empty that we can see Self-nature and realize nirv?na from sa?s?ra by means of removing avidy? or fundamental ignorance. Since Buddha resides in every home, your parents are Buddha. So serving your parents is a genuine Buddhist offering. Since Buddha lives on every str eet, the poor and the weak are Buddha. So serving them is a genuine offering. Since Buddha is everywhere, we have an eternity of incalculable offerings to make. The joy of living can be found in serving and making offerings to all these countless Buddhas! Serving Buddhas everywhere is the noble vow of all Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, and the very basis of Buddhism. So we should be eternally grateful to the Buddha S?kyamuni for teaching us this noble law, and we should lead a life full of genuine Buddhist offerings. The Middle Path and Buddhist offering form the crux of his philosophy and represent the metaphysics and ethics he preached and practised. Hence I prefer to call Seong-cheol`s philosophy metaphysical ethics.

20권 1호.title_en: Right Judgement of the Information Society in a Buddhistic Way
20권 1호.abstract_kr: This paper recognizes the various characteristics and problems arising in the information society as an intrinsic properties of the world of suffering (sabha) instead of a phenomena accompanying the development of information technology. Sakyamuni Buddha gave a sermon to his disciples and followers to seek a path building the Buddhist Elysium Elysium (Sukk?vat?). The practice of the Buddha`s disciplines to make the sabha a Sukk?vat?, are considered as practical plans of the current information society. General systems theory, which may be the most important changes in the modern thoughts and science to think the reality as a dynamic and systematic process without substance, is surveyed briefly and it is tried to elucidate that the Buddhistic perspectives of the world of suffering and the information society are not farfetched interpretation and religious dogmatic approach, which distort the society phenomenon to religious doctrine of Buddhism, but more scientific and academic approach. This paper investigates how the information society development have an influence on the whole society, specifically the religious world, and the establishment of future Buddhism movement direction. Furthermore, it emphasizes Buddhism gives a direction for not only the special situations of the information society, but also by the universal values of human freedom and liberty and manifestation of the Buddhist Elysium. At this point, the fundamental Buddhism will be shared and developed as the spirit of the twenty-first century.

20권 1호.title_en: A Study on New Mahayana movement in the Information society
20권 1호.abstract_kr: The Offerings to Buddha in the information society are to make life activities taking place in the information network and to give benefits helping to protect the activity. The internet in information society makes ``uninterrupted Faith life’ possible in order to realize the public worship of the temple and chanting cyber ritual at anytime and at anywhere. It makes Sublime Dharma Hall to make his own ritual, and to take advantage of the Buddhist contents as the community services to the public common. We have to reconstruct the vast Buddhist scriptures and the wealth of story telling as the discours of the spirit of the age to survive. In this story-telling of Buddhist discours make easy approach to difficult Buddhist contents and to mitigate prejudices. You can also take advantage of a variety of Buddhist contents through the application development. The advent of smart phones has made the mobile networks as a communicative community. In the spirit of sharing and development of open source applications, Bodhisattva can be shared with the public common. From the practical point of view, the thinking and practicing in the way of ‘application Buddhism`` development is urgently required. To understand the accessible content from a Buddhist perspective has to be developed in the many social problems such as abortion and contraception, multiple identities, and war and violence. New Mahayana movement in information society is based on the ‘Mahayana Faith’ to the ``single-minded`` to practice to be beneficient both me and others, which is the essence of the practice of Bodhisattva. To serve others can be accomplished in the realm of both the mental world and material world. Effects of magnetic force can be grown in the mind of remuneration in exchange of something through the practice of Mahayana movement. To establish the identity in the modern multi-cultural society and to participate in the smart network to open a platform to the participation required. Therefore we can build the public common service based on smart media. In some cases, the aesthetics of the venture such as ``delightful ruin`` should be excised in the information over-supply situation. ``Smart network`` participation, ``smart media`` sharing, ``Buddhism Archive’ for the practice of opening have to be accompanied towards the Bodhisattva practice to the necessity of this modern information society as the characteristics of social knowledge. It is necessary to serve platform as well as the Buddha`s message of Buddhism according to the restoring of record cultural heritage and to cause the public action for the comfort and happiness should be expanded reproduction as the way of Awakening Bodhisattva.

20권 1호.title_kr: 조계종(曹溪宗) 표준(標準) 김강경(金剛經)에 대한 교감(校勘)(Ⅱ)
20권 1호.abstract_kr: I corrected chapter 1∼5 of Jogye order Diamond Sutra in my previous paper (Renewed Diamond Sutra(Ⅰ). In this paper, I corrected chapter 6∼10 of Jogye order Diamond Sutra. As well as I know, all scholars translated the Diamond Sutra that he had and did not make any effort to find a perfect Diamond Sutra. As result, all of the Diamond Sutra has many severe problems. On the support of Huayen Sutra and Whitehead Study Group, I propose renewed more perfect Diamond Sutra. In this paper, I propose the special form of 4-4-4-4 letter Diamond Sutra.

20권 1호.title_en: Religion Model of Won Buddhism Doctrinal Chart and Modern Religion
20권 1호.abstract_kr: In Won Buddhism doctrinal chart, Il-Won-Sang(One Circle Image, ?), the target of faith and target of example and enlightenment is placed at the top center and the gateway of faith and the gateway of practice are placedat both sides of bottom left and right. And the concept of Il-Won-Sang(一圓相) and transmission verse(偈頌) are placed at the bottom center of Il-Won-Sang. Therefore, the structure of doctrinal chart consists of the gateway of faith and the gateway of practice and the principle of the nature (性理). The first religion model pursued by doctrinal chart is faith in a religion based on truth. Second is practice as training in morality based on facts. Third is Il-Won-Sang as the target of enlightenment. Fourth is the harmony of faith, practice and enlightenment. The first religious orientation of modern people is reflection on incorrect religion phenomena in the crisis era of material civilization. Second, modern people have doubts about wishing good luck and exclusive faith and tend to be indifferent to religion due to the development of modern science and benefits of social welfare system. Third, they want to participate in spiritual master centered practice programs and spiritual development programs to enjoy practice culture such as DanJeonJu-Seon(丹田住禪) or Ganhwa-Seon (看話禪), meditation, mindfulness etc. The religion model of Won Buddhism doctrinal chart presents the exemplary religion model of religious innovation that must be pursued bymodern religions. transmission

20권 1호.title_kr: 유식학이 융의 분석심리학의 마음 형성에 미친 영향
20권 1호.title_en: An Influence on the Formation of Mind of Jung``s Analytical Psychology in Vijnapti-m?tra-Science
20권 1호.abstract_kr: Jung`s analytical psychology examines how to see and understand, How Vijnapti-matra-Science sees the mind(psyche). Then, the mind of Jung`s analytical psychology will discuss which had been received the impacts at some point of Vijnapti-matra-Science. The mind of Jung`s analytical psychology is divided consciousness and ego, personal unconscious, and the collective unconscious. The mind of Vijnapti-matra-Science is divided consciousness(vijnana), self-consciousness (mano-nama-vijnana), and store house(alaya-vijnana). Conscious is the current consciousness and the ego is its center. Consciousness roles active gate keeper in Jung`s psychology and Vijnapti-matra-Science. The collective unconscious is the most important concept in the system of Jung`s psychology. The collective unconscious does not rely on personal experience. The contents of personal unconscious was once done consciously. However, the contents of the collective unconscious have been never experience the things in a lifetime. The seventh conscious (mano-nama-vijnana) is to cling to persistingly the mind in the depth. The store conscious(alaya-vijnana) is the conscious(異熟識, vipaka-vijnana) which is ripen differently. Jung`s libido(psyche energy) is regard as the energy of the mind in the unconscious. This is seemed relate to four defilements(catus kle?as) and the good, evil and neutral non-record of which consist moral concept in the seventh mano-nama-vijnana. Because of contents of the unconscious is not good, or not evil, and not neutral non-record, and it is the duality which is not reasonable, or not an unreasonable thing. Alaya-vijnana goes on as like the cause disappear when the result occur. This seems similar to the understanding of Jung`s unconscious as a reservoir of the thought. Jung`s unconscious radicalized the shadow/archetype when meets with the crisis or difficulty. This seems to Similarity with which is to activate when the seeds meet relationship which the mind of Vijnapti-matra-Science.is to be potential, In addition, Jung`s archetypes seems to Corresponding with the original non-flow seed(本有無漏種子) of Vijnapti-matra-Science. These points can see which the mind formation of Jung`s analytical psychology is influenced from the mind of Vijnapti-matra-science. However Jung`s analytical psychology and Vijnaptimatra- Science have also each other different perspectives. Therefore, Jung`s mind seem to difficult to say which everything had been affected by the mind of Vijnapti-matra-science.

20권 1호.title_kr: 석존의 발자취에서 배우는 비움과 느림의 삶
20권 1호.title_en: Learning Slow and Empty Life by Buddha``s Footprint
20권 1호.abstract_kr: The culture of Buddhism can serve to empty and slow life model for wandering people in modern society. Temple Stay program and Slow Life is a kind of new model of Buddhist culture. Shakyamuni Buddha was born in country farm side and his teaching familier with nature friendly attitude. Lumbini in Nepal is a birth place of Buddha, pilgrims feel the peaceful landscape and feel oneness with nature. The awakeness of Buddha call it Bodhi or Buddi, Buddha means the man of awake. The place of awaken call it Budgaya, the sitting place call it Kumgang Bojwa(the precious seat of Diamond) under the Bodhendrum tree. The every living of Buddha used to eat once in a day, he wear humble robe and he has no house at frist time. His well being life was not pleasure of desire but his real pleasure earn from simple life. The Buddha image always shown by calm and smile. There is not image of quick temper. The Buddha image was depicted as a clam without worldly interesting. It is not image of success of outside dreaming, but the image of delight of inner mind. The Nirvana image of Buddha expressed by very calm and peaceful and free from fear.

20권 1호.title_en: A study on application of the Eight GraveRules in the contemporary information society
20권 1호.abstract_kr: This is a thesis to study if the Eight Grave Rules can be well applied and practiced in this information-oriented society or not. As we all know, modern information society is working under the transient change of moments and yet constantly creating some new knowledges through the network of subject-object relationship, by proposing a kind of feedback, circulated process of ``evaluation-choice-effect`` on the previously acquired informations. The first, top priority among virtues in this cyclic process is laid on our harmonious communication and equality. Communication means a kind of network like making bridge between informations and new knowledge. Equality guarantees the harmonious complete interaction as mutual value. Modern relational structure of information society has something in common with the equality, harmony and concord that the Buddha taught and thought as top priority in his sangha. People`s equality was one of basic principles to manage sangha from the primitive period during Buddha`s lifetime, which made people naturally harmonious group and for them eager to seek upper enlightenment and render it down to the other people. If it is true that Buddha had such intention of equality and harmony, there`s no way to set up any discriminative rules or precepts, even especially no way to point out and determine low and high status among ordained people. Whether Sutras or Vinayas, those canon must preserve Buddha`s real meaning of instruction, if there`s any literature against his real intention, I think, it can be right to consider it inserted on purpose after Buddha`s lifetime. Reflecting on an instruction-trivial precepts can be ignored, it seems to be a kind of spontaneous confession that Buddha himself talked trivial precepts as a means to teach people at his lifetime. Therefore the Eight Grave Rules showing discrimination clearly between bikku(monk) and biksuni(nun), cannot be a concrete and immutable principle. It is the reason to be able to argue on such issues of sila-violation, adaptability and orthodoxy in relation to that the Eight rules can be applied differently according to the time and the place. In conclusion, the Eight Grave Rules are now thought as out of date practice, moreover need re-interpretation in order to fit this information age and its gender equality as well. It is mandatory for us to go back and search the Buddha`s real intention to require those rules to his disciples. With tracing instruction to its origin, we can avoid making mistakes in understanding by words, and can do better interpretation and practice the wisdom of Right Vision in real life.

20권 2호.title_en: The Concept of maitri-karuna of Master JinBodhi in the Contemporary Society
20권 2호.abstract_kr: This paper examines “The Concept of maitri-karuna of Master JinBodhi in the Contemporary Society”. During the last few decades there have been enormous developments in science and technology which have practically changed the face of the earth. But in spite of the great achievements in science and technology, we find that there prevails a certain chaos and confusion at all levels ― individual, social, moral, religious, political, national and international. We find people going from bad to worse everyday. There is confusion and anarchy at all levels of human existence. In the face of these circumstances the need of the hour is “The Concept of maitri-karuna of Master JinBodhi in the Contemporary Society”. Chinese Buddhist Master JinBodhi developed Bodhi methodology after eighteen years studying traditional philosophy and meditation on the Qinghai-national and international. We find people going from bad to worse everyday. There is confusion and anarchy at all levels of human existence. In the face of these circumstances the need of the hour is “The Concept of maitri-karuna of Master JinBodhi in the Contemporary Society”. Chinese Buddhist Master JinBodhi developed Bodhi methodology after eighteen years studying traditional philosophy and meditation on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau of China. In 1991, he emerged from this period of intensive training to great acclaim as a meditation master. From then on, he has taught and inspired vast multitudes of people throughout Asia. Master JinBodhi’s methodology is based on the ancient Eastern philosophy of “compassion,” an understanding of humanity’s interconnectivity and itsinseparability from the natural world. The Bodhisattva, moved by sympathy, love, and compassion, refuses to enter into Nirvana until he has helped all living beings to attain liberation. In his infinite compassion, the Bodhisattva gladly exchanges the fruits of his own good deeds to relieve men of their suffering and suffers the consequences of their actions himself. Having overcome all passions and attachments, the Bodhisattva acts always out of compassion for suffering men and never out of selfishness, egoism, greed, and personal gain. In its mere 20 years of availability to the public, Bodhi Meditation has already benefited millions. All are welcome, irrespective of age, religion or personal background. Master JinBodhi‘s maitri-karuna is to realizs an unselfish action. An unselfish actions is based on the maitri-karuna A maitri-karuna is Master JinBodhi‘s essense.

20권 2호.title_kr: 단전주선과 간화선의 경험적 연구 : 원불교 정전 좌선법을 중심으로
20권 2호.title_en: Empirical Study on Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon and Gan-Hwa-Seon: Based on Zen meditation in 『Jeongjeon(正典)』
20권 2호.abstract_kr: The study is based on the researcher``s experience in Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon (Dan-Jeon-Ju meditation, 丹田住禪) and Gan-Hwa-Seon (Gan-Hwa meditation, 看話禪). First, this study describes the principle and method of the meditation practices of Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon and Gan-Hwa-Seon programs and consists of possible experiences in the process of the two meditation practices. Additionally, the common characteristics and features of Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon and Gan-Hwa-Seon are explained. The shared characteristics of two meditation practices are summarized first and then the features of each practice will be discussed. The tasks of won-buddhism suggested through this study are about the issues regarding the practice of the two meditations indicated in Zen meditation of Jeongjeon (正典). The first issue is about the breathing type of Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon. When the breathing method was changed from that of ``short`` and gentle to ``shallow`` and gentle, it turned out that all problems were solved. Secondly, several issues regarding the interpretational problems in the Dan-Jeon-Ju-Seon pratice are pointed out. Thirdly, the problemsregarding the expressions and the practices of Gan-Hwa-Seon are pointed out. The realistic issues are also raised. Gan-Hwa-Seon is regarded as a research subject like Uiduyeonma (Training in cases for questioning, 疑頭鍊 磨), however; this misunderstanding might lead to the opinion that Uiduyeonma at the end of Zen meditation rather interrupts Zen meditation Samadhi.
keywords_en: problems in the process of practice

20권 2호.title_kr: 여산(廬山) 혜원(慧遠)의 백련결사(白蓮結社)의 의의
20권 2호.title_en: The Meaning of a Society of White Lotus by Hui-yuan in Mountain Lushan
20권 2호.abstract_kr: Hui-yuan had been stayed at Lushan during 30 years, he never came out from the temple till A.D 416 and died at 83 years old there. His book dacheng-dayi-zhang(大乘大義章, the Sentence of Mahayana and Great Meaning), that mainly Hui-yuan asked about Dharma-nature, Embodiment of Dharma. Chant Samadhi and so on to Kumarajiba. In his book shamen-bujing-wangzhe-lun(沙門不敬王者論, the Theory of Monks never adore to King) insisted that the Buddhist monks need not to adore to king. Zen is very necessary tool to cul the worldly cares and learning to make peaceful mind. He also recommend to chant Amitaba Buddha for insight inner nature. He had a doctrine of double training Zen and Chant. Mountain Lushan has been famous place to Buddhist and Taoist. All of both had been lived there for saving their soul since Hui-yuna``s entered this mountain at East Chin dynasty. Hui-yuan made a society and chant with 123 members for the rebirth at the Paradise of West. This society call it the Society of White Lotus(白蓮 社). The name originated from white lotus ponds in the mountain. While both monks and lay persons in the society, both of all insight that Buddhanature contained themselves like white lotus blooming in the dirty pond. The society was costitutes 123 members as well as famous 18 monks. They prayed for rebirth in the paradise of west to Amita Buddha. This society was a Amita Buddha``s chant group.They chant Amita Buddha with practice Zen and keep the strict rule.

20권 2호.title_en: A Study on meditation principle of the Heart of the Perfection of Wisdom Sutra
20권 2호.abstract_kr: The meditation principles of life healing in the Heart of the Perfection of Wisdom Sutra can be summarized as three perspectives. The first principle is the restoration of purity in nature as a new innocence by way of the awakening of bodhi-citta. This principle is to have responsibility for the suffering of sentient beings from the having compassion for others. It can be called undertaking responsibility principle to be happy together with others. The second principle of life healing in the Heart Sutra is blessing with light as healing power in prajna insight principle. This principle is the correlation linkage of insight into the interdependent arising and sunyata. We can practice the dhyana by the samatha, and we can contemplate the reality of wisdom through vipassana with the accomplishment of samapati. The third principle of life healing in the Heart Sutra isbe free from sufferings by way of mantra recitation. Absorbed in the single-minded by the chanting mantra, we can be free from six secret teachings such as heavenly, asura, human, angler-fish, animal and world of hell. The practicing such merits of bodhisattva can be transferred to sentient beings.

20권 2호.title_kr: 도시의 발전과 종교: 축의 시대를 기준으로
20권 2호.title_en: The Study on the Relationship of development of cities and religion on the base of the Axial Age
20권 2호.abstract_kr: This article studies on the historical development of city and the relationship between city and religion. Humans in prehistory broke beyond hunting and gathering into settled farming communities, which then developed into new types of social organisation, spawning of cities and civilisations during Bronze and Iron Age. The characteristics of this Urban age has included that they were larger than earlier settlements, they contained full-time craft specialists, the surplus was collected together to a god or king, they witnessed monumental  architecture, there was an unequal distribution of social surplus, writing wasinvented, the sciences developed, naturalistic art developed, trade with foreign areas increased, and the state organisation was based on residence rather than kinship. After the Roman Empire, the separation between the church from the state was a prerequisite for peace. Secularism has become so natural to us that we assume it emerged organically, as a necessary condition of any society’s progress into modernity. As a result, it brings the unstability ofreligion itself. Jaspers, in his Vom Ursprung und Ziel der Geschichte(The Origin and Goal of History), identified a number of key Axial Age thinkers as having had a profound influence on future philosophies and religions, and identified characteristics common to each area from which those thinkers emerged. Jaspers saw in these developments in religion and philosophy a striking parallel without any obvious direct transmission of ideas from one region to the other, having found no recorded proof of any extensive intercommunication between Ancient Greece, the Middle East, India, and China. Jaspers described the Axial Age represents an in-between period, a period where old certainties had lost their validity and where new ones were still not ready, it has also been suggested that the Axial Age can be considered a historically liminal period. and become the spiritual home which we always return to whenever we faced the dillema to slove our spitual and cultural problems. Through this article, I argue that against the development our cities aided by advanced science, a new Axial Age will be sought to solve the weakness of religious power which soothe our spiritual disruption.

20권 2호.title_kr: 근 현대 한국불교에 나타난 생활불교의 유형과 미래 재가불교의 방향
20권 2호.title_en: The Life Buddhism`s Type in Modern Korean Buddhism and the Future Layman Buddhism`s Direction
20권 2호.abstract_kr: ‘Layman Buddhism’ is a corresponding concept to ‘monk Buddhism’. ‘Layman’ means layman Buddhist and laywoman Buddhist among four main groups of Buddhists, Buddhist monk, Buddhist nuns, layman Buddhists and laywoman Buddhists. So we can identify the meaning of the layman Buddhist as a member of four main groups of Buddhism. Layman Buddhists have established layman``s right role and status and actually practiced Buddha``s teaching in reality. After the Joseon dynasty of worshipping Confucianism and restraining Buddhism, the modern Buddhist world has experienced various tests to meet new era. There have been various movements to practice Buddha``s teaching in real life, rejecting mountain Buddhism of monks. There have been some movements of making Buddhism a way of life regardless of laymen and monks in modern Korean Buddhism. We can say some representative movement examples, Baek-yongseong``s enlightenment movement, Baek-hakmyeong``s coincidence movement with Zen and farming and Pak-jungbin``s research group on Buddhism. There are diverse forms in modern Korean Buddhism such as ‘Layman Buddhism’,‘Cultural Buddhism University’ and ‘Federation of University students of Buddhists’. Restently various layman Buddhism movements seek new direction under the inactive situation. It seems that layman Buddhists thought their making Buddhism a way of life came out fail. So they tried to seek new direction of future lay Buddhism under the cognition on the failure. And they suggested Mahayana Buddhism of layman in real life, not returning early Buddhism.

20권 2호.title_kr: 중국 객가인(客家人)의 사당(祠堂)에 반영된 관음(觀音)신앙
20권 2호.title_en: A Study of The Guaneum-Faith Reflected on Hakkas Shrine in China(中國客家祠堂所反映的觀音信仰)
20권 2호.abstract_kr: 中國的將近十四億人口，分類于五十六個民族，其中百分之九十五以上屬 于漢族。漢族文化一般分于中原文化，齊魯文化，荊楚文化，巴蜀文化，吳 越文化，嶺南文化等八種，而嶺南文化再細分以客家文化，廣府文化，潮汕 文化等, 本論文卽探討客家文化的內容。 客家人本是中原漢族，而在長久的中國歷史風波中，離開故鄕，經歷苦 難，遂到南部地區定居的；他們艱苦地建設了新的家園，就希望不再팽面患 難，而平平安安過日子，故建造了堅固而尨大，有利于防備外侵的大型住 宅。通過他們住宅裏的祠堂布置中，可以發現3種核心信仰：以祖堂所反映 的儒家祖先崇拜，以土地公社所反映的土地神崇拜，以觀音閣所反映的佛敎 觀音崇拜。 客家人的觀音崇拜，來源于浙江省周山島普陀山的觀音信仰；以慈悲理念 爲核心的普陀山觀音信仰，雖然受到佛敎原本理念的影響，但獨自樹立而形 成的成分也흔大，故其所呈現的慈悲與以 ‘因果應報’, ‘發願力行’等爲做前 提的原本理念有所不同，則以母親對待赤孩的 ‘無由而不渴的賜愛和庇護’；遂 把從前的 ‘觀音菩薩’ 稱號, 也改成爲 ‘觀音娘娘’。如此觀音信仰的內涵，則 當地以海洋還境爲舞臺而生活的商人和漁民等，經常팽到無能爲力的災難，不可豫測的苦厄，故援以佛敎的觀音菩薩願力，寄託自我的祈願，遂形成了 獨特的一種信仰形態。客家人也經歷過多次患難，處境不安，故借以普陀山 所形成的觀音信仰，寄託了祈安求福的心情。

20권 2호.title_kr: 日本の佛敎受容と排斥の說話
20권 2호.title_en: Narratives about reception and exclusion of Buddhism in Japan
20권 2호.abstract_kr: In this article, I explored narratives of reception and exclusion of Buddhism in “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku”. To discuss this problem, I compared “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku” with “Nihon shoki” and “Jougu Shoutokutaishi-den Hoketsuki”, both of which were quoted in “Syoutoku- Taishi Denryaku”. Although I only compared some articles here, I concluded that the descriptions of “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku” were written in its own point of view rather than reconstructed from previously written books. And “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku” has a detailed article about the exclusion of Buddhism for which “Jougu Shoutokutaishi-den Hoketsuki” has only a few words. It``s difficult to determine whether those articles were quoted from other books or written uniquely, because previously written books like “Ryakuroku”, whose articles were quoted in “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku”, has been lost. But an article about a war against Mononobeno Moriya in “Syoutoku-Taishi Denryaku” shows that it has modified its previous ones by itself.

Major reasons that humans do not see the reality are due to the limitations of cognitions.In the aspect of cognitive science as one of the reasons of the limitations of cognitions, there are the intentionality(intentionnalite],which is a notion from phenomenology, and a function of representations, cognition distortions, automatic thoughts, the confirmation bias and qualia.In the aspect of neuroscience the categorization of cognitions and concepts, Hebbian theory, selective system and stimulus-response of the brain are also related with limitations of cognitions.In the aspect of psychoanalysis the archetypes of collective unconsciousness introduced by Yung are causes of the limitations of cognitions.In the aspect of buddhism perceptive function called as papanca(희론戱論), the 9 or 8 types of consciousness, and the 3 kinds of perceptive functions are the causes. In the aspect of quantum physics I inquired into the complementarity principle, chaos theory, and complexity system and found that humans can not see the duality of wave and particles at the same time owing to the human nature which is bound to the dichotomous way of thinking. And there are limitations of cognitions to perceive the chaos and complexity system to which is applied not the law of lineal cause and effect but that of reciprocal cause and effect.As above I investigated that the limitations of cognitions can be overcome by practicing Vipassana meditation by establishing the four foundations of mindfulness of body, feelings, mind and dhamma.Sati( awareness or mindfulness), the key mental factor of Vipassana meditation, can help reveal the true nature of self and make anobjective observation with the perspectives of middle way the here and now.

In the Renewed Diamond Sutra(Ⅱ), Chapter 6∼10 were corrected, and in this paper, Chapter 11∼15.The Diamond Sutra was translated into English and into Korean by many scholars, but little effort was offered to complete the Diamond Sutra. As a result,almost all of the Diamond Sutra, even the Kumarajiva``s version, have many severe problems and/or dropout.On the support of Huayen Sutra and Whitehead Study Group, I propose more perfect Diamond Sutra and the 4-4-4-4 Korean-alphabet version. the work is composed of 3 stages. the first stage is achieving a complete version. 21권 3호.title_en: Social Integration and Harmonizing Disputes by Wonhyo
21권 3호.abstract_kr: Currently, there have been many problems in our society.Compared to the era of military dictatorship, the political democratization has been implemented to some extent. Economy has developed. However, people``s lives are impoverished. The fact that Korea’s suicide rate is the highest among the OECD member countries shows us the reality as it is. This reality is attributed to the fact that social integration has not been correctly carried out,particularly to excessive polarization and social conflict that are deemed detrimental to the integration in our society. Therefore,resolving social conflicts is regarded as critical to social integration.Hwajaeng can provide us with suggestions on how to resolve the conflicts. Invoking the method of Hwajaeng may function to resolve social conflicts. The resolution of conflicts is available in three ways.Conflicts are resolved through: (1) negation; (2) free affirmation and negation; and (3) broad understandings. These are the ways in which the conflict can be resolved.According to Wonhyo, different perspectives could be the material of the conflict. But he recognizes that there may be the beginning of a new development. Today’s conflict situation per se is not necessarily bad. Rather, it should be used as a means to create the beginning of positive developments. Most importantly, we should admit that there exist diverse conflicts. We will then have to strive to communicate with one another. Wonhyo tried to reconcile the disputes among a variety of Buddhist theories through hwajaeng.Additionally, he was committed to the popularization of Buddhism.Such Wonhyo’s efforts can be referred to as ones toward social integration. We need to find avenues towards social integration,regarding conflicts as creative assets. Humans and social existence are interdependent. The starting point can be that all human beings have Buddha-nature as well. If we practice dissolution of conflicts in a spirit of hwajaeng, we will be able to further promote social integration.

21권 3호.title_kr: 한국 불교의 미래를 위한 지식인의 역할

21권 3호.abstract_kr: Korean buddhism is a going concern always. The subject of “Sang-gu bori hawa jungsang”(Pursuing the truth upwardly and edifying the people downwardly“ is the highest task, but it is regarded as difficult to realize it.Perhaps, it seems that the goal aims too high. But Korean society runs and the buddhism develops too while it maintains the current level.The roles of the intellectuals for Korean buddhism, social welfare, issue of Korean buddhism innovation and the international relief activities of Korean buddhism were discussed in this study.Korean buddhism tries to make the future Korean society of realizing the land of Buddha, but it is difficult because Korean society is dynamic and there are consistent conflicts.With regards to Korean buddhism and social welfare, the subjects of social welfare workforce supply and demand in Buddhism society, development of customized education program, education system for buddhism identity and establishment of the exclusive organization for welfare education in buddhism society were discussed in the study based on the dignity of life. The innovation of Korean buddhism shall be focused on the old traditional values approved as practice for long duration and Korean buddhism shall be modernized, popularized and made to be a way of life. The points to be overcome are listed for the transparency in finance, problem in the statistics of buddhism believer, non-utilization of the merits of urbanization and the lacking the capability for missionary work to teenagers and youth. And the problems in buddhism formalities were pointed out.As for the issues of religion affairs adminstration, abuse of religious body and familism, representation of religious body and lacking of duty sense, non-establishment of the professional religious staff system, headquarters of diocese, less human resources in the terminal temples and deepened financial differences among the temples were listed and the countermeasures were suggested.The international relief activities of Korean buddhism are developing considerably even though it is not in the mature stage. The material and human assets,professional manpower and networking among the buddhism related organization shall be acquired for international relief activities.The role of intellectuals for the future of Korean buddhism is to establish the innovative thought for arranging Korean social structures and acquiring the mind of pursuing the self and other’s interest (Win-win).This is the reason of emphasizing the role of the intellectuals for the development of buddhism.

21권 2호.title_en: The CoThe Concept of Miraculous Prostration of Master JinBodhi as a Principle of Social reconcilationncept of Miraculous Prostration of Master JinBodhi as a Principle of Social reconcilation
21권 2호.abstract_kr: This paper examines “The Concept of Miraculous Prostration of Master JinBodhi as a Principle of Social reconciliations” During the last few decades there have been enormous developments in science and technology which have practically changed the face of the earth. But in spite of the great achievements in science and technology, we find that there prevails a certain chaos and confusion at all levels ― individual, social, moral, religious, political, national and international. We find people going from bad to worse everyday. There is confusion and anarchy at all levels of human existence. In the face of these circumstances there is a need for an hour of the spiritual regeneration of human society. So this paper examines “The Concept of Miraculous Prostration of Master JinBodhi as a Principle of Social reconciliations. In the temples on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau of China, people prostrate on a daily basis. The wooden floors are visibly eroded as a result of years of rubbing by the hands and bodies of prostrating people. In this region, its common to see pious shepherds prostrate all the way from their remote villages to the holy city of Lhasa. They literally measure the road by the length of their bodies as they prostrate forward on their journey, without standing up on a single steep. Natural disasters are no obstacle. The shepherds are not afraid of wild animals, bad weather, illness or death. Their devotion and persistence are touching. For Buddhists or anyone studying dharma, prostration is the most devotional gesture that respects Buddha. Apart from this, what can prostration bring to common people? According to my experience, prostration can bring everyone numerous benefits, including physical health, emotional balance and mental clarity. Furthermore, it helps us to access the compassionate power of the Universe. We may even unearth the unrealized inner potential.

21권 2호.title_kr: 불교와 사회관계 정립을 위한 제관점 분석
21권 2호.title_en: Analysis of different views for the establishment of relationship between Buddhism and society
21권 2호.abstract_kr: Since the early Buddhist era to modern, social contribution and political participation of Buddhism was a very important concern. Because political and social change has had a significant impact to the existence and development of Buddhism. In the past world history, We can find a variety of cases how did it affect in Buddhism that the change of religious faith in the ruling class. In this study, I analyzed the sermon of the Buddha, a Mahayana Buddhist perspective, and the perspective of society in modern Korea on the social and political participation of Buddhist community. Buddhist point of view of political participation is mixed for the active participation, limited participation, and the opposite. In the multicultural, multi-religious society, political participation of temples and monks are a lot more dangerous. Because it can be a party to the political conflict. On the other hand, Buddhism can not ignore the social suffering, and also not indifferent to social reality. In the context of korean buddhism, it is the time to try to focusing on practice asceticism and propaganda, and to strengthen the internal capacity.

21권 2호.title_kr: 불교(佛敎)와 사회복지(社會福祉) 소고(小考) -조계종,천태종,진각종을 중심으로-
21권 2호.title_en: Buddhism and Social Welfare -Fouced on ChoGye Jong(Order), ChunTae Jong(Order) , JinGak Jong(Order)-
21권 2호.abstract_kr: This article outlines the contribution of Buddhist organizations in Korea to social welfare. ChoGye Jong(Order), ChunTae Jong(Order), and JinGak Jong(Order) to represent Korean Buddhism have been heavily involved in social service. This paper is illustrated through examining social services delivered by three major Buddhist Orders. In case of ChoGye Jong(Order), the share of children and youth welfare facilities is 32%, the share of elderly welfare facilities 25% and community-based welfare facilities showed a share of 23%. In case of ChunTae Jong(Order), the share of children and youth welfare facilities reach 43%, the share of elderly welfare facilities 39% and disabled welfare facilities accounted for 9%. In case of JinGak Jong(Order), the share of children and youth welfare facilities is 32%, the share of elderly welfare facilities 25% and community-based welfare facilities showed a share of 23%. Among Buddhist social welfare facilities, the share of children and youth welfare facilities is the highest, and followed by the elderly facilities. It is analyzed by the urgent diversification of social services in order to respond appropriately to the needs of the public.

Problems conceivable from a Buddhistic position can be divided first into the personal and fundamental question, “Why am I living?” and second into the social problem that results from personal and structural pain arising from social structure. The solution to the personal question gave the opportunity and rights of life for sudra to manage a just life, and the solution to the structural problem denied the caste system and solved inequality by classes. The nobility of life is not decided by birth, but by his/her thoughts and behavior. The four noble truths are presented as a methodology to arrive at the purpose, pratityasamutpadah. The four noble truths are duhkha, sumudaya, nirodhaarya and marga. Duhkha is a phenomenon occurred, a presentation of assignment, sumudaya is an investigation of the reason why it happened, a reason for occurrence, nirodhaarya is a status at which an actual problem has been solved, and marga is the method and actions that solved the problems that already occurred. For example, a person visits a clinic for low back pain. Once his/her low back aches, it must be cured. He may have to visit a clinic for the pain or use a folk remedy to cure it. Then, what is this status, a low back pain? It is ‘duhkha’ that Buddha stipulated. If he/she would visit a clinic, he/she may take an X-ray, touch his/her low back and make the cause clear. Is the low back painful? The cause of the pain must be determined if it is painful, because a cartilage supporting the bones is worn out, because the joint is put out of, or because it is a herniated lumbar disc. Finding it out is ‘sumudaya.’ It was turned out to be a herniated lumbar disc as a result of the X-ray. Some kind of prescription must be made to cure this disc either by disc surgery or by correction if not too serious. At last, the low back pain is gone either through surgery or correction. Its recovery is what is called ‘nirodhaarya.’ Then, if it is healed by surgery, the surgery is called as ‘marga.’ If it is corrected, the correction is ‘marga,’ a way of practice. Explaining duhkha, sumudaya, nirodhaarya and marga with a low back pain, the pain itself is duhkha, so ‘duhkha’ is a presentation of an assignment. It is an expression of some problem. Then, ‘sumudaya’ finds out the status and the cause of the pain by using X-ray. We found out why it is painful. That is, ‘sumudaya’ is the cause of occurrence. It is ‘sumudaya,’ the cause of the pain and its occurrence. Low back pain has been solved and overcome. The normal status without any pains is called as ‘nirodhaarya.’ In other words, a status at which the actual troubles we regard as problematic are overcome and solved is called as ‘nirodhaarya.’ Then, what is ‘marga’? We healed the low back by surgery. Then, the way of practice becomes surgery, and if the low back is corrected, the correction is a way of practice. The four noble truths, presented by Buddha, is an assignment we must pursue and conduct by ruminating in everyday life, while thinking endlessly to become a Buddha, to live a happy life, and to manage a righteous life as we earn our livelihood throughout our lifetime. The presentation, the cause of occurrence, overcoming the reality and the way of practice are duhkha, sumudaya, nirodhaarya and marga. Solutions based on four noble truths are necessary in order to overcome the problems of social communication.

21권 2호.title_en: Buddhist Solution to the Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
21권 2호.abstract_kr: 2014 Korea`s per capita national income is $25,931, about 27.227 million won when converted into the currency (1$ = 1,050won). When calculated as a family of four, the household average is 108.91 million won. It must be a great income. However, a look at the suicide rate, it is the world`s second-largest record with 31 people per 100,000 (1st, Lithuania, 31.5 persons). The fertility rate is that 219 of the 224 countries with over 1.23 people. It can be estimated that though the overall income of people has increased, it is becoming more difficult to live and to raise kids. It seems that there is no choice but to compete with the social and aggravated imbalances in income distribution. In terms of human fatigue, this situation can be said to mean that the society as a whole is susceptible to fatigue. In addition it may not hard to judge, that the environment is created to arouse chronic fatigue syndrome is the cause this environment. This study examines the causes of fatigue, discusses symptoms of fatigue and actions to take and then suggests the Buddhist solution as the fundamental solution. As the Diamond sutra solution, for the ever so obsessed by an ego lies at the root of fatigue, teaches to discard the stick to what happens with saying that realize the concept of non-ego, the whole of creation born and die by nidana are like dreams, like illusion, like bubbles, and like shadows. On the other words, it explains the way not to be fatigue and guide the way to avoid chronic fatigue syndrome. In addition, the solution of the Saddharma-Pundarika explains by analogy to a burning house that however this world is made up of easy ones cling to human nature; the fact is that there is no subject worth clinging to feel a sense of fatigue. In addition, this world is not composed as two according to the Vimalakirti Sutra. The ‘not two’ idea is presented the fundamental solution to fatigue in itself already. Because when tiring others, be tired will oneself, when ease others, I feel comfortable. Because others and I are not the two.

21권 2호.title_en: The Development and Characteristics of Korean Buddhistic-social movement
21권 2호.abstract_kr: In Korean society, the characteristic of engaged-Buddhism was formed in modern and contemporary period. In modern period, it revealed nationalist Buddhistic movement, and in 1980`s, it revealed public Buddhistic movement. Based on such history of Buddhistic group movement and public movement, in 1990`s, Buddhist social movement flourished. After the Max Weber`s remark that Protestant ethic functioned as a main spiritual property in the foundation of Modern Capitalism, the relationship of Religion and Social-change has been considered as one of the most important issues of Sociology of religion. In such background, this study classifies public Buddhistic movement in 1980`s into three period by significant events or degree of organization, such as ①The grim Buddhist persecution period(1980-1984) ② The systematization of public Buddhistic movement(1985-1987) ③ The ideological differentiation of Buddhistic-social movement(1988-1990)

21권 2호.title_en: The apology of Ananda with a series of reproaches
21권 2호.abstract_kr: The elders at the council then addressed Ananda with a series of reproaches. He had neglected to question the Buddha about the minor and least important precepts, he had put his foot on his cloak, he allowed his body to be defiled by women`s tears, he had not asked him to prolong his stay in this world and, finally, he had pleaded for the entry of women into the order. Even though he felt perfectly innocent, Ananda confessed those faults out of regard for the community. Many other considerations could be advanced concerning this tradition of the council. The little that has been said about them is enough to demonstrate that it would be imprudent to commit oneself for or against the historicity of the councils. In itself, the account abounds in improbabilities and anachromisms, it is steeped in the marvellous and exploits myths and literary themes which are no more than commonplaces. When compared with one another, the various narratives which have come down to us disagree over almost every point, date and place of council, persons who took part in them, the activity which was carried out at them. The tradition of the councils is only indirectly connected with the mainstream of the canonical writings. It appears only in later sutra which are not included in the early collections. It is merely as an appendix that it appears in the Vinayas of the various schools after undergoing the necessary modifications. They were accepted as a whole by the early community and constituted the common heritage of the Buddhist sects which were subsequently to develop.

21권 2호.title_en: China Empress Wu Zetian`s Government Established and Buddhism -focused on 『Dayunjingshu』-

In China, women are the emperor and the bureaucrat not even once in the right place. Wu Zetian needs a new political consciousness to control regime, she has to learn the scriptures. According to the traditional religion of Confucianism(儒家) and Taoism(道家), women are not allowed to become the emperor, so Wu Zetian sought the legitimacy of buddhism. In the Buddhist scriptures to the emperor of the ideal woman can on. Wu Zetian used a Buddhist, she was about to give even the legitimacy of the emperor. At that time, Xue Huaiyi(薛懷義) tried to give her the emperor ascended the throne, analysis of Jingguang-Qiannu(淨光 天女) character and Maitreya(彌勒佛) in 『Dayunjing(大雲經)』, the female emperor ascended the throne to help wrote the 『Dayunjingshu(大雲經疏)』. In this manner, such a sequential events became important background and proof to Empress Wu Zetian`s seizure of political power.

21권 1호.title_en: A Study of the thought of lifespan representing the eternally abiding dharmakaya in Maha Parinirvana Sutra
21권 1호.abstract_kr: Maha Parinirvana Sutra consists of 40 volumes and 13 chapters. Its main messages are the idea of the lifespan representing the eternally abiding dharmakaya; four virtues of Buddha-eternity, bliss, self, and purity; and that all sentient beings have the Buddha-nature innately. The present paper provides an explanation of the notion of the lifespan representing the eternally abiding dharmakaya. Sakya becomes an eternal Buddha by attaining enlightenment, and recognizes and attains Nirvana, which is the original nature of existing beings. It explains the eternity of dharma body, which is attained after a body becomes extinct. Humans pursue the goal of happiness. This happiness is a state in which body and mind are perfectly satisfied and it becomes great if this state lasts forever. In Ekottaragama 31-5, Buddha stated, “No one is worse than me at obtaining happiness in the world.” The goal of pursuing and achieving happiness is eventually about suffering becoming pleasure, which leads to the everlasting pure dharma body. All sentient beings who have the Buddha-nature innately can be happy because they all have the Buddha nature. According to the first chapter of the Sutra, on life span, Tathagata is a being that originally transcended birth and death and reveals Nirvana to show the true nature of impermanence and the non-self to sentient beings. In the second chapter of the Sutra, on lament, disciples who grieve over death are asked to understand the mortality of life and cease their obsession with life. In the fourth chapter of the Sutra, on spiritual brotherhood the text states that “Tathagata lasts eternally and does not change.” Additionally, Kassapa is addressed, “Understand properly, Kassapa. The body of Tathagata is Vajrapani and you will be devoted to this duty from today onward. You should not wish for body. Tell people that the body of Tathagata is the dharmakaya and staing at all times.” Here, reality and eternity are presented as two sides of a coin, as the realistic problem of death and the essential problem of seeking eternity are presented as related by interdependency, which is a relationship of dependent origination. Through death, Sakya is sublimated into the thought that his life-span as a representation of the eternally abiding dharmakaya through the eternity of death.
keywords_en: Lifespan representing the eternally abiding dharmakaya

21권 1호.title_en: A Study on the Correlated Linkage between Nirvana in Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra and Buddha`s nature thought of Shinjo Ito
21권 1호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this article is to study on the correlative linkage between nirvana in the ‘Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra’ and Buddha`s nature thought of Shinjo Ito. According to the Buddha`s nature thought of Shinjo Ito, ‘Dharma kaya resident’ is the source of touching upon buddhahood. The Shinyo-en is an outward manifestation of their deep resolve to help all people their buddha nature. First, we can find the nature of Buddha in the ‘Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra.’ The Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra is equipped with pure precepts compliance to keep the Dharma kaya steady. From the perspective of correlative linkage, it was Kyodoin-sama who laid the foundation for identifying the place Shinchoji was established. It was at the time that the power we call bakku-daiju as trans-versality and Shinnyo spiritual faculty were perfected through Shindoinsama`s passing. Second, based on the Mahayana Buddhism, we can be aware that the immortal resident immortal of Dharma kaya is the source of permanent bliss in the Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra.’ From the perspective of correlative linkage, To pray and reflect before the three personifications of buddhahood and the Shinnyo Stupa is the same meaning as meeting the ever-present Buddha. Third, the ‘Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra’ tells us ‘all sentient beings have Buddha nature`` that could be the possibility to the fulfillment of buddhahood in the spiritual practice. From the perspective of correlative linkage, we can strive with open hearts and minds, in efforts that benefit others, and in ways we can work together to build a word of joy in which everyone can have public-common happiness. This is based on mutually beneficial voluntary focused our principles into practice the spirit to build a joyous world of shinnyo as the civic clean precepts of ‘Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra.’ Fourth, the Buddha`s nature thought of Shinjo Ito is based on the thought of Mahayana Mahaparinirvana Sutra. It can be supported by the Shinnyo parents and the two Dojis to build a world of joy as the light dharma descending and the emphasis of Tathata spiritual power. It`s not that we can`t do something we haven`t attained a higher spiritual level. What counts is our continuos effort, act so we can elevate our spiritual ability as public-common linkage.
keywords_en: the Buddha`s nature thought of Shinjo Ito

21권 1호.title_en: Methodological approach to the development of Buddha nature through Shinnyo meditation of Sessin training
21권 1호.abstract_kr: Shinnyo teaching is focusing on the acceptance of all phenomenal occurrences including personal relationships through the daily life as an important virtue and a practice for the spiritual enlightenment. This practice is based on the acceptance from all aspects around followers, occurring through their mentally or physically. Therefore, these practice believed as a way to approach to their buddha nature by the practice of the acceptance. The characteristics of the Shinnyo teaching is to relieve the followers from the suffering from the delusion through ``Bakudaiju`` (spiritual power of acceptance which is accepted by the Shinnyo spiritual world) and Sessin training, a kind of meditation, which is unique meditation training in Shinnyoen developed by Master Shinjo, the founder of Shinnyo teaching. The practice or training in Shinnyoen is focusing to bless for his/her ancestors` comfortable rest as well as to relieve the delusion of the followers, and finally support to find out his/her buddha nature. However, Shinnyo teaching is rather emphasized a strict practice of altruism, and pray to be purified their endowed with unwanted relations. Basic idea of Shinnyo practice is to develop the buddha nature with altruism, and suggested as the aim to become a spiritual medium to serve Sessin training for the followers. to develop their buddha nature as well as to have a chance to be purified himself through meditation services. Sessin training is emphasized its practice either in the temple or at home or society through their whole life. Therefore, the followers can lead their daily life with a sprit of buddha all the time and let them to practice to purify their karmas. The spiritual word from Sessin seems like a gourd of water for the conventional pump, and therefore the followers should continue to pump their buddha nature from their unconsciousness out, as the water can be pumped out from the earth.

21권 1호.title_en: Sunya and Reality on the basis of Mah parinirv as tra(涅槃經)`s affiliations Sutra
