Recently this topic was hot issued, so there are two positions appeared. The point is tathagatagarbha(如來藏) thought is Buddhism or not. This paper purposed to point out the concept of The nature of Buddha(佛性) on Mah parinirv as tra(涅槃經)`s affiliations correspond to Sunyata(空性). So it could`t be interpreted Reality. Because the concept of The nature of Buddha(佛性) on Mah parinirv as tra(涅槃經)`s affiliations correspond to Selfless theory(無我說) of Early Buddhism and Sunya theory(空思想) of Mahayana Buddhism, it`s the central thought that realize a teaching of Buddha. 21권 1호.title_en: Some implications of the Nirvana Sutras for the Political Philosophy
21권 1호.abstract_kr: Nirvana sutras have abundant implications for the political philosophy. The idea of Buddha-nature of the Mahayana Nirvana Sutra elevated human being to the level of the Buddha. In this respect, the idea is the forgoer of respect for human dignity and human rights in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and human rights provisions in the basic laws of the developed democracies. Mahayana Nirvana-sutra also tells us what the main causes of human sufferings are, what the vision of the future is, and what men should do to actualize the vision. The political ideologies generally ascribe the causes of human sufferings to certain social system or social groups. Their future visions tend to be the society in which the existing social system is transformed and some groups or individuals are eliminated. The Mahayana Nirvana-sutra ascribes the human suffering to the lack of enlightenment of Buddha nature and three fires of human greed, anger and ignorance. The vision of the sutra is the world of 常·樂·我·淨 eternity, bliss, personality, and purity where even icchantikas, the most devilry persons also should be redeemed by recovering their Buddha-nature. In the sutra, the future vision is actualized by awakening Buddha-nature in every man`s mind and practicing the bodhisattva path. If the Mahayana Nirvana-sutra is able to guide the political ideologies, the politics in the world would be greatly improved and purified. The Nirvana-sutra of Pali version includes the teachings of the seven no-decline laws for Vajji republic in the face of aggression and some principles for the operation of Sangha community. We can get some hint from the teachings for the current republican operation of the developed nations.

21권 1호.title_kr: 원효(元曉)의 『열반종요(涅槃宗要)』에 나타난 불성(佛性)의 개념(槪念)과 그 현대적(現代的) 의의(意義)
21권 1호.title_en: The meaning of Buddhata and modern significance shown in Wonhyo`s 『涅槃宗要』
21권 1호.abstract_kr: This dissertation is for what the view of Buddhata and its modern significance shown in Wonhyo`s 『涅槃宗要』 are. Wonhyo explained his views on Buddhata in a variety of treatises. But there are few treatises which make comprehensive positions clear like 『涅槃宗要』. I wrote this dissertation to consider the position of Wonhyo`s Buddhata comprehensively based on that point and arranged its modern meaning from subjective stance. Wonhyo had arranged the position on Buddhata which was insisted in the Buddhist areas of North-east Asia with 6 points at the time of his activity. It was with the trace of the fact that 『涅槃經』 was considered as the remarkable from the world after Kumarajiva came into Jangan and then translated various sutras. Therefore, he can be mentioned with Seungmin of Jangeomsa, Beopun of Gwangtaeksa, Muje in Liang Dynasty, Hyeonjang who made the basis of Yusik thought in China, and Jinjesamjang who introduced Yeoreajang(Tathagatagarbha) thought with the translation of Seopdaeseungron( 『섭대승론』) to China etc since Dosaeng who united Prajna and Buddhata. Wonhyo concluded that those six buddhist scholars` arguments were, on the one hand, some parts were valid though, on the other hand, some parts were not, so it could be said, on the one hand, some were right, but on the other hand, some were wrong. And he integrated all the theories as his unique 一心論, the theory of One mind. Wonhyo said, ... the essence of Buddhata is 一心, the One mind is to leave away all the heresy of holding extreme views, so there is nothing to be contained because it left from all the heresy of holding extreme views.... But such a thought of One mind by Wonhyo is on the same logical line of Ilshimimun, the thought of One mind and two doors which were mentioned in Daeseunggishinron(『대승기신론』). It is that all things are on the foundation of One mind whether it is 眞如門 or 生滅門. Based on such a principle, he could integrate the theories of Buddhata from six scholars who had worked before. Then what on earth is it, if Wonhyo`s view on Buddhata has a modern meaning? To condense and summarize, there can be explained with the followings. First, Buddhata emphasizes on the dignity of life. It is that the universal value of life is equal, the dignity of life should be the purpose as itself, not the method. Second, if the buddhata is recognized as Yeoraejang(Tathagatagarbha), all the human beings can be saved. It means that the door of salvation is not opened only for a special thing or something, but already widely opened to everything. Third, the essence of Buddhata is One mind, it lets us accept religious pluralism which can embrace others who are thought as ones having differences from me in the reality of multiple religious society on the point that One mind embraces Tathata and Tathagatagarbha. Forth, if the genuine ego is considered as Buddhata, it can be mutually understood with the divine nature which is positioned as a significant concept in Modern science of religion or psychology. But it is not that Buddhata is recognized as the nature which has invariability, so it should be distinguished with divine nature. Fifth, Wonhyo lets people know how to live desirable lives.
keywords_en: Conciliation of diverse arguments on Buddhist doctrine

21권 1호.title_kr: 한국(韓國)에서 진여원(眞如苑)의 교리(敎理)와 수행(修行)의 활성화(活性化)에 관한 소고(小考)
21권 1호.title_en: A Study on The Activation Plan of Teachings and Practices of Shinnyo-en in Korea

As the founder of Shinnyo-en, Kyoshu integrated the Spiritual Faculty of Esoteric Buddhism and Teachings of Mahaparinirvana Sutra. Teachings of Mahaparinirvana Sutra is summarized to that everything has buddha nature. The Sameness of the three Dharma in Shinnyo-en has been thaught to every devotee. The Spiritual Faculty means the supernatural power from the convergence of spiritual faculty of earth and that of heaven. The Encounter Mind Practice is unique program of Shinnyo-en which reflects and improves the their own minds. The founder of Shinnyo-en emphasized Sharing the Path with others, Sincere Offerings, Selfless-Service as way of doing the The Six Paramita. It plays a role as the specific action plan for devotee. And Shinnyo-en also emphasizes self-benefit and others-benefit. Keishu Shinso, The Current Head of Shinnyo-en said that prayer is gratitude mind and true practice to have others led to happiness. As the activation plan of Shinnyo-en in Korea, I proposes seven plan, first of all is lunch service for old men, second is the Japanese language service for layman and college students, third is establishment of graduate school for expanding The Encounter Mind Practice, fourth is supporting the Ph.D. course and Post-doc course encouraging the studying the teachings of Shinnyo-en, fifth is serving Buddhist service in morning and evening by korean, sixth is awarding winner in public contest which invites the experiences of practices and spiritual faith, seventh is retraining and reeducating the staff. 22권 3호.title_en: Propagation Direction and Prescriptions of Korean Buddhism
22권 3호.abstract_kr: Jogye Order, the largest sect of Korean Buddhism, did not have any institutionalized organization for propagation but try to secure believers only through the traditional Buddhist ceremony service. As Buddhist liberal arts colleges were established at major temples in the 1980s, a new type of propagation to secure believers emerged. Although different temples offered different doctrines and standards about becoming Buddhist believers, they made substantial achievement. The Buddhist monastic order consists of four different communities; monks, nuns, laymen and laywomen. Although there was no education system for propagation to attract followers, there were education institutions such as Gangwon (a temple studying Buddhism theory) and Senwon (a temple practicing Zen). But they failed to transform themselves as a regular curriculum course of the Ministry of Education and Science in the modernization process, which represent both the limitations that Korean Buddhism is facing in the era of multi religions and the most vulnerable point in its propagation. The basic attributes that religions must have are truth, universal validity and sociality. Buddhism has more powerful features of truth and universal validity than any other religions. First, truth is the goal that a religion pursues to achieve and represent its uniqueness. The goal of Buddhism is to become a Buddha, which is the ultimate aim of Buddhism. Second, a religion must have universal validity. In other words, what is important is not which type of structure a religion has or what kind of people believes in it but how its followers are living `right` lives in a right frame of mind. It must have universal validity by offering guidance toward true lives in any part of the world and also throughout periods and history. Lastly, a religion must have sociality, which represents its practicality and reality. That is to say, it must have vitality and persuasive power based on faith. It is closely related to its propagation methodology or specific method. After examining the Jogye Order, the largest sect of Korean Buddhism, the study offered recommendations and prescriptions about its propagation method. To effectively achieve this goal, it must establish a systemized doctrine in an internal way and develop a system to deliver the systemized doctrine in an external way. It means that Korean Buddhism must present a propagation direction toward delivering specific opinions about its doctrines, education, system and scriptures in a persuasive way. And it must develop the standard educational materials about the basic Buddhist teaching within the Buddhist sect itself to ensure that even though it is taught by different instructors, the same teachings must be offered. It must issue certificates to only those who complete the basic course to become instructors to allow them to teach how to become Buddhists to its would-be followers. Without this system, Buddhist followers will learn different doctrines depending on which temple they go or which monks they meet. They end up with having varying opinions about the doctrines, although they believe in the same Buddhism. Especially for coexistence with various religions, it is necessary to establish a basic and common system. In Buddhism, there is no introductory education program for would-be followers. For this reason, there is no clear boundary between Buddhist followers and non-followers. In others words, there is no guideline about how they have to practice Buddhism. Given this, the introductory education program for would-be followers must be established and implemented. To this end, it is prerequisite to set up the criteria about education system and content as well as instructors` requirements. After 2,500 years of coexistence of different Buddhism sects, we now must find out an ideal image that Buddhist followers adopt as a new guideline for their lives. The ideal image of Mahayana Buddhism is the figure of the Bodhisattva who seeks Enlightenment for the sake of all beings, whereas that of Zen Buddhism is Zen master JoJu who strived to restore the original nature of humans through lives and Zen meditations. At this critical juncture, we must face the following realities in order to return to the life of Buddha. First, one must practice the Buddha among the three Jewels-the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Sangha. To practice the Buddha is to reach the enlightenment as Buddha. The purpose of Buddhism is to devote a person`s life to reach the enlightenment as Buddha through. The mysterious rule is that the world is saved by one person who devotes all his whole life to practicing the path of enlightenment. Second, one must practice the Dharma in a right way. It is to know and practice the law of causality through experiences of `no-thinking` and `non-self`. One must know the doctrine of Buddha. Buddhism must be disseminated only with the teachings of Buddha. Third, one must practice the Sangha in a right way. It is to adopt Buddha`s way of living. One must take Buddha`s way of living as the guide for his or her life. If one chooses his or her life in a Buddhist way, Buddhism is not a tool but become the goal. While practicing the three universal truths, one must abide by the five moral rules, which are the fundamental tenets, and firmly believe in the principle of cause and effect.

22권 3호.title_en: The Theory of practice in domestic buddhist mission through Buddhism college`s operating.
22권 3호.abstract_kr: This paper deals with Buddhism college`s types and improvement points, the technique of buddhist missionary practice and its application. My aim is to provide methods of practice technique in order to come up with an effective and efficient buddhist missionary process through Buddhism college`s operating. Today`s Buddhism college in Temple or Buddhist mission center is divided according to giving Jogye-Order`s approval, course process, method of operating, subject, place and independent problem etc. Buddhism college should be managed in relation to the mutual partnership of subjects and objects. And to improve Buddhism college`s system operating, we should give prompt information and answer in Online and select person, program, contents and material things suitably. As buddhist missionary practice frameworks, Buddhism college needs a committee of arrangements, good selecting workers and professors, changing material environment, inducing individual and group to buddhist mission, enforcing work on the outside of temple, using compensation system and suitable system according to small temple etc. From the theory of practice through Buddhism college`s operating, should be prepared intervention and empathy skill, management skill for new learners, skill for oneness, inspiration of believing and buddhist missionary practice and organization skills. Buddhism college`s subject, workers, professors and missionary workers need to be closely connected and communicated. They have to learn orienting theories and theories of practice, practice model, operational review in relation with Buddhist mission. In concluding Buddhism growth dependents on research on buddhist mission`s targets, material environment and practice cases. Therefore Jogye-Order`s missionary Institute, Buddhism colleges, each missionary group meet and communicate together in order to solve mission`s problems and to develop Buddhist College in online or offline relation nets.

22권 3호.title_en: Cornerstone of global Korean Buddhist Culture
22권 3호.abstract_kr: This paper has attempted to demonstrate the reason why we need a paradigm shift from what to globalize to how to globalize when discussing the globalization of Korean Buddhist Culture, and then propose driving forward with publishing dictionaries of Buddhist culture from various fields of Korean Buddhism as for the cornerstone of globalizing Korean Buddhist culture that we cause to commence paramount concern. Foremost of all, this paper was examined several previous researching viewpoints that insisted on rebuilding the identity of Korean Buddhism as for the answer what to globalize Korean Buddhist culture. As the consequence, the difference from the previous researching viewpoints was revealed the identity of Korean Buddhism is considered outcomes to be made through the formulation process that Buddhism was absorbed in Buddhist thought and practiced by Korean Buddhists in the Korean peninsula since Buddhism was brought out to the Korean peninsula. It was also brought out that we ask to accept a fresh understanding of globalization. The globalization means that the results of the formulation process of Buddhism on the Korean peninsula are shared with global citizens, but not shared with people only in the Korean peninsula. And it is likewise indicated that the most important, pressing, and sustainable job for sharing the outcomes globally is to publish Korean-English Buddhist culture dictionaries from various Korean Buddhist fields. In this report, the most emphasizing and clarifying point is that the globalization in Buddhist world is not present phenomenon, but 2,600 years Buddhist history has been the globalizing process of Buddhist civilization. It is also alleged that today various Asian Buddhist countries that have attempted to conduct their own Buddhist culture and thought are considered its Buddhist historical extension. Therefore, it is stressed that globalization of Korean Buddhist culture is not optional, but it is our mission and duty of this era.

22권 3호.title_en: Globalization of the Korean Buddhist culture -limits and response-
22권 3호.abstract_kr: This paper recognizes the various characteristics and problems arising in the Korean Buddhist culture as an intrinsic properties of the world of suffering(sabha) instead of a phenomena accompanying the recent social development and change. Sakyamuni Buddha gave a sermon to his disciples and followers to seek a path building the Buddhist Elysium Elysium (Sukkavati). The Buddhist cultures, which were changed and developed in response to the requests of Sakyamuni Buddha, are considered as part of the 21st century cultural movement. By a brief overview of major changes in the postmodernism, which argues that the boundary of pure literature and popular literature should be broken, it is tried to elucidate that the Buddhist cultural perspectives of the world of suffering are not farfetched interpretation and religious approach, which distort the society phenomenon to religious doctrine of Buddhism, but more reasonable and diverse approach. This paper investigates how the 21st century social change and development have an influence on the whole society, specifically the religious world, and the establishment of future Buddhist cultural movement direction. Furthermore, it emphasizes the Buddhist culture gives a direction for not only the special situations of the 21st century society, but also by the universal values of human freedom and liberty and manifestation of the Buddhist Elysium. At this point, the fundamental mental culture soil of Buddhism will be shared and developed as the culture that reflects the zeitgeist of the 21st century.

22권 3호.title_en: The Existence and Type of Seon Garden in Korea
22권 3호.abstract_kr: This research investigated the existence of Seon Garden in Korean Buddhism and the type, if any. To see the content of the research, this research investigate Korean temple garden by dividing into the period before and after adoption of Zen Buddhism, also, investigated the target to pay attention for the research on Seon Garden particularly such as Rock garden of Sangwonsa in Yangpyeong, Gyedam(溪潭) of Songgwangsa, and Garden Pond of Silsangsa, etc. which have not been studied so far, lastly, arranged the types of garden that can be considered as Korean Seon garden by dividing into general temple gardens, natural gardens, borrowed scenary gardens, and Rock gardens. Research results are as follows. First, it was confirmed that Korean temple has no type of garden that can be defined as Seon garden, since the form of Seon garden was not particularly established or transmitted. Second, this research investigated whether Rock garden of Sangwonsa in Yangyeong, Garden Pond of Silsangsa in Namwon, and Gyedam(溪潭) of Songgwangsa as the special garden modes of Korean temples could act the function of Seon garden. Third, as a result, this research considered that general temple garden also could function as Seon garden in Korea, since it is important the way how to impose a significance on the garden rather than the form of temple garden itself, also, determined granting a significance on the nature by performing artificial acts to have significance as a garden rather than the modification on natural features such as defining the location or direction of building or walling in, etc. to properly recognize the installation of some facilities as pavilion by granting significance by the ancestors who visited the fine view(勝景) around temples, significance as a garden by borrowing beautiful landscape(借景), and the rocks or landscape features within the scenery. In conclusion, this research determined that Korean Seon garden is considered to have an important design language on the concept that the garden which is not actually a garden or the nature itself is garden, which is a mode that appears only in Korean temple.

22권 3호.title_en: A Case Study on the globalization of the Chinese Buddhism : Focusing on the Bodhi Meditation
22권 3호.abstract_kr: During the traditional era, China adopted Buddhism from India then it expanded to Northeast Asian region. It is this era when Chinese Buddhism became globalized by the power of Chinese culture, some of which include the development of Chinese characters and typography, and Buddhist paintings, superior national and cultural power, and ceaseless reformation efforts made by Buddhists. However, after 1949, Chinese Buddhism suffered a major downturn because the new autocratic regime thereabout accepted materialism as their central political and governmental ideology. With Lamaism being oppressed under the ruling regime, Master JinBodhi, who achieved spiritual enlightenment after 20 years of meditation practice at the Quinhai-Tibet Plateau, immigrated to Canada in 1999 to spread his teaching by helping eliminate the illness and liberate sentient beings. Yet, his move to Canada was rather an opportunity to enable the globalization of Buddhism, and promote meditation practice for healing the illness of busy people living in a modern society. Not only was his method of Bodhi meditation practice simple to follow and easy to attain grand ideals (pure joy and perfect wisdom), but also accessible to anyone regardless of their race, country, gender and status. The practice and teaching of Bodhi meditation amplifies the allowance of grand ideas of helping all sentient beings come true within each one`s capacity and made it possible to spread worldwide.

22권 2호.title_en: A Case Study on the globalization of the Korean Buddhism : Focusing on the activities of a major religious Order
22권 2호.abstract_kr: This paper is for the globalization of korean buddhism. It is focused on the international activities in propagating of Jogye order and Chuntae, Jingag order. Korean Buddhism is facing two problems. One is the influx of foreign Buddhist organizations, and the other is how globalization to the Korean Buddhism. At present, foreign Buddhist groups are rapidly disseminated in Korean society. Korea Buddhism is also actively working to expand into foreign countries For the globalization of Korea Buddhism, there are a few different ways; international Relief Services, Buddhist cultural exchanges, promoting international missionary work, establishment and support of education and healthcare, and translation of Buddhist scriptures. International relief, education, health care and support is effective in developing countries. Meditation and Buddhist cultural exchanges are effective in Western industrialized countries. In the future, in order to achieve the globalization of Korea Buddhism, it should be actively and exchanges with many countries and should strive to be promoting an understanding of Buddhism. Internally, they also have the capacity of the international missionary. At the same time, they must ensure the human and material resources required for globalization. To sustainable development in the future, it must establish the identity of Korea Buddhism, at the same time, need to ensure universality that the world is acceptable.

22권 2호.title_kr: 일본불교 세계화의 사례 연구 -신뇨엔의 교리, 종교활동, 사회공헌활동을 중심으로-
22권 2호.title_en: A Case Study on Globalization of Japanese Buddhism : Focusing on Shinnyo-en`s doctrine, religious life, philanthropic activity.
22권 2호.abstract_kr: This article examines the characteristics of doctrine, religious life, philanthropic activity of Shinnyo-en in the context of globalization. Shinnyo-en is a typical lay Buddhism in Japan. It was founded in 1936, and marked the 80th anniversary this year. It has globalized itself since 1966 to have 40 foreign temples and centers in 18 countries. Regular district meetings are being held at 930 places in 51 countries. Also various kinds of its sacred books and periodicals have been translated into 9 foreign languages including English and Korean. Shinnyo-en``s doctrines characteristically stress the law of altruistic practices, equality without distinction of friend or foe, embracement and spiritual harmony, which have ideologically supported the overseas missions and philanthropic activities, and brought on the open attitudes toward other religions or cultures. Characteristics of religious life lie in its emphasis on the Three Practices in everyday life, Sesshin training(meditative practice), and the rite of Homa or Merit Transfer, which have affirmatively worked for its globalization. Finally international philanthropic activities have been generally carried out through three forms; direct involvement by Shinnyo-en itself, specialized works of Shinnyo-en affiliated Foundations, financial support to the international organizations. These activities have contributed to the improvement of its moral position in international societies.
keywords_en: Shinnyo-en. Lay Buddhism in Japan. Globalization

22권 2호.title_en: The Strategies for Internationalization of Korean Buddhism in the Jogye Order: Issues and Directions
22권 2호.abstract_kr: 본고는 글로벌 시대에 불교의 세계화 방향을 모색하는 맥락에서 한국 불교종단을 대표하는 조계종의 국제화 정책과 문제점을 검토하고 미래의 발전방향을 제안하였다. 대한불교조계종의 국제화 이념은 종헌과 관련 법규에 이미 제시되어 있으며, 현 종단 집행부의 역점 정책 사업으로 설정되어 사회부 국제 팀을 중심으로 상당한 성과를 올리고 있다. 한국불교문화의 국제홍보와 외국인 템플스테이 교육, 국내에 있는 여러 국제불교 단체의 자발적인 봉사와 교류활동 등은 앞으로의 세계화 불사에 큰 희망을 갖게 한다. 또한 종단 대표가 종교 지도자협의회의 주도적 역할을 하면서 대한불교조계종의 위상 향상과 종교대화와 국제교류 활동에도 괄목할 만한 성과를 보이고 있다. 그러나 해외 주요 불 교국과 비교해 볼 때 조계종의 국제화 전략과 그 시행은 아직 초기 단계에 머물고 있다고 볼 수 있다. 특히 기독교의 활발한 해외선교 전략과 비교해 볼 때 매우 큰 차이를 보이고 있다. 한국불교 세계화의 과제를 성공적으로 수행하기 위해서는 먼저 국제화에 대한 필요성 인식과 비전의 대전환이 필요하다. 대한 불교조계종의 업무를 전담하는 기구가 너무 소략하며, 해외 포교를 위한 전문연수교육기관이 없다는 점이 가장 큰 문제이다. 국제화 전략수립에는 먼저 기초자료 조사와 기획이 필요하다. 언어권별 불교도의 현황과 사찰의 파악, 해외포교의 원력을 가진 스님 및 재가자의 발굴과 지원, 국제포교와 국제불교회의 참가 전문가 양성과 교육훈련 등에 관한 체계적인 정책이 시행되어야 한다. 이를 위해서는 무엇보다도 재정적 지원이 선행되어야하므로, 국제포교를 위한 특별 기금을 종단과 범불교도 차원에서 시급히 마련해야 할 것이다. 1,700여년 한국불교 전통을 대표하는 대한불교조계종의 국제화정책과 그 실천은 다른 한국불교 종단의 세계화전략의 모델이 되어야 한다. 그러기 위해서는 국제화정책 기획, 재원학보, 전문 인적자원 교육. 세계 공용어인 영어 및 외국어 교육, 국제포교연수원 설립, 교구별 해외 거점 사찰 건립, 새 국제단체 창립의 주도, 해외 불교의 적극적 수용, 국내에 체류하는 외국인 근로자 지원과 포교, 서구문명의 이해와 종교대화 교육 등의 제 문제에 대한 구체적 청사진 제시와 그 실천이 따라야 할 것이다. 불교의 세계화는 단순히 한국불교의 전파차원이 아니라, 전 세계 불자들의 공조와 파트너쉽으로 성취되어야 할 이 시대대승보살들의 대작불사인 것이다.
keywords_en: Internationalization of Korean Buddhism. Jogye Order. Missionary works

22권 2호.title_en: The Plans for Internationalization of the Jingak Order of Korean Buddhism
22권 2호.abstract_kr: The Jingak Order of Korean Buddhism is the Buddhist sect opened by Mater Hoedang, Son Gyusang, after obtaining great enlightenment through chanting Six-syllable Mantra, O. ma.i padme h... The first official name of the religious organization was 갾Edification Institute, Chamhoe-weon갿 later changed to 갾Simin Buddhism Chamhoe-weon갿 in 1951; and to 갾Jingak Order of Korean Buddhism갿 in 1963. Jingak signifies 갻Jingak Esoteric Buddhism갽, which is well expressed in its Basic Tenet. The Basic Tenet shows that the Dharmakaya Mahavairocana Buddha is its Doctrinal Buddha and Six-syllable Mantra O. ma.i padme h.. is the main object of worship for its practice. Therefore, the ascetic exercise of the Jingak Order is the Three Mysteries practice, namely Three Mysteries contemplation focused on the Six-syllable Mantra. Based on this theory, there is not a Buddha statue in the Simindang of the Jingak Order. 갻The attainment of Buddhahood with this very body갽 is the dimension of specialized ascetic practice, 갻the purification of this world갽, on the other hand, is the aspect of our daily life in practical issue. The activities for internationalization of the Jingak Order can be classified into three major sections as follow: Firstly, the international exchange activities in various organizations including WFB, secondli, the overseas missionary works and educational activities, and thirdly, the international academic activities of the Association for Hoedang Studies and various international actions of the Vairocana YouthAssociation.

The Bongwon temple which is the traditional successor of Yeongsanjae should be supported for vigorous global activities and Yeongsanjae need to be upgraded for a global stage. 22권 2호.title_en: International Edification Activities and Prospects of Won Buddhism
22권 2호.abstract_kr: The doctrine system shown in Won Buddhism doctrinal chart not only serves Dharmakaya Buddha Il-won (the One Circle,一圓相) as the target of faith and example of practice but led people to enlightenment especially with Mind-buddha Il-won (the One Circle,心佛一圓相) as a topic(話頭). The characteristics of Buddhism and Won Buddhism in terms of religious phenomena are as follows: First, the figures of enshrined Buddha are different, the statue of the Buddha and Il-won (the One Circle as A Mind-buddha). Second, the methods of faith are different. Buddhism focuses on Buddhist prayers and Buddhist service for the statue of the Buddha, whereas Won Buddhism is the Sasabulgong(事事佛供) centered faith that offers a Buddhist prayer for every Buddha affair everywhere. Third, Buddhism emphasizes meditation-oriented practice in a quiet place while Won Buddhism is mind practice with a focus on timeless Seon(無時 禪) lightening One Mind anytime anywhere. Fourth, the statue of the Buddha is for worshipping the wisdom and personality of Buddha but a Mind-buddha Il-won (the One Circle) encouraged people to enlighten One Mind with it as a topic towards the enlightenment while always serving Buddha in mind. Currently, international edification of Won Buddhism is conducted in about 30 agencies and temples in 67 cities in 23 countries and approximately 140 priests are carrying out edification with a focus on volunteer work and sponsored activities abroad. The scriptures were translated and published in 10 languages and translation is in progress in 15 languages. Won Buddhism is actively maintaining cooperative relations with international religious organizations around United Religions Movement. Since the doctrine system of Won Buddhism is reasonable for life practice and presents a religious model suitable for modern people, Won Buddhism is expected to receive good response anywhere in the future only if talented priests are trained and economic support is made.
keywords_en: Mind-buddha Il-won as a topic(話頭)(the One Circle

22권 2호.title_en: A Study on the role of Buddhism in Unequal society
22권 2호.abstract_kr: The purpose of this article is to study on the role of Mahayana Buddhism in unequal society. Mahayana movement in Buddhism is based on the practice to be beneficient both myself and others, which is the essence of the practice of Bodhisattva. We can find the social publicity in faith of Mahayana Buddhism to awaken bodhicitta to serve to self-profit and other profit equally. Firstly. The correlative linkage between three thousand in one idea and the public practice of comfortable people by the building of the right have contributed to activating the private to opening the public through life respect around the essentiality of public-common value. Secondly, As the Korean J inul Master said The correlative linkage between fulfilling buddha’s nature in one lifetime and wide spreading the dharma benefit in the world have contributed to fulfilling the public-common happiness through life saving. The conviviality is considered to be the attitude of sharing life’s goods and being happy with other people in public-common value. Thirdly, The correlative linkage between three secrets of buddhist law including chanting of Lotus Sutra’s title and the public practice of benefit to others including self interest have contributed to mediation the private with the public through life reconciliation. From this point of view, the Mahayana Buddhism can be seen the face of life Buddhism, people Buddhism and modern Buddhism, and the public efforts to the respect for life, to the reconciliation and to saving life based on the Mahayana Buddhism’s belief system. The teaching of Mahayana Buddhism is taking the three essential factors of Public-common ethics.

22권 2호.abstract_kr: HBGPE aims to possess human being’s good personality which is required for personal successful life. If you possess human being’s good personality, you can succeedingly advance toward your ultimate goal. In another word, you can always do your duty at your position. We call this man as creative leader. The creative leader is asked for what kinds of personality? He is asked for possessing the power for concentration[a strong will], intellectual power, energetic power, and the power for emotion. If he cultivates and uses these powers, he can possess psychological resilience[回復彈力性] which originate from the power for concentration[a strong will], intellect[知性] which originate from intellectual power, wild nature[野性] which originate from energetic power and the sensitivity[感性] which originate from the power for emotion. We call these elements as four human being’s good personalities. Psychological resilience which originate from the power for concentration[a strong will] is regarded as the most important human being’s personality. And then what is the method to cultivate the power for concentration[a strong will] effectively? This writer gave attention to the breath meditation of Buddhism. I thought that we can persue two another ways through using this breath meditation of Buddhism. The first is the successful way in the world. We can live as creative leader who can always do his duty at his position. We can live confident lives by forming good habits. Furthermore we can do important roles in building the strong and good cultual nation as korean future vision. The second is the unworldly way of spiritual enlightenment. This writer gave attention to the fact that breath always indicates ‘here and now’ and ‘here and now’ has the mean as the truth of Buddhism. We call the awakened man as Bodhisattva. Bodhisattva always goes to the way toward saving the world. These two ways have something in common. What is this? This has the hope to become the man who does his duty at his position. So we understand that creative leader has the sameness with Bodhisattva. The successful way in the world is very easy. But the unworldly way of spiritual enlightenment is very hard. We must start to go the easy way. Then we can go the hard way. Even though we select any way, it needs the power for concentration[a strong will] by the breath meditation of Buddhism. In this paper, I tried to research the way which gives us successful life and the way which guides us the unworldly way of spiritual enlightenment each other.

22권 1호.title_en: The Connectivity of Meditation and its Interdisciplinary Application

Meditation is used not only as a buddhist practice but also as a  therapy and healing mechanism. 23권 3호.title_en: Propagation Strategy of Wonbuddhism in the Transition Period -Reconsideration on Spiritual Opening and Founding Spirit-
23권 3호.abstract_kr: Generally, each religion has experienced great development or regression by its own 100 years history or met its new transition period. In this point, Wonbuddhism is in the state of transition over its 100 years history.In the transition period, it is necessary to reconsider its original spirit. Based on the view of history as the Great Opening, Wonbuddhism has its own goal to establish the new spiritual civilization in the harmony of new science and spirit. Establishing the new spiritual civilization requires the great spiritual opening. While there are various religious dogmas such as Il-Won-Sang, Sa-Eun and Sam-Hack, to work towards the goal of spiritual opening is Wonbuddhism's real motive. The basic way for the spiritual opening is the four great principles, which is Wonbuddhism's main concept to present its own identity.Based on the four great principles, the reconsideration over the overall propagation works is necessary. In the process of the reconsideration, the various interpretations of religious dogmas, the changes of Wonbuddhism's organization and system, the reestablishment of the relationship with Buddhism, and the suggestion of its own new vision can be to consist of the bases to practice the spiritual opening and the four great principles.
23권 3호.abstract_en: 종교의 역사는 대개 100년을 기점으로 성장과 퇴보 혹은 새로운 변화의 기점이 이루어진 면이 있다. 원불교는 이제 그 역사가 100년을 넘어서는 역사적 전환기에 있다.전환기에는 그 본래 정신을 다시 살펴야 한다. 원불교는 후천개벽의 역사관에 바탕하여 새로운 과학문명과 도학문명이 조화를 이루는 새로운 정신문명 건설을 목적으로 하고 있다. 이 정신문명 건설을 위해서는 정신개벽이 꼭 필요하다. 일원상 사은 삼학 등의 원불교 각종 교리가 있지만 정신개벽의 목적을 향해서 나가자는 것이 원불교 존재의 이유와 목적이라고 할 수 있다. 그 정신개벽을 향해서 나가는 기본 방향로는 사대강령이 된다. 사대강령은 원불교의 정체성을 확인할 수 있는 중요한 교리적 개념이다.사대강령에 바탕하여 원불교가 행하는 전반의 교화사업을 재분석하는 것도 필요하다고 본다. 이러한 것들을 재분석하고 재정립하는 과정에서 교리 해석의 다양화, 교단 제도조직의 변화, 불교와의 관계 재정립, 새로운 미래의 비젼 제시 등은 정신개벽과 사대강령의 실천을 위한 기본 여건 형성이라고 하겠다.

23권 3호.title_kr: 불교인구 300만 감소에 따른 대한불교진각종 전환기 교화전략
23권 3호.title_en: A strategy of Jingak Buddhist Propagation following the 3 million Buddhist Population Reduced
23권 3호.abstract_kr: Following the result of recent Religion Population Survey, the overall percentage of religious population has fallen sharply compared to 10 years ago. The reason of this fallen is, the percentage of younger people in the religions is decreasing remarkably.The most serious problem in this, for each of the religious organizations in the modern missionaries, including the Buddhist community was that it is difficult to secure and manage younger generations, including children and teens.To establish a future directional strategy in this transitional period of Buddhism, Buddhist community is also struggling to countermeasures in and out.Jingak Buddhist Order is also celebrated the commemorating of the Sacred Buddhist Service (Seongyeokhwa Buddhist Service) and carried forward a business comprehensive bibliography form of a on Korean Esoteric Buddhist culture to prepare for the 100th years anniversary and there is also a wide variety of diverse and exhaustive missions underway to establish the direction and identity of the Jingak esoteric Buddhism.This research paper is based on the reform of the Buddhist spirit of the "Great Master Heodang", and it also summarized the cultural project in relation to the missionary policy in the Order which is celebrated of the 70th foundation anniversary.Furthermore, I have tried to write this paper based on the various problems to diagnose future countermeasures submitted by the various propagator in this field.
23권 3호.abstract_en: 최근 통계청 종교인구조사 결과 발표에 따르면 10년 전에 비해 전체적으로 종교인 비율이 하락한 것으로 나타났으며, 그 원인은 젊은 층의 종교인 비율이 현저하게 감소한 데 있는 것으로 분석되었다. 불교계를 포함한 각 종교기관의 중장기적 현대 포교에 있어 가장 심각한 문제는 바로 어린이・청소년을 비롯한 젊은 층 신도의 지속적인 확보와 관리가 어렵다는 점에 있을 것이다.미래 교화 전략의 방향성을 정립해야 할 전환기적 불교의 현 시점에서 불교계는 대응책 마련에 고심하는 모습이 역력하다. 진각종 역시도 진각100년 대계를 마련하기 위한 총인원 성역화불사 및 한국밀교문화총람 사업 추진 등, 진각밀교의 나아가야 할 방향과 정체성을 확립하기 위한 다양하고도 심도 있는 불사가 진행 중이다.본고는 진각성존 회당대종사의 불교개혁정신을 살피고, 창종 70주년을 맞은 종단의 포교정책과 관련하여 문화 사업을 중심으로 요약했다. 나아가 현장의 교화자들이 제출한 다양한 문제점들을 바탕으로 향후 대응책을 자체적으로 진단해보았다.

23권 3호.abstract_en: 본 논문은 4차 산업혁명시대에 맞는 전법방안을 다룬다. 인공지능시대에 빅데이터와 초연결성의 전법방안과 SNS를 전법도구로 활용할 수 있는 방법을 제시하는 것에 중점을 두었다. 먼저 빅데이터 활용을 통해 각종 실태조사를 하고 전법으로 활용해야 한다. 전법은 주체와 대상, 전달내용과 전달매체로 구분하여 다루어야 하고 그것에 맞는 능력을 갖추어야 한다. 아울러 초연결성을 통해 전법자료의 개발과 공유, 전법이나 설법플랫폼을 형성하고 전법, 설법자료를 제공할 수 있도록 준비해야 한다. 또한 페이스북, 트위트, 카카오톡, 유투브, 유스트림 등의 도구를 활용하는 기법을 배워야 한다. 특히 중요한 것은 전법을 할 수 있는 인간관계가 중요하다. 아울러 PPT, 시청각 도구, Egg, 방송기구 등 전법도구를 잘 활용하여 전법을 실현을 만들어 나가야 한다.

23권 3호.title_en: The ten Points in the Mahisasaka Vinaya
23권 3호.abstract_kr: This paper explains why the ten points received interpretations which varied according to the sources. One hundred years after the Buddha's Nirvana, bhiksus of Vaisali promulgated ten practices as being licit, 1. salt in a horn, 2. two finger, 3. another village, 4. dwelling in the same district. 5. approbation, 6. rule of conduct. 7. sour milk. 8. new palm-wine 9. mats with fringes, 10. gold and silver. In the choice of their interpretations, the various Vinayas were not guided by mere fantasy. They took the trouble to find in their rules, which had already been codified. passages dealing with the points and enabling them to be condemned. In the Mahisasaka Vinaya, it is an extension of that matter to deal with the problem of the ten points.
23권 3호.abstract_en: 이 논문은 10사(事)에 자료에 따른 여러 가지 해석을 설명한다. 붓다열반 100년후 바이샬리 비구들이 10사를 합법적으로 발표했다. 1. 염정, 2. 이지정, 3. 취락간정, 4. 취처정, 5. 수의정, 6. 구주정, 7. 생화합정, 8. 수정, 9. 불익루니사단정, 10. 금은정 등 이다. 각각의 율장들은 자신들이 원하는 해석을 선택하는 데 있어 상상력에 좌우되지 않았다. 각 율장들은 이미 편찬된 그들의 계율 가운데 논쟁점들을 찾았고 그것들을 유죄로 선고할 수 있는 구절들을 찾는데 고심했다. 오분율에서 10사 문제를 다루는 것은 그것의 연장선상에 있다.

23권 3호.title_en: Interpreting the dharani of thousand-armed sutra
23권 3호.abstract_kr: The most popular sutra that buddhists read in large numbers is thousand-armed sutra and the most important contents in the thousand-armed sutra are dharani which is marvelous and strange. Because the dharani is written by sanskrit so buddhists are not easy to read the original of sanskrit and furthermore because buddhists have read the dharani for several hundred years buddhists are only accustomed to read the dharani.Therefore buddhists don`t know the accurate sentence of dharani which buddhists read current. Also, buddhists are not know where the dharani is begun and finished. Therefore, present paper endeavored where the dharani is partitioned and to make the meaning of dharani clear as far as possible.The dharani in the thousand-armed sutra is consisted of 27 sentences and the contents of the dharani are speaking highly of the prestige of Avalokitesvara bodhisattva. If buddhists read intone the dharani, life of buddhists is brightened by virtue of the prestige of Avalokitesvara bodhisattva. Avalokitesvara bodhisattva appears various kinds of figures in the human world and complies with the wish that buddhists desire. Therefore, if buddhists read this dharani with most faithful mind, they will have their wish realized.
23권 3호.abstract_en: 불교신자들이 제일 많이 읽고 있는 경전이 천수경이고, 천수경에서 제일 중요한 내용은 신묘장구 대 다라니이다. 그러나 다라니가 산스끄리뜨 어로 작성되어 있어서 산스끄리뜨 원문을 읽기도 쉽지 않고 또 수백 년 동안 읽어왔기 때문에 불교신자들은 지금 전해지고 있는 다라니를 습관적으로 읽고 있을 뿐이다. 그러므로 불교신자들은 지금 읽고 있는 다라니의 정확한 문장을 알 수가 없고, 다라니의 시작과 끝도 알 수가 없다. 그래서 본 논문에서는 다라니의 문장을 구분하고, 가능한 한 그 뜻을 밝혀 보려고 노력하였다. 천수경 다라니는 모두 27개의 문장으로 구성되어 있고, 그 내용은 관자재보살님의 위신력을 찬탄하고 있다. 이 다라니를 읽으면 관자재보살님의 위신력으로 우리들의 삶이 밝아진다. 관자재보살님은 여러 가지의 모습으로 인간 세상에 출현을 하시며 사람들이 바라는 소원을 들어주고 있다. 그러므로 불교신자들은 지극한 마음으로 이 다라니를 읽으면 바라는 소원을 성취할 수가 있다.

23권 3호.title_kr: 『無門關』에 나타난 炳痛에 關한 考察
23권 3호.title_en: The study on Ch'an Sickness in the Gateless Gate (Mu moon kwan)
23권 3호.abstract_kr: This Study is Ch'an sickness of Kogan's(公案) in the Gateless Gate『Mu moon kwan』. In this paper, we will see the seon-jam(禪箴) of Ch'an Sickness in the Gateless Gate『Mu moon kwan』.For the complete the prajñã-wisdom, when we can cure Ch'an sickness that causes karmic hindrances in our mind of living beings. and we can truly see reality with the eye of insight.Ch'an sickness is a kind of mental hindrance of the student with his own subject or obsessional ideas during the practice of Seon meditation.Every seon master said "To enlight the truth of middle way which being is not different to non-being. or being is same to non-being.There is the Great Jôchû's 'Mu' Kogan's(公案) that Jôchû says "there is not the buddha's nature of a dog, though there is the buddha's nature of a dog. It is very strange for you, if you cause obsessional ideas, you can not reach to the world of the prajñã-wisdom.study hard to hard can reach to the world of transcendence.
23권 3호.abstract_en: 본 硏究의 에서는 禪家의 敎科書 格인 公案集『禪宗無門關』에 나타난 病痛에 대한 考察을 通하여 正法의 眼目을 점검하면서『無門關』에 나타난 그 治癒的 含意까지도 규명해 보는 데에 있다. 이리하여 각자의 수행에 더욱 보탬이 되고 자신의 내면에서 廓徹한 敎訓 혹은 指針이 세워질 수 있도록 하여 이를 함께 공유해 보고자 하였다. 또한 본 硏究가 指向하는 바는『無門關』이라고 하는 公案集에 나타난 病痛에 대해 살펴봄으로써 이를 통해 오늘날의 現代人의 根機에도 잘 맞는 적절한 看話禪의 修行法을 함께 照明해 보고자 함에 있다. 따라서 이를 어떻게 하면 大衆들에게 現代的으로 새로이 접목할 수 있을 지를 잘 응용하여 摸索해 보고자 하는 데에도 그 意味가 있다고 하겠다. 우리가 가장 健康한 상태를 알려면 오히려 건강하지 못한 상태를 기준으로 하여 그 근거를 삼듯이 수행납자들의 病痛을 通해 修行의 바른 眼目을 세워보고자 하는 것이다.따라서 본 硏究에서는 無門 禪師가 제시한 10개의 病痛인「禪箴」를 기준으로 하여 無門關』에 나타난 禪師와 衲子 間의 禪問答을 通해 이 過程에서 볼 수 있는 修行者의 病痛과 그 治癒的 含意를 摸索해 보았다. 지금까지 傳統的 修行인 禪病으로 알음알이(知解)와 馳求心 등을 들어 수없이 알음알이를 내려놓는 修行으로 전념하여 왔는데『無門關』에서 無門 禪師는 이 또한 無라고 廓徹하게 答하고 있다는 것을 알 수 있다. 그 無란 있고 없다는 無가 아닌 상대적인 有와 無를 떠나 이를 넘어선 超越의 無인 것이며, 어떤 규칙에도 얽매이거나 또한 그 규칙을 무시해서도 안 되는 양극단을 떠난 中道 緣起的인 修行으로 나아갈 때만이 비로소 病痛에서 자유로워질 수 있다고 하였던 것이다.
keywords_kr: 中道 緣起的 修行.
